jobs.title: Senior .NET & Azure Developer | DevOps Engineering
jobs.description:
**This is what we offer you**
-----------------------------

* **Salary:** Gross monthly salary between EUR 4,105 and EUR 5,862 (scale 08\) for a 36\-hour work week.
* **Extras:** a thirteenth month, 8% holiday allowance, and a 10% Employee Benefit Budget.
* **Development budget:** EUR 1,400 development budget per year for your growth and development.
* **Hybrid working:** a balance between home and office work (possible for most roles).
* **Pension:** decide for yourself the amount of your personal contribution.


Or view all our benefits.

**Senior .NET \& Azure Developer \| DevOps Engineering**


Do you want to improve how engineers develop and deploy software through Azure DevOps, .NET and Microsoft Azure?

**Summary**
-----------


As a Senior .NET \& Azure Developer at Rabobank, you will work within Tech4Dev on technology that enables efficient DevOps and work\-item management. You will use C\#, .NET Core, Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps to automate and standardise services for Rabobank engineers.


Tech4Dev supports more than 400 squads that build Rabobank’s modern digital experience. Your work helps engineers onboard, design solutions, manage tasks, develop software and deploy changes efficiently, while meeting high standards for quality, performance and security.


At a glance:

* Develop reliable and scalable backend services with C\#, .NET Core and Microsoft Azure.
* Customise and extend Azure DevOps services using APIs, pipelines and automation.
* Improve the development experience for engineers across more than 400 squads.

**What will you do as a Senior .NET \& Azure Developer?**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain backend solutions in C\# and .NET Core that support DevOps and work\-item management for Rabobank engineers.
* Customise and extend Azure DevOps services through platform administration, Azure DevOps Pipelines, APIs and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
* Automate development and deployment processes to help engineers onboard, build features and release software efficiently.
* Build reliable and scalable services with Microsoft Azure components such as Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Azure Storage Accounts and Azure SQL.
* Collaborate with squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to balance technical quality, security and business priorities.

**Skills, tools and areas of expertise**
----------------------------------------


In this role, you will work with or develop knowledge of:

* C\#, .NET and .NET Core.
* Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Azure Storage Accounts and Azure SQL.
* Azure DevOps, Azure DevOps Pipelines, Azure DevOps administration and Azure DevOps APIs.
* API design, API development and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
* Continuous integration and continuous delivery, DevOps methods and the software development lifecycle.
* Git, source control and branching strategies.
* Infrastructure as Code with Bicep and Terraform.
* MSSQL and Azure SQL.
* Bash, PowerShell or Python scripting.
* AI\-enabled development tools.
* Process automation, reporting and analytics integrations.

**Together we achieve more than alone**
---------------------------------------


We believe in the power of differences. By combining people's differences, we become an even better bank. We are curious about what you will bring to our team Tech4Dev.


Within Tribe Tech4Engineering, the Tech4Dev squads develop tools and supporting processes for more than 400 squads. You will work with your squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to provide reliable and easy\-to\-use services for Rabobank engineers.

**Work on yourself \& the world around you**
--------------------------------------------


For us, your development and that of society go hand in hand. That is why we want to invest in you and work together to create a better world. We summarise this in one sentence: at Rabobank, you work on yourself and the world around you at the same time.

**Why everyone is welcome at Rabobank**
---------------------------------------


At Rabobank, we are working towards a culture where everyone feels welcome. We value our differences and use them to collaborate more effectively and make better decisions. By being open to different perspectives, we create an environment where colleagues feel heard.

**What do you bring?**
----------------------


Must\-haves:

* Senior\-level experience in .NET development, including backend programming with C\# and .NET Core.
* Strong knowledge and practical experience of Microsoft Azure cloud services, including Azure Storage Accounts, Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions, Azure App Service and Azure SQL.
* Experience in API design and development.
* Experience with Azure DevOps setup and administration, Azure DevOps Pipelines and the Microsoft Graph REST API.
* Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous delivery, DevOps methods and the software development lifecycle.
* Experience using AI\-enabled development tools to improve productivity, code quality and solution outcomes.
* Knowledge of Git, source control and branching strategies.
* Experience with MSSQL.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, particularly Bicep, and familiarity with Terraform.
* Scripting skills in Bash, PowerShell or Python.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* A critical and analytical approach to identifying the root cause of problems.
* The ability to communicate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive and practical approach, with ownership of problems and outcomes.
* The legal right to work in the Netherlands.

**Nice\-to\-haves:**
--------------------

* Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps APIs and services.
* Experience developing Azure DevOps extensions.
* Experience building APIs and data services for reporting, analytics and integration platforms such as Backstage and Kong.
* Experience developing Power BI semantic models.
* Experience developing Power BI reports.
* AZ\-400: DevOps Engineer Expert certification.
* AZ\-204: Azure Developer Associate certification.
* DP\-900: Azure Data Fundamentals certification.
* Experience supporting teams with onboarding or migration to new technologies.
* Experience with large\-scale rollouts in complex enterprise environments.
* Leadership skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.

**Frequently asked questions**
------------------------------

**Is this role suitable for my experience level?**


This is a senior\-level .NET and Microsoft Azure development role. You need senior\-level .NET experience and practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, APIs and DevOps engineering.

**What will I do each day as a Senior .NET \& Azure Developer?**


You will develop backend services, customise Azure DevOps, automate development processes and improve tools used by Rabobank engineers. You will work with your squad, product owner, scrum master and solution architect.

**Which skills, tools or technologies will I use?**


You will use C\#, .NET Core, Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure DevOps Pipelines, APIs, Git, Bicep and scripting languages such as Bash, PowerShell or Python.

**Which team will I join and who will I work with?**


You will join Tech4Dev within Tribe Tech4Engineering. You will work with squad members, the product owner, scrum master and solution architect to improve services for Rabobank engineers.

**What does the application process look like?**


Your CV and answers to 3 application questions will be used in the first assessment round. Interviews will take place by video call, and a screening and an assignment are part of the process.

**Apply**
---------


To ensure that we assess all candidates equally for suitability for this position, we do not require a cover letter. Instead, we ask all candidates the same three questions to see how your profile matches the position. Pay sufficient attention to answering these questions and explaining your answers; this, together with your CV, is the only information we will use to evaluate you in this round. If this is missing from your application, your application will not be considered. You can draw on your work, volunteer work, education, private life, and so on. Use a maximum of 200 words per question and provide no more than two examples. Below are the questions:

* How should an enterprise\-wide DevOps platform be set up to make sure the process is secure and developers can work efficiently?
* What do you think about having standard rules versus being flexible when setting up DevOps processes in an enterprise?
* If you use Azure DevOps, what automation opportunities do you see?

**You and the application process**
-----------------------------------


Apply for the Senior .NET \& Azure Developer vacancy at Rabobank.

* Questions about working at Rabobank or the process? Contact Niels Diks IT Recruiter, via Niels.Diks@rabobank.nl.
* Interviews will take place via video call.
* If you are invited for an interview, Bo, our virtual assistant, will contact you by SMS and email to schedule the interview.
* A reliability assessment is part of the procedure.
* An assessment can be part of the application process.
* You can find answers to frequently asked questions here: Rabobank application FAQs.
* We respect your privacy: Rabobank privacy information.


You must be based in the Netherlands or elsewhere in the European Union and have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. Rabobank cannot consider applicants who require relocation from another country.

jobs.title: Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen (HVAC & Energy Systems)
jobs.description:
Wil jij bouwen aan de energievoorziening van broederijen over de hele wereld? Heb je een duidelijke visie op duurzame energiesystemen en krijg je energie van het ontwikkelen van slimme, schaalbare producten? Dan is deze rol als Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen bij HatchTech iets voor jou.

  

In deze fulltime functie (intern noemen we deze rol Product Group Owner Energy), ben je verantwoordelijk voor de complete productgroep Energy. Je ontwikkelt samen met jouw team van 5 personen en groeiend, modulaire oplossingen voor verwarmen, koelen, ventileren, perslucht, elektriciteit en andere energievoorzieningen rondom onze incubators. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar vandaag, maar ook naar de broederij van de toekomst: Energiezuinig, modulair en schaalbaar pushed to the max.


Je combineert technische diepgang met ondernemerschap, productontwikkeling en teamleiderschap. Daarbij krijg je veel ruimte om richting te geven aan de strategie, roadmap en innovatie van de productgroep.

 **In deze baan**


Als Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen stuur je de ontwikkeling van de complete productgroep aan. Je vertaalt complexe energiesystemen naar slimme, modulaire bouwblokken. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

* Ontwikkelen van een visie en roadmap voor de productgroep Energy.
* Ontwikkelen en verbeteren van energie\-efficiënte producten en systemen.
* Integreren van koel\-, verwarmings\- en energiesystemen binnen onze totaaloplossingen.
* Opzetten, uitbreiden en begeleiden van een team van engineers.
* Initiëren en leiden van ontwikkelprojecten binnen de bestaande projectstructuur.
* Beoordelen van klantfeedback en vertalen naar verbeteringen.
* Samenwerken met Product Group Owners van Incubators en Software \& Control.
* Ontwikkelen van tools waarmee Sales eenvoudig de juiste configuraties kan samenstellen.
* Presenteren (en prioriteren) van nieuwe concepten, innovaties en investeringsvoorstellen aan het management.


Je werkt vanuit het principe van modulariteit en standaardisatie: producten moeten wereldwijd inzetbaar, schaalbaar en eenvoudig toepasbaar zijn. Een beetje zoals IKEA, maar dan voor industriële energiesystemen.

 **Wie zoeken we?**


Je bent een ervaren specialist die techniek, visie en leiderschap combineert. Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen naar slimme en praktische oplossingen.


Je brengt mee:

* WO\-werk\- en denkniveau.
* Bijvoorbeeld een achtergrond in Energietechniek, Duurzame Energiesystemen, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering, Sustainable Energy Technology of vergelijkbaar.
* Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring op gebied van energiesystemen.
* Ervaring met bijvoorbeeld industriële energiesystemen, luchtbehandeling, warmtepompen, chillers, HVAC of vergelijkbare technieken.
* Ervaring met productontwikkeling en technische innovatie.
* Wat ervaring met het aansturen van engineers of technische teams (hoeft geen 10 jaar te zijn).
* Je woont in de buurt van Veenendaal (max 30 min), want we vinden het fijn als je een niet al te lange reistijd hebt.


Mooi meegenomen:

* Ervaring met internationale projecten.
* Ervaring binnen machinebouw, industriële installaties of duurzame energie.
* Kennis van de agrarische sector.


Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

* Je hebt een eigen visie en durft keuzes te maken.
* Je durft te denken voorbij de status\-quo (onorthodoxe creatieve ideeën mogen de ruimte krijgen).
* Je scheid hoofd\- en bijzaken snel van elkaar.
* Je bent ondernemend en neemt eigenaarschap.
* Je kunt technische complexiteit eenvoudig maken.
* Je bent een teamspeler die mensen weet te verbinden.

 **Wat je van ons kunt verwachten**


Bij HatchTech krijg je de kans om een belangrijke rol te spelen in de toekomst van onze producten én die van onze klanten. We voeden de wereld van morgen. Daarbij hebben we uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden te bieden:

* Een fulltime baan die de komende 10 jaar niet verveelt.
* We belonen je met een salaris tussen de € 6\.000,00 en € 7\.500,00 bruto per maand, op basis van 40 uur per week;
* Je krijgt 26 vakantiedagen en als dat niet genoeg is voor je reisavonturen kun je kiezen voor nog 13 ADV\-dagen extra (beide o.b.v. fulltime).
* Vanzelfsprekend hebben we 8% vakantiegeld.
* Reiskosten van € 0,25 per kilometer met een maximum van 25 km enkele reis.
* Je pensioen is goed geregeld: wij betalen ruim de helft
* Je kunt aandeelhouder worden en meeliften op het succes van HatchTech. We geloven in ‘delen is vermenigvuldigen’.
* We werken schouder aan schouder, 100% vanaf kantoor in een jaloersmakend mooi en groen pand, langs de A12 en dicht bij station Veenendaal\-de Klomp.

  

Hiernaast kun je rekenen op:

* Een sleutelpositie binnen een innovatieve internationale organisatie.
* Veel vrijheid om richting te geven aan jouw productgroep.
* Directe invloed op productstrategie en innovatie.
* Een team van betrokken engineers in Nederland en Oekraïne.
* Werken aan duurzame oplossingen met wereldwijde impact.
* Ruimte voor initiatief, ondernemerschap en persoonlijke groei.

 **Ben jij onze Manager Product Engineering Energiesystemen?**

jobs.description:
Als software engineer raak jij niet snel uitgesproken over je vak. Je deelt graag je kennis en je bent altijd nieuwsgierig naar de inzichten van anderen. Eigenlijk sta je het liefst samen met andere engineers aan een whiteboard om slimme oplossingen te bedenken voor complexe uitdagingen. Jij bent in je element wanneer je bouwt aan systemen die impact maken in de maatschappij.


—\- —\- —\- —\- —\-

**Uitnodiging: inhousedag**
---------------------------

**Donderdag 8 oktober \| 15:00 – 18:30 uur \| Gouda \| Burgemeester Jamessingel 1 \| Naast het station**


Wil je graag – voordat je solliciteert op deze functie – meer weten over werken bij Technolution, kom dan naar de 8e editie van onze informele inhousedag! Ontdek wat Technolution voor jou kan betekenen en maak kennis met de projecten, producten \& collega’s van Technolution.


Klik hier voor meer info en aanmelden voor onze inhousedag!


—\- —\- —\- —\- —\-

**In het kort: werken als Medior Software Engineer bij Technolution**
---------------------------------------------------------------------

* Software ontwikkelen in uitdagende, maatschappelijk relevante projecten
* Technologie: Java, C\# en Rust
* Zelfstandigheid en ruimte voor individuele ontwikkeling
* Werken met hoogopgeleide technische collega’s
* Een snelle sollicitatieprocedure

**Jouw werk als Medior Software Engineer**
------------------------------------------


Als plezier in je werk belangrijk voor je is, zul je je bij ons snel thuis voelen. Samen met je collega’s, net als jij toppers in hun vakgebied, werk je elke dag weer aan uitdagende projecten. Je bouwt bijvoorbeeld mee aan de cloudversie van het grootste verkeersmanagementplatform van Nederland, aan een systeem dat in het Westland na grote hoosbuien de watermassa’s opvangt en afvoert of je werkt aan een energiemanagementsysteem.


Je dag begint met een stand\-up. Met je projectteam bespreek je eventuele issues bij de klant en bedenk je een oplossingsrichting. Je ondersteunt en helpt de ontwikkelaars, bespreekt voor\- en nadelen van de gekozen aanpak en hakt de knoop door bij complexe vraagstukken. Samen met de architect spreek je nieuwe features door, doe je suggesties voor het ontwerp en bekijk je wat de impact is op de huidige applicatie. Je bent constant bezig met het uitwisselen van ideeën. Uiteraard schrijf je uitstekende code, en je draagt bij aan de kwaliteitsborging en de optimalisering van processen en systemen. Daarbij houd je overzicht en heb je altijd oog op de doelen en eindresultaten van het project.


Omdat we zoveel verschillende projecten doen, is er altijd wel een opdracht die bij jou past. We werken daarbij met de nieuwste technologieën en talen – zoals Rust. Je gebruikt, waar mogelijk, de tools die jij het prettigst vindt en je hebt veel vrijheid om te werken op jouw manier. Overigens: je werkt vrijwel altijd bij Technolution op kantoor of op je thuiswerkplek – geen detachering.


Je werkt in deze functie zelfstandig, maar je doet het nooit alleen. Als je vragen hebt, kun je altijd bij je collega’s terecht. Het omgekeerde geldt ook: jouw collega’s kunnen een beroep doen op jou voor advies, hulp en ondersteuning.


**Jouw vooruitgang**
--------------------


Bij alles wat we doen, delen we kennis. Niet alleen met collega’s in projecten, maar ook in onze gespecialiseerde kennisgildes, of in boeiende lunchlezingen. ‘Training on the job’ is de basis voor jouw persoonlijke groei. Jij bepaalt de richting, samen met je People Development Coach. Wat zijn jouw kwaliteiten? Wil je je verdiepen in een klantspecifiek vakgebied en doorgroeien richting domeinarchitect? Je specialiseren als systeemarchitect? Of past projectmanagement meer bij jou? Bij Technolution heb jij de regie over je carrière. Dat geldt ook voor de projecten die je doet: jij geeft aan welke kant je op wilt.

**Typisch jij**
---------------

### **Jij hebt:**

* Een afgeronde relevante Bachelor of Master
* Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als software engineer

* Ervaring met meerdere courante programmeertalen en interesse om andere talen te leren

### **Jij bent:**

* Oplossingsgericht
* Initiatiefrijk

* Collegiaal en behulpzaam


Persoonlijke en professionele groei kunnen bij ons snel gaan als je de juiste kwaliteiten hebt. We hechten veel waarde aan persoonlijk ondernemerschap en vragen van onze collega’s dat ze hun ideeën en wensen duidelijk communiceren. Zo helpen we elkaar vooruit.

**Typisch Technolution \& arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------------------------------


Alles ademt technologie bij Technolution. Met 300 technische professionals realiseren we al meer dan 35 jaar hoogwaardige software en elektronica voor klanten in mobiliteit, energie, industrie, security en hightech. Passie voor techniek, ownership en betrouwbaarheid zijn onze belangrijkste waarden.


Of werken bij Technolution past bij jouw behoeften, kun je het best beleven tijdens een gesprek bij ons op kantoor.

**Jouw salaris**
----------------


Je salaris is een belangrijke arbeidsvoorwaarde. Daarom vind je bovenaan deze vacature alvast de salarisrange voor deze functie. Jouw precieze salaris bepalen we op basis van jouw kennis en werkervaring.


Naast salaris hebben we veel andere aantrekkelijke voorwaarden; financiële en sociale. Want wij geloven erin dat een prettige werkomgeving met fijne collega’s de basis vormt. Een greep uit de voorwaarden:

Werk aan de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van innovatieve (Gen) AI \& Data oplossingen voor onze klanten. Bij Deloitte.

* Mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan de collectieve zorgkostenregeling.
* Fiscaal voordelige regelingen, zoals bedrijfsfitness, het aanschaffen van een fiets tegen bruto salaris of de mogelijkheid om een fiets te leasen.
* De mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van 55 uur oppasdienst per kalenderjaar, als jouw kind 12 jaar of jonger is.
* Een maandelijks budget waarmee je keuzes kunt maken in flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals extra vakantiedagen of het financieren van een fietsplan.
* Verschillende verlofopties, afgestemd op jouw behoeften, van ouderschapsverlof (ook voor regenbooggezinnen) tot de mogelijkheid om drie nationale feestdagen te ruilen voor andere dagen.

**Be the true you**
-------------------



Je bent gedreven professional en enthousiast om je expertise binnen het NL Delivery Center verder te ontwikkelen. Je bent leergierig en geïnteresseerd in de nieuwste AI ontwikkelingen en technieken. Je bent gemotiveerd om snel nieuwe kennis en vaardigheden op te doen en actief bij te dragen aan kennisdeling binnen de organisatie. Je werkt graag in multidisciplinaire teams. Je bent flexibel, neemt initiatief om problemen op te lossen en processen te verbeteren. Je begrijpt het belang van het leveren van een betrouwbare en hoogwaardige dienstverlening aan onze klanten en bent gemotiveerd dit samen met je collega’s te realiseren. Daarnaast sta je klaar om mee te bouwen aan ons nieuwe NL Delivery Center en op deze manier de impact van onze dienstverlening op klanten te vergroten.


Verder beschik je over:

* 3\+ jaar werkervaring in een relevante technische omgeving (bijvoorbeeld in AI/ML, Data Science, Data Engineering of DevOps functies).
* Minimaal een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding, of autodidact met de juiste werkervaring.
* Bewezen ervaring met het werken volgens Agile en Scrum.
* Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
* Een hands\-on mentaliteit met oog voor detail en kwaliteit.
* Het vermogen om analytisch, kritisch en probleemoplossend te denken.
* De bereidheid om te leren, je vaardigheden continu te ontwikkelen en actief bij te dragen aan kennisdeling in een dynamische en groeiende omgeving.


Je hebt ervaring met:

* AI, Data Science \& Machine Learning
* Python, SQL \& ETL/ELT
* DevOps \& CI/CD


Je hebt aanvullende ervaring met:

* GenAI/LLM: LangChain, Hugging Face, vector stores
* MLOps: MLflow, model registry of model serving frameworks (vLLM etc.)
* Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)
* Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift)
* Monitoring en observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk


**What impact will you make?**
------------------------------



Als (Senior) AI \& Data engineer bij Deloitte’s NL Delivery Center werk je aan de meest innovatieve systemen en platformen van onze klanten. Het NL Delivery Center is net gestart waardoor je de kans krijgt om samen met je collega’s iets vanaf de grond op te bouwen. In ons NL Delivery Center werken onder andere software, DevOps, Cloud en dataspecialisten die zich bezighouden met het runnen en onderhouden van essentiële bedrijfsdiensten, processen en functies van onze klanten. Wij bieden een hybride manier van werken, met een vaste standplaats in Breda, en een omgeving waarin persoonlijke groei, kennisdeling en experimenteren centraal staan. Je krijgt de beschikking over een ruim aanbod aan op maat gemaakte trainingen, erkende certificeringen en begeleiding binnen Deloitte.


**How do you do this?**
-----------------------



Als (Senior) AI \& Data Engineer ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van innovatieve, veilige en schaalbare (Gen) AI \& Data oplossingen voor onze klanten. Je maakt onderdeel uit van het nieuwe Netherlands Delivery Center (NLDC) van Deloitte binnen onze Operate practice waar je samen met je collega’s werkt aan het runnen en onderhouden van essentiële bedrijfsdiensten, processen en functies van onze klanten. Je gebruikt innovatieve AI \& Data toepassingen om kwaliteit en efficiëntie in werkprocessen te vergroten. Op deze manier weet je echt impact te maken.

**In deze rol:**

* Werk je aan de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van innovatieve (Gen) AI \& Data oplossingen voor onze klanten.
* Vertaal je complexe klantvragen naar innovatieve, veilige en schaalbare (Gen) AI \& Data oplossingen en leg je inzichten in begrijpelijke taal uit aan de klant.
* Ontwerp, bouw, optimaliseer en test je ML \& (Gen) AI\-modellen en data pipelines.
* Containeriseer je workloads met behulp van bijvoorbeeld Docker en Kubernetes.
* Implementeer en schaal je klantoplossingen met CI/CD\-frameworks en Cloud\-automatisering (MLOps).
* Neem je eigenaarschap over de technische architectuur en kwaliteit.
* Automatiseer je operationele taken met (AI) tooling om kwaliteit en efficiëntie te vergroten, en handmatige interventies in processen te verminderen.
* Werk je nauw samen met andere AI, Data, software \& DevOps specialisten in multidisciplinaire teams.
* Blijf je op de hoogte van de nieuwste technologieën en draag je actief bij aan innovatieve toepassingen en optimalisaties binnen het NL Delivery Center.

jobs.title: Senior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product **Playtime Arcade**, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in\-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

**Keeping Platform Stability Front and Center for 770M\+ Users**


On the frontier of adjoe's most critical publisher relationships, the Product Operations team moves fast, cuts through complexity, and keeps our entire platform running. Operating across the full adjoe stack—backend services, SDKs, catalog, and integrations—we unblock strategic launches, build custom integrations, and resolve critical issues in production.


We act as the safety net for our product teams and the first line of defense for enterprise publishers like Venmo and PayPal. Beyond immediate troubleshooting, we build and scale high\-impact diagnostic tooling to automate root\-cause resolution across client\-side and microservice architectures. Combining cross\-stack technical depth with rapid execution, Product Operations ensures seamless performance wherever enterprise growth meets global scale.

**Your Mission \& Who We Are Looking For:**

* **5\+ years in Go, built for scale.** You have 3\+ years building production Go services and know how to profile and optimize applications under real traffic, not just identify bottlenecks, but eliminate them. You've worked on large Go applications with considerable daily request volume.
* **Distributed systems are your default context.** You design and operate microservice architectures using **Kafka** and **SQS/SNS** for reliable asynchronous communication, and are responsible for collecting and aggregating billions of daily API events into **Kafka** streams queryable from the data lake in seconds.
* **Data performance matters at every layer.** You work with **Druid**, **MySQL**, **Redis**, and **DynamoDB**, optimizing queries and data access patterns to deliver few\-millisecond response times. You know the tradeoffs between different storage solutions and when each one is the right tool.
* **Bridge product and Data Science.** You collaborate directly with Data Scientists to integrate ML algorithms that optimize ad delivery: translating complex mathematical solutions into production\-ready backend services.
* **Partner\-facing data ownership.** You support partners through well\-documented open APIs, providing raw or aggregated data transparently based on their business needs.
* **Infrastructure fluency is part of the job.** You have hands\-on experience with **Terraform**, **Docker**, and serverless infrastructure, owning services end\-to\-end from development to production.

**We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.**

**What’s in It for You?**


At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

* **Go Big.** Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.
* **Move Fast.** Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.
* **Be Direct.** Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.
* **Thrive Together.** Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.
* **Have Fun.** Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.


We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

**Warum wir?**

* Spannende und praxisnahe Einblicke in modernes AI Engineering und innovative Softwareentwicklung

* Ein motiviertes Team, das Zusammenarbeit und Weiterentwicklung lebt

Die EVEX Group ist der führende europäische Anbieter digitaler Lösungen für Optiker und Hörakustiker. Unter den Marken Amparex, IPRO, Euronet, Optix und Bludata unterstützen wir die führenden Akteure in Augenoptik und Hörakustik, ihre Kunden bestmöglich zu betreuen, wirtschaftlich erfolgreich zu sein und administrative Prozesse effizient zu gestalten.  

  

Mit unserer Präsenz in über 20 Ländern und einem breiten Technologie\- und Serviceportfolio schaffen wir digitale Infrastruktur, auf die sich tausende Expert:innen täglich verlassen. Unser Anspruch: Innovative Software mit echter Branchenexpertise verbinden – für einen einfacheren, smarteren und erfolgreicheren Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden.  

  

Zu unseren Kunden – unseren Key Accounts – zählen zahlreiche führende Unternehmensgruppen in Europa, welche für ihre tägliche Arbeit am Kunden und ihr Wachstum auf EVEX zählen. In rund 14\.000 Fachbetrieben setzen unsere Kunden jährlich rund 8 Mrd. EUR um – mithilfe der Produkte und Dienstleistungen von EVEX.  

  

Die PE\-geführte EVEX Group befindet sich auf einem klaren Wachstumspfad: Wir treiben die Internationalisierung voran, erweitern unser Produktangebot um eine KI\-native Plattform und entwickeln unsere Organisation stetig weiter. Heute vereinen wir sechs Unternehmen aus Deutschland, Großbritannien und Italien in einer Gruppe – und gestalten gemeinsam die Zukunft digitaler Gesundheitslösungen in Europa.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist – Optimization Algorithms & Software Development (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology


Enabler for smaller, more powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips


Working for tomorrow today.


Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are produced using ZEISS technologies. As the centerpiece of every electronically controlled system, they have become an integral part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in the field of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high\-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, increasingly powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips, and thus plays a pivotal role in the age of micro\- and nanoelectronics.


As a developer for the system optimization of EUV lithography systems, you will help advance some of the world’s most sophisticated optical systems for semiconductor manufacturing. You will develop physical and mathematical models, optimization algorithms, and robust software solutions used in both system development and production. Working closely with experts from optical design, metrology, process development, production, system engineering, and software development, you will turn complex technical challenges into scalable and sustainable solutions. Depending on the task, you will coordinate technical activities or small expert teams and take responsibility for the quality, schedule, and results of your work.


**Your Role**
=============

* Design, refine, and implement physical and mathematical models as well as numerical algorithms for the adjustment and optimization of complex optical systems.
* Analyze system and production behavior, identify optimization potential, and validate solutions through simulations and experiments under realistic conditions.
* Translate mathematical and physical concepts into robust, maintainable, and testable software used in development and production, primarily in MATLAB and complementary software environments.
* Shape and drive the evolution of our software architecture, including modularization, interfaces, data flows, reusable components, and automated testing—while ensuring the continued operation of existing functionality.
* Establish and promote modern software development practices across projects through code and design reviews, regression testing, version control, knowledge sharing, pairing, and technical mentoring.
* Coordinate activities across optical design, metrology, production, system engineering, and customer interfaces; where appropriate, lead small expert teams and support the introduction of new processes and future technologies.

**Your Profile**
================

* A degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, natural sciences, or a related field; a PhD is an advantage.
* Strong expertise in mathematical optimization, numerical methods, physical modeling, or related algorithmic disciplines, with experience applying them to complex technical systems.
* Extensive experience in software and algorithm development, ideally for scientific, technical, or production\-related applications.
* Strong proficiency in MATLAB; experience with Python, C\#, C\+\+, or comparable languages is an advantage.
* Sound knowledge of software architecture and design, including modularization, interfaces, maintainability, testability, reusable components, and the incremental modernization of existing software systems.
* A proven ability to connect physical domain knowledge, mathematical algorithms, and professional software engineering, combined with fluent English at C1 level and a pragmatic, structured, and collaborative working style.

Your ZEISS Recruiting Team:


Sandra Köhler

jobs.title: Head of Digital Product Platform (gn) full-time/ part-time
jobs.description:
Your job at DKV Mobility? As part of a leading European B2B platform for on\-the\-road payment solutions, you will work in an exciting environment. Our tasks are defined by our Purpose: To drive the transition towards an efficient and sustainable future of mobility. We offer you numerous opportunities to help shape the mobility of tomorrow in a dynamic and agile environment. Our approximately 2,700 employees throughout Europe are united by a common passion: to give their best every day for our customers in more than 50 countries. True to our claim: You drive, we care. Become part of our diverse, dedicated and unique team!


What you can expect
* You define the vision, strategy, and priorities for the digital product platform and align them with customer, business, and technology goals.
* You identify shared needs across product teams, user groups, and customer journeys and translate them into scalable platform capabilities.
* You drive reuse and accelerate the development of better products through common platform solutions.
* You lead, coach, and develop Product Managers, fostering both their professional and personal growth.
* You establish a culture centered on customer centricity, ownership, and outcome\-driven thinking.
* You build strong Product Trio teams together with Engineering and Design and promote effective collaboration between platform and product teams.
* You manage platform investments based on user value, strategic relevance, scalability, and business impact.

You define success metrics for adoption, effectiveness, and business value and ensure that platform investments deliver measurable results.  
* 
What makes you stand out
* You bring 7\+ years of Product Management experience in a SaaS, platform, or digital business environment, including leadership responsibility.
* You have a proven track record of delivering measurable customer and business outcomes and developing successful product or platform strategies.
* You are highly experienced in Continuous Discovery, Experimentation, Product Analytics, and data\-driven product decision\-making.
* You have built and coached empowered Product Teams and helped Product Managers grow and succeed.
* You foster strong Product Leadership capabilities and create an environment where teams can perform at their best.
* You combine strategic thinking with strong business acumen to balance customer value, business impact, and long\-term platform investments.
* You excel at communication and stakeholder management and can align teams and leaders around a shared vision.
* You are fluent in English; German language skills are an advantage.
We are looking forward to your application and to applicants who enrich our diverse culture! Regardless of age, gender, origin and sexual identity and orientation. Severely disabled applicants will be given preference if equally qualified. This position can be full\-time or part\-time (min. 30h/week). DKV Mobility is looking for the best talents and knows that these are not always available on a full\-time basis. Many of our employees work part\-time or in flexible working models. Please talk to us about the flexibility you need during the application process.


**Why DKV Mobility? Here are five good reasons...**
---------------------------------------------------


At DKV Mobility, we are team players \- because we are only successful together! **\#teamofteams**
  

You should feel welcome with us from the very beginning!


### **We've been growing for about 90 years**


How we do it? We keep adapting our products and business model to meet changing customer needs. That's how we stay mobile and master every challenge the future holds.


There are also many other good reasons to work at DKV Mobility. For example, we offer you comprehensive company health management, parent\-child offices (from 2023\) and support you in leasing your eBike through our partner Jobrad!


### **We attach great importance to work\-life balance.**


We stand for the compatibility of family and career! That's why we offer flexible working hours and family\-friendly working time models. In addition, we rely on a balanced mix of on\-site meetings and home office.


### **We support you in your development**


We offer you optimal conditions to familiarize yourself so that you can quickly find your way around and become a part of the team! To further your personal development, we offer you access to a modern learning environment \- independent of time and location. This way you can also face the challenges of tomorrow!


### **We are committed to a net\-zero future**


After reaching our Green Pledge climate target in 2023 by reducing carbon emissions in our own business operations by 50\.4% compared to the base year 2019, we set ourselves ambitious net\-zero climate targets. The targets have been validated by the Science Based Targets initiative. By 2050, DKV Mobility commits to reach net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions across the value chain from a 2022 base year. You want to take climate action? Follow us on our road to net\-zero.


### **We are a certified employer**


Our employees trust us. As an employer, we regularly receive awards from independent institutes, e.g. as Top Employer Germany and as Great Place to Work!


Did you know that we have received several awards as an employer in recent years?

  

Have we made you curious? Then we are looking forward to your application! If you still have open questions then please contact **Sarah Issiakou** via sarah.issiakou@dkv\-mobility.com.

* Du bist hauptverantwortlich für die Umsetzung agiler Digitalisierungsprojekte im Public und Private Sector auf Basis von Pega.

* Du beteiligst dich an der Konzeption von effektiven IT\-Strategien und Zielarchitekturen.

* Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
* Du kannst mehrjährige Erfahrung in Pega\-Implementierungsprojekten vorweisen und hast fundierte Erfahrung im IT\-Sektor.
* Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Lead Developer in Projekten gesammelt.
* Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung modellbasierter Geschäftslösungen und –anwendungen.
* Du hast eine aktuelle Zertifizierung als Pega Senior System Architect (PCSSA) oder bevorzugt als Lead System Architect (PCLSA).

* Du bist Teamplayer mit guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Zusammenarbeit in cross\-funktionalen Teams bereitet dir Freude.
* Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit

#### **Das bieten wir dir**

* **Because we care:** 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
**About the Position**
======================

**Ihre Aufgaben**

Sie entwickeln, analysieren und optimieren bestehende Produktionsprozesse und Prozessketten durch den Einsatz verfahrenstechnischer Methoden und Werkzeuge \- unter Anderem durch Erfassung und Auswertung von Prozessdaten, die Durchführung von Prozessanalysen sowie die Identifikation und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. Sie planen, koordinieren und führen Versuche im Labor\-, Technikums\- und Produktionsmaßstab durch, werten die Ergebnisse aus und leiten daraus technische Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Darüber hinaus bearbeiten Sie verfahrenstechnische Projekte selbstständig von der Konzeptphase bis zur Umsetzung und kommunizieren Ihre Ergebnisse in Form von technischen Berichten, Präsentationen sowie Stoff\- und Energiebilanzen an interne und externe Stakeholder.


Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt Ihrer Tätigkeit liegt in der Unterstützung von Investitions\- und Optimierungsprojekten. Hier wirken Sie bei der Entwicklung technischer Konzepte, der Auswahl geeigneter Apparate und Anlagenkomponenten, der Durchführung von Tests sowie bei Inbetriebnahmen mit. Zudem unterstützen Sie die Nachhaltigkeitsorganisation durch die Erhebung, Aufbereitung und Validierung von prozessbezogenen Daten für Life\-Cycle\-Assessments (LCA). Der Fokus liegt dabei auf der Bereitstellung belastbarer Prozess\-, Energie\-, Rohstoff\- und Emissionsdaten (CO2 Bilanzierung). Darüber hinaus identifizieren Sie kontinuierlich Verbesserungspotenziale in den Bereichen Energieeffizienz, Ressourcennutzung und Prozessperformance und tragen aktiv zum Ausbau des technologischen Know\-hows im Unternehmen bei.


**Ihr Profil**

Sie haben ein Studium der Verfahrenstechnik oder des Chemieingenieurwesens erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Ebenfalls bringen Sie gute Kenntnisse von verfahrenstechnischen oder analytischen Prozessen, z.B. Sprühtrocknung, Mahlen oder Partikelmesstechnik sowie gute Kenntnisse der spezifischen Prozessketten mit. Sie haben Erfahrung mit dem Thema CO2 Bilanzierung \& Nachhaltigkeit und sind vertraut im Umgang mit MS\-Office, Minitab , ERP\-Systemen (idealerweise M3\) und haben erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Life Cycle Analysis. Gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2\) runden Ihr fachliches Profil ab.


Persönlich überzeugen Sie durch Zuverlässigkeit in Bezug auf Terminplanung und Arbeitsergebnisse sowie eine effektive und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise. Sie sind offen in der Kommunikation und bringen sich proaktiv in die Aufgaben des Teams ein. Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen setzen wir voraus.


**Working at Höganäs**
----------------------

We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfill your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world \- and we \- face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred supplier of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net\-zero climate emissions.


**More about Höganäs**
----------------------

  

Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials.


The company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and Höganäs is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. Höganäs collaborates with customers across multiple industries to develop innovative solutions, including applications in automotive components, electric motors, brazing, surface coating, welding consumables and additive manufacturing. Operating 15 production centers worldwide and employing 2,200 people, Höganäs’ turnover for 2025 was 11,045 MSEK. Höganäs is owned by Lindéngruppen and FAM. www.hoganas.com  

  



**Interested? Apply today!**

* Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit der Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
* 35 Stunden reguläre Wochenarbeitszeit und 30 Tage Urlaub
* Helle und moderne Arbeitsräume mit ergonomischen Arbeitsplätzen
* Kantinenzuschuss (am Standort München)
* Zentrale Innenstadtlage mit kostenlosen Parkplätzen und guter Verkehrsanbindung  

(PKW, Bus, U\-Bahn und S\-Bahn) \+ Jobticket
* Familienfreundlichkeit, z. B. Kooperation mit Eltern\-Kind\-Initiative am Standort München
* Regelmäßige Mitarbeiterevents: Sommerfest, Oktoberfest, B2Run
* Wertschätzendes Miteinander mit starkem Zusammenhalt, offener Gesprächskultur und einem familiären Betriebsklima
* Gesundheitsförderung: Wellpass, Gesundheitstage, Sozialberatung, Betriebsärztlicher Dienst
* Attraktive Corporate Benefits: Produkte und Dienstleistungen namhafter Anbieter für Mode, Technik und Wohnen


**Dein Weg zu uns**
-------------------


ASMPT setzt auf den Charakter \- unabhängig von ethnischem Hintergrund, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion, Identität oder Behinderung. Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung.  

  

Wir sind schon gespannt auf Dich, Deine Unterlagen und Deinen Eintrittstermin. Lass uns am besten alles in 2 Minuten über den "Jetzt bewerben"\-Button zukommen. Wir freuen uns!

jobs.title: Support Engineer (Snowflake)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.

**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.

**Who we are**


Our Retail business supports customers throughout their lives, to help them save, plan, protect and enjoy retirement.


We’re a leading provider of retirement and protection solutions. We aim to support our c.12\.8 million policyholders and workplace members throughout their lifelong financial journeys.


We focus on helping the customers of today and tomorrow achieve better long\-term outcomes. We either talk with them directly or work with intermediaries and employers to meet their needs. We use the latest technology to connect with them quickly, efficiently and wherever possible in highly personalised ways.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a Support Engineer to help keep our data services running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative support team responsible for our Snowflake data warehouse, investigating pipeline issues, responding to internal queries and helping colleagues access the accurate data they need.


This is an opportunity to work with Snowflake, DBT, SQL and Azure technology in a varied environment where your troubleshooting and communication skills will be equally valued. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds who can demonstrate the relevant skills, even if they do not meet every desirable requirement.


What you'll be doing:

* Monitoring scheduled ETL jobs and data ingestion pipelines
* Confirming that data has loaded successfully into Snowflake
* Investigating pipeline failures and coordinating timely resolutions
* Responding to incidents and service requests from internal colleagues
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete or inconsistent data
* Supporting technical and non\-technical users with Snowflake queries
* Communicating progress and solutions in clear, accessible language
* Prioritising issues effectively within a fast\-paced support environment


Who we're looking for:

* Practical experience of working with Snowflake
* Good working knowledge of DBT
* Strong SQL skills
* Previous experience within a support or service desk environment
* Effective troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving skills
* An approachable communication style and the ability to explain technical subjects clearly
* The ability to remain organised and make sound decisions under pressure
* Experience of Azure Data Factory or the wider Azure ecosystem would be beneficial


Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance \-related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand\-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


\#LI\-NH1

 **Additional Information**  

At L\&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.


If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.


We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part\-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.


It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**Principal Engineer**
======================


**Location**: Waterloo, London, England, UK \| **Hybrid** (1 day per week in office)



**Who We Are**
--------------



At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.



Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early\-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.



Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands\-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.



If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.


**Who You Are**
---------------



You’ve shown long\-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 10\+ years. You are a trusted expert and leader, often called upon to guide ambiguous initiatives and architect scalable solutions. You bring a blend of deep consulting acumen, technical expertise, and product thinking that drives measurable and impactful outcomes. In your previous experience, you have:


* Built and shipped production\-grade platforms: the reusable foundations, tools, infrastructure, and workflows that help other teams shift faster and more reliably
* Taken AI and agentic systems from prototype to production, with a strong understanding of infrastructure, authentication, and observability
* Delivered on high\-stakes consulting engagements across multiple language paradigms, stacks, ecosystems, and client industries
* Built high\-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served
* Led the development and delivery of production\-grade software using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C\#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL
* Actively experimented with AI development tools and translated that experimentation into faster, higher\-quality delivery for your teams
* A track record of understanding, assessing, and embracing new tooling and trends within the software industry
* Built or integrated AI/ML features into products and systems, including recommendation engines, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, RAG pipelines, and agents
* Successfully led modernisation and replatforming efforts to align legacy systems with short and long\-term business needs
* Led and delivered solutions to architecture\-level problems including scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and observability
* Facilitated alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders to move initiatives forward through ambiguity and complexity
* Provided mentorship and team support at scale, while sharing knowledge and improving team practices
* Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
* Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

**What You’ll Do At 8th Light**
-------------------------------



As a go\-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:


* Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives
* Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long\-term technical vision to what ships
* Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long\-term vision to what ships
* Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high\-quality work within deadlines
* Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes
* Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
* Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions
* Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
* Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
* Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
* Designing and managing high\-level technical roadmaps for large engagements
* Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain
* Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices
* Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization
* Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre\-sales scope shaping
* Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep\-dives to improve team and project outcomes
* Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
* Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
* Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform\- or product\-oriented development
* Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices
* Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale

**Strongly Preferred Skills**
-----------------------------



We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:


* Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
* Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
* Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
* DevSecOps \& DevOps
* MLOps
* Infrastructure as Code


Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real\-world career experiences.


**How You’ll be Supported**
---------------------------



At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well\-being, and success shape our future.


* Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
* A robust L\&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert\-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
* Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning \& development
* Coworking support for our global team
* 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

  


**A Note on Compensation**
--------------------------



At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.



We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Principal Engineer position within London is: £92,818\-£116,122 GBP



Reach out to recruiting@8thlight.com for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.


**8th Light Hubs and Geographies**
----------------------------------



8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.


* **London Co\-working:** Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co\-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.


We hope to see you apply!



\#LI\-Hybrid

**A Note on Your Privacy**
--------------------------



At 8th Light, one of our core values is ***Honesty that builds trust*** — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of *who we are*, *what we're looking for*, and *how we handle your information* throughout the process.

jobs.title: Protection and Control Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Base Location**: Melksham, Oxford, Reading, Slough or Portsmouth  

**Salary:** £64,085 \- £76,581 \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.  

**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available



We are looking for an enthusiastic and diligent engineer to join the SSEN Protection \& Control (P\&C) Team working across the Southern  

Distribution Network.



As a Protection \& Control Engineer, you’ll work with a passionate team on projects from 6\.6kV to 132kV, taking designs from concept through construction and energisation. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders to deliver compliant, cost\-effective solutions on time. You’ll also engage in innovation, standardisation, technology assessments, and work with suppliers on new products and services.



Join us now to help tackle Net Zero challenges and embrace opportunities from new technologies and services.


**You will:**


* Develop scoping documentation and Main Connections \& Protection (MC\&P) Diagrams.
* Review Protection \& Control (P\&C) designs from third parties for 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV networks for SSEN.
* Specify P\&C equipment such as relays, CTs, and VTs.
* Produce detailed designs, including AC/DC schematics, and carry out protection grading studies with relay file/settings creation.
* Review Commissioning Plans, attend panel meetings, and witness FAT and on\-site commissioning as required.


**You have:**


* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in a relevant field is required.
* Proven experience working on Distribution Networks from 11kV to 132kV, ideally a UK Distribution Network.
* Background as a Protection \& Control Design Engineer, including work at 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV.
* Experience in protection relays, relay panels, CT \& VT sizing, protection grading studies, and producing accurate AC/DC schematics.
* Strong knowledge of UK electrical standards, CDM regulations, and a commitment to safety with experience in risk mitigation.


Regular travel is required and as a result we can only accept applications from candidates that hold a current driving license.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Distribution, part of the wider SSE group, powers 3\.9 million UK homes and businesses. Our team of more than 4,200 skilled engineers, customer service advisors and technical specialists keep customers connected to a safe, reliable supply of electricity while investing in and developing the flexible networks needed for our low carbon future.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact laura.morrison@sse.com / 01738 341814 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.



\#LI\-DIST



\#LI\-LM2



\#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Context**


Engineering • Leeds • Full\-Time • Hybrid  

  

Are you a people\-first engineering leader who thrives on turning complex technical challenges into elegant, user\-centric software?  

  

As our Senior Engineering Manager, you will sit at the intersection of high\-level business strategy and hands\-on execution. You will lead the engineering organisation responsible for the full BigChange product suite—from our legacy monolith to our rapidly evolving microservices architecture and mobile product ecosystem.  

  

Reporting to executive leadership, you will lead high\-performing development teams, translate strategic vision into actionable technical roadmaps, and embed an AI\-first engineering culture that elevates delivery velocity, code quality, and team capabilities.  

  

About BigChange:  

  

BigChange is at an inflection point. As a pioneer of AI\-powered field service software serving over 250,000 users worldwide, we are transforming how trades and field service businesses operate. Headquartered in Leeds and part of the global Simpro Group network, our platform connects jobs, people, and performance across plumbing, HVAC, fire \& security, facilities management, electrical contracting, and more.  

  

Trusted by over 2,200 high\-growth businesses, we've processed billions in invoiced work and scheduled tens of millions of jobs. We've featured multiple times on the Sunday Times Tech Track 100, and we're just getting started. We’ve recently launched BigChange Lightning—an AI intelligence layer that deploys autonomous agents across field service operations—and we are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the teams building what comes next.**What You’ll Do**

**People Leadership \& Talent Development**
-------------------------------------------

* Grow \& Mentor: Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and merit cycles, providing honest, constructive feedback and creating tangible career pathways for individual contributors and leaders alike.
* Build a High\-Trust Culture: Drive hiring, onboarding, and retention efforts in Leeds to foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where engineers feel motivated to stay and do their best work.
* Be a Pillar of Support: Act as a trusted sounding board and support system for your team through both professional and personal challenges.

**Technical Requirements**

* Legacy Modernization \& Strategy: Expertise in bridging legacy monoliths (.NET 4\.6\.2, WebForms, jQuery) with modern architecture (C\# .NET 8, Micro\-frontends, Microservices on AWS EKS).
* Full\-Stack Platform Management: Ability to lead diverse development streams across Web (React, WebForms), Mobile (iOS/Swift, Android/Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform), and Backend systems.
* Cloud \& DevOps Leadership: Proven experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS EC2, EKS) and robust CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Data Architecture: Proficiency in overseeing multi\-model data environments, including relational (MS SQL, PG SQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases, alongside data integration pipelines (Snowflake, FiveTran).
* Observability \& Security Integration: A proactive approach to system health (New Relic), security compliance (Snyk, Auth0\), and incident management (PagerDuty, FlagSmith).

**Technical \& Mobile Platform Strategy**

* Set Technical Vision: Establish and communicate a technical vision that aligns with business goals, making pragmatic architectural decisions across web, cloud, and mobile platforms.
* Platform Evolution: Oversee our continued migration from an AWS EC2 monolith toward AWS EKS microservices, ensuring system reliability, security, and long\-term scalability.
* Mobile Ecosystem Leadership: Drive high technical standards across our native and cross\-platform mobile apps, mastering the nuances of mobile performance, deployment, and app store ecosystems.
* Champion Engineering Excellence: Establish high standards for code quality, continuous testing, and proactive management of technical debt with an AI\-first lens.

**Delivery, Operations \& AI\-First SDLC**

* Transform to an AI\-First Team: Lead the transition from traditional agile delivery to an AI\-first software development lifecycle—leveraging developer tooling and CI/CD intelligence to fundamentally change how engineers work and what they achieve.
* Measure Progress: Utilize industry\-standard framework metrics (such as DX Core 4\) to track team performance, remove delivery bottlenecks, and validate the efficiency gains of our AI transformation.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management, Commercial teams, and executive leadership to balance feature delivery (especially mobile\-first initiatives) with platform maintenance and technical debt.
* Incident \& Vendor Leadership: Take the lead during high\-priority technical incidents, coordinating calm, swift resolutions, while managing key vendor relationships and external software partnerships where required.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Proven Engineering Leadership: 8\+ years of total software engineering experience with a track record of successfully managing, scaling, and transforming engineering teams within a fast\-paced SaaS environment.
* Mobile \& Systems Architecture Depth: Hands\-on expertise in modern mobile application development (iOS, Android, React Native, or Flutter) alongside proven experience navigating hybrid environments combining legacy systems and cloud microservices.
* AI Conviction: Genuine conviction about AI in engineering—you've moved teams beyond AI as a curiosity to AI as a core capability multiplier in developer workflows and product features.
* Pragmatic Debt Navigator: A track record of navigating legacy systems and technical debt pragmatically without stalling product velocity or feature delivery.
* Executive Communicator: Strong presence and communication skills—you easily translate complex technical challenges for executive stakeholders and bridge the gap between technical and business goals.
* Empathetic Leader: A genuinely people\-first manager who takes team morale, psychological safety, and individual growth seriously.
* Location: Located in or able to regularly commute to our headquarters in Leeds for on\-site leadership presence.

**Our Core Values**

 **We Are One Team**

**We Are Customer Centric**  

**We Are Growth Minded**  

**We Are Accountable**  

**We Celebrate Success**


Simpro, AroFlo, BigChange \& ClockShark are equal opportunity employers with a best\-of\-class onboarding program and supportive team environments. This means that we want everyone to feel welcome and offer equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation, or any other non\-performance factor.


If you'd like to join a fun and progressive organisation, where there are opportunities to develop your career, please apply now with your CV/Resumer.

*Please note: no agencies will be accepted in the recruitment of this role. Any CVs provided to Simpro Software by agencies will be treated as a gift.*
