jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are Printed.com, one of the largest and fastest growing on\-line print shops in the UK. We are filled to the brim with a passionate team who are mad about printing, designing, building and growing the business. In the office you’ll find that we are forward\-thinking, with a mission to be creative, innovative and to help our customers.


We are constantly investing in new products and using technology to improve how we increase our market share and take advantage of new opportunities. Catch us in our production space and you will find a fast\-paced, dedicated team who endeavour to reach perfection for our customers.

  

We’re a growing company with offices in London and Newcastle, looking for employees that are equal parts dynamic and enthusiastic. People brimming over with new, original ideas that they just can’t wait to share with their team and bring to life.


Printed.com is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Engineering team as we scale our platform across UK and US markets, reporting directly to our Head of Engineering. You'll work across a mix of PHP (Symfony/Laravel) applications running on AWS (EC2 and EKS), contributing hands\-on to multiple concurrent projects while helping raise the bar on engineering practices across the team. This role carries the scope and expectations of someone who takes the initiative on ambiguous or unowned problems with little to no guidance, is comfortable moving fluidly between workstreams, conversations, and challenges, and can dig past the symptom to find the actual root cause. You'll be trusted to own technical decisions and help set technical direction, not just execute against a spec, and to bring that same drive to mentoring others as the team continues to mature.


This is a hybrid role with minimum of 2 days required in our Cramlington office.

 **Requirements** **Responsibilities**


Ownership \& Initiative


Take the initiative on problems with little to no guidance — spotting what needs doing, digging past the symptom to find the actual root cause, and driving the technical decisions needed to resolve it, working closely with the Engineering Leadership Team, Head of Engineering and Head of Programme to keep that aligned with the wider technical direction.

  

Multi\-Project Delivery


Work across several concurrent workstreams — spanning feature development, platform improvements, and infrastructure initiatives — balancing competing priorities while maintaining code quality and delivery pace.

  

Engineering Best Practices


Champion and help embed engineering best practices (code review standards, testing, CI/CD, documentation) across the team, acting as a role model for the standard of work expected from senior engineers.

  

Process \& Ways\-of\-Working Adoption


Support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working as the engineering function matures, helping teammates understand the "why" behind changes and troubleshooting adoption friction.

  

Mentoring \& Technical Guidance


Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, code review, and informal guidance, helping build technical capability and confidence across the team.

**Key Skills**

* Our stack is PHP (Symfony/Laravel) with Vue.js front ends — but we're open to strong engineers from other frameworks (e.g. Rails, Django, .NET) or other JS frameworks (React, Angular) who can demonstrate solid fundamentals and pick things up quickly
* Comfortable working across JavaScript, SCSS, and Twig as part of day\-to\-day full\-stack delivery, or a proven track record of moving fluently across a similar front\-to\-back stack
* Solid working knowledge of AWS (EC2, EKS/containers, RDS, or similar services)
* Background in DevOps, platform, or infrastructure engineering
* Comfortable working across multiple projects and shifting priorities
* Confident, senior\-level communicator able to work autonomously and influence without authority
* Experience mentoring or supporting the development of other engineers
* Familiarity with observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir) is a plus
* Pragmatic approach to trade\-offs between speed, technical debt, and long\-term maintainability
* A genuine self\-starter — comfortable picking up an ambiguous or unowned problem, working out what's really going on, and driving it to a solution with minimal handholding
* Approaches technical disagreement collaboratively — pushes back on ideas, not people, and can hold a firm position without it turning combative
* Cost\-conscious when working with cloud infrastructure — thinks about the cost implications of architectural decisions, not just the technical ones
* Comfortable working with legacy and end\-of\-life systems — able to help modernise incrementally without needing a clean\-slate rewrite
* Security\-conscious by default — thinks about access control, dependency hygiene, and data handling as part of normal development, not as an afterthought

  

**Benefits**  

* 22 days holiday Plus 8 days bank holidays
* Staff discounts \& Friends and Family discounts
* Cycle to work scheme, Tech Scheme and EV Scheme (subject to conditions)
* Breakfast and drinks provided on days you work in the office
* 1 Charity Day per year
* Summer and Christmas Parties
* Street food days
* Perkbox membership
* Enhanced parental leave
* Staff discount on print

**Asset Engineer**
==================


### **About the role**


National Grid Ventures Interconnectors is playing a critical role in connecting the UK's energy system with neighbouring countries, helping to deliver a more secure, resilient and low\-carbon energy future. Through our portfolio of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) interconnectors, we enable the import and export of electricity, supporting the UK's transition to net zero while developing the infrastructure needed to meet future energy demands.


We're looking for an **Asset Engineer** to join our Asset \& Engineering team. In this role, you'll be responsible for the effective management, performance and maintenance of critical interconnector assets, helping to ensure exceptional levels of reliability, availability and operational resilience across our portfolio.


Working closely with site\-based and central teams, you'll use your technical expertise to develop asset strategies, drive maintenance excellence, improve asset health and support continuous improvement initiatives. You'll play a key role in ensuring our assets perform safely, efficiently and in line with all regulatory and operational requirements.


This position is based at our IFA1 site in Sellindge so candidates would be ideally be based within a hours commute.


### **What you'll do**


As an Asset Engineer, you will:


* Deliver asset health assessments and asset management activities in line with National Grid policies and standards.
* Develop and implement asset maintenance strategies to maximise asset performance, reliability and lifespan.
* Translate OEM technical guidance and engineering standards into practical maintenance plans, work instructions and Maximo task lists.
* Produce and manage maintenance plans and outage scopes to ensure maintenance activities are completed safely and effectively.
* Support the management of asset defects, equipment failures and technical investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.
* Analyse asset performance data and provide recommendations to improve reliability and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with site operations teams, engineering specialists and external partners to drive best practice across the interconnector portfolio.
* Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) on warranty, performance and asset integrity matters.
* Maintain accurate asset records and support continual improvement of asset data within Maximo.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, compliance and continuous improvement across all engineering activities.
### **What you'll need**


* Experience in engineering and asset management, ideally within the utilities, energy, infrastructure or industrial sectors.
* Strong understanding of asset management principles and maintenance strategies.
* Knowledge of high\-voltage electrical systems or other critical infrastructure assets.
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, engineering drawings and OEM manuals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make informed technical decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience using asset management systems such as Maximo or similar platforms.
* Understanding of risk management processes and regulatory compliance requirements.
* A proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* HNC in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
* Full UK Driving Licence.
### **What you'll get**


A competitive salary between **£47,442\.00 \- £56,173\.50 per annum**– dependent on capability.

  

  

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

  

This role closes on **28th September at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.


We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.


Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points\-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points\-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

To create revolutionary, story\-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind\-the\-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members!

 **Job Description**  

Join CD PROJEKT RED and help shape the future of QA Engineering across our projects and Shared Development Services initiatives. We’re looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** to help build and scale technical quality solutions, automation frameworks and testing infrastructure used across multiple Unreal Engine projects.


You will be part of the QA Engineering team within Shared Development Services (SDS) \- a shared technical group focused on improving quality, testability and development workflows through automation, reusable tooling and standardized testing platforms.


While the priority for this role will initially be supporting the development of Witcher 4 this is not a project\-dedicated position. Your work will contribute to long\-term cross\-project QA Engineering solutions and shared technical capabilities used across the studio.


This is an opportunity to join at the early stages of a highly innovative game and play a key role in shaping scalable QA engineering practices from the ground up. You will work closely with development teams to build and maintain automated testing solutions, testing environments and shared technical tooling supporting multiple teams and gameplay systems.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Tech Art, Art, QA, DevOps, and central development services teams to support integration and deployment of automated testing solutions, shared tooling, and testing environments across projects.
* Design, develop, maintain, and extend automated test frameworks and testing infrastructure for Unreal Engine systems and reusable gameplay modules.
* Support migration, integration, and validation of shared automation solutions between different projects and development environments.
* Investigate, debug, and resolve technical issues related to automation, integrations, testing environments, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure.
* Participate in the code review process and contribute to maintaining high engineering standards across QA automation codebases.
* Work closely with development teams to improve testability, reliability, scalability, and long\-term maintainability of shared systems.
* Proactively monitor and maintain CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid identification and resolution of build and test failures.

 **Qualifications*** 4\+ years of experience in QA Engineering, test automation, or software testing, preferably within the gaming industry.
* C\+\+ experience, especially within Unreal Engine environments.
* Knowledge of working with automated testing, tooling, and testing infrastructure in Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks and testing solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, integrations, and development environments.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines and teams.
* Comfortable owning tasks and asking for input when needed with a strong sense of curiosity toward solving technical challenges.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience shipping an Unreal Engine\-based game for Xbox or PlayStation consoles.
* Prior experience with Unreal Engine, or a very strong understanding of Unreal from the development side, not limited to automated test work.
* Experience with containerization and cloud technologies (e.g., Docker, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with programming and scripting skills using languages such as Python, TypeScript or C\#.
* Experience with performance profiling, debugging or validation tooling within Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience with asset processing and validation pipelines, digital content authoring tools, or other proprietary game engine tools.
* Experience supporting shared tooling, reusable systems, or cross\-project technical initiatives.
* Experience working with CI/CD systems and automation pipelines.

 **Additional Information** **Working mode**


In\-office in a hybrid or full\-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland.

**Health \& Well\-Being**

* Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
* Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
* Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
* Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well\-being initiatives.
* Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
* Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
* RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family\-friendly events.
* RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.

**Perks \& Professional Growth**

* A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
* Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge\-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e\-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
* REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.

Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!  
* 

**Social Activities \& Life in the Office**

* Dog\-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
* Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
* Healthy selections — canteens.
* Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
* Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
* A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.

jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

**Are you an experienced backend developer with a curious mindset?** Do you have a passion for building intuitive, cutting\-edge solutions with state\-of\-the\-art technology?


At LeoVegas, we’re on a mission to deliver the greatest iGaming experience to our customers and technology is at the heart of making that happen.


As part of our Retention domain, you’ll play a key role in developing the platforms and features that keep players engaged and coming back for more.


This is a great opportunity to join a fast\-moving, flat\-structured team as a Senior Backend Engineer, where your work will directly shape value\-generating features across our products.


The Retention team powers the organisation with communication capabilities, ranging from indirect and direct communication with the players to a custom\-built toolbox that enriches the player journey with bonuses, loyalty programs, and seamless cross\-channel experiences. As one of the most crucial parts of the player lifecycle, the Retention domain ensures our players return for new, exciting, and rewarding experiences.


We’re driven by excellence and fuelled by innovation now we’re looking for someone who wants to be part of that journey.

 **YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:**

* Building scalable, robust and efficient solutions in our full\-stack team and ensure the continuous delivery in our microservice architecture.
* Being involved in technical discussions to challenge, propose, evaluate, and take a guiding and supportive approach to business needs.
* Working closely with our operational units and stakeholders.
* Driving your own initiatives with a high\-quality mindset.
* Working within the full chain of development, having end\-to\-end responsibilities.
* Collaborative work across the organisation with other domains.
* Making sure our IT ecology is scalable and ready for upcoming expansions.

 **OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:**


ESSENTIAL SKILLS

* Minimum of 6\+ years of experience working as a back\-end developer with Java and/or Kotlin
* Experience with messaging tools (i.e. Kafka)
* Experience with microservice architecture
* You have experience with common Java frameworks such as Spring and JPA
* MySQL relational databases are not something new for you
* Experience with AI tools like Claude

  

NICE TO HAVES

* Experience with OpenAPI
* Experience with BigQuery
* Experience with Kubernetes

 **WHO WE ARE**


At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the iGaming industry. We’re a team of almost 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast\-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

 **BENEFITS**

* Hybrid work policy (3 days a week from the office)
* 4 weeks of Workation (T\&C apply)

* Training budget
* ICAS assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments.
* Our office provides complimentary snacks and drinks; on Mondays, we serve complimentary breakfast.
* Team and office social events throughout the year
* Free parking for bicycles and motorcycles
* Free gym in the building
* Equipment: MacBook Pro \+ smartphone (iPhone 16/17 or Samsung Galaxy S25\)

 **JOIN US!**


In our pride, we like to empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait around for things to happen. We pounce and make it happen!


Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride \- give us a roar!

jobs.title: .NET Backend Developer — 6-Month Project (NXJ-204)
jobs.description:
**The Role**
------------

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto\-tagging engine—the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem\-solving in a highly collaborative, AI\-integrated environment.


**About the Product**
---------------------


The product is an AI\-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI\-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real\-time content creation.


Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low\-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production\-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.


**Team Structure \& Collaboration:**

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. Because the index layer relies heavily on algorithm signals, you will work in close daily collaboration with the AI and algorithm teams.  



**What You’ll Be Doing**
------------------------

* **Video Indexing \& Auto\-Tagging:** Build and maintain the C\#/.NET backend infrastructure that interprets algorithm signals to index videos and auto\-tag live sports events
* **Technical Leadership:** Elevate the team by actively participating in design discussions, driving code review standards, and mentoring fellow developers
* **On\-Call Rotation:** Participate in a shared on\-call pool (approximately one week every five weeks). While critical nighttime or weekend outages are rare, you must remain reachable and have access to a laptop to respond to operations team escalations
* **Proactivity:** Execute tasks independently, demonstrate strong problem\-solving skills, and maintain prompt, proactive communication via Slack with the Israel\-based team

**What We Expect**
------------------


* Strong proficiency in C\# and .NET, with **5\+ years** **of commercial .NET experience**
* Hands\-on experience developing within **Azure** cloud environments
* Familiarity with and daily use of **AI\-assisted engineering tools** (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
* Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to mentor peers and lead design discussions
* **High autonomy**, independent task execution, and proactive communication habits for effective distributed collaboration
* Familiarity with event\-driven messaging services such as **Azure Service Bus** or **Kafka**
* Working knowledge of **SQL databases** (general proficiency; specific engines do not matter)
* Basic familiarity with **DevOps terminology** and **Kubernetes** (operational expertise is not required)
* Willingness to work in a hybrid mode, **3 days from the office in Warsaw**

**Why This Role Is Worth Your Time**
------------------------------------


* Direct ownership of pure backend compute at scale—no full\-stack dilution, focusing entirely on high\-load microservices, indexing engines, and real\-time processing
* High\-autonomy environment with modern workflows where AI tools (Claude, Cursor) are embraced to eliminate boilerplate and keep focus on architecture

  
### **Category**


.Net · Backend · SaaS


### **Type**


### **Location**

jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:** EU remote

#### **About the Role:**


As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise\-grade solutions for audiology clinic chains worldwide. You will shape integrations, domain boundaries, system design, and platform evolution across our SaaS product portfolio.

**Our tech stack** includes .NET, React ecosystem, Azure Servises (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database).


#### **What You Will Do:**

**Integration \& API Architecture:**

* Define and maintain Manage’s integration strategy (REST, Events, APIs, Data Feeds).
* Design standard integration patterns — real\-time (Event Hubs), on\-demand (REST), hybrid workflows.
* Lead technical workshops with customers and partners to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
* Align integrations with domain boundaries, data contracts, and platform security standards.
* Govern message contracts, event schemas, versioning strategy, and error\-handling models.
* Enforce security best practices (OAuth2, mTLS, Azure AD, Key Vault).
* Oversee monitoring, observability, and integration reliability (tracking, retries, DLQs).

**Domain \& System Architecture:**

* Serve as the technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates, and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross\-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high\-level design, technology selection, and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture, and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation, and ADRs.

**Platform \& Multi\-Tenancy:**

* Design and own the architecture of a secure, performant, and cost\-efficient multi\-tenancy model.
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture vision and support the evolution of the platform strategy.

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement:**

* Participate in pre\-sales work, technical scoping, and early\-stage solution shaping.
* Support troubleshooting and performance improvements for complex integrations or distributed system issues.

#### **What You Will Bring:**


Technical Skills \& Experience:

* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate architectural decisions to both leadership and engineering teams.
* Experience with integration architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, REST APIs, Webhooks).
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event\-driven architectures.**
* Solid understanding of **Domain\-Driven Design** and **Clean Architecture.**
* Proven ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation and diagrams (Miro, Lucid, C4, Event Catalog).
* Comfortable in customer\-facing technical discussions.
* Strong background in Azure Cloud services.
* Ability to enforce architectural standards through ADRs, reviews, and quality gates.
* Familiarity with governance, audit logging, and proactive system health monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with Product and Delivery teams to align architecture with the roadmap and business vision.
* Fluent English.


Preferred:

* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years in architecture roles within enterprise SaaS.
* Proven experience modernizing or commercializing legacy platforms into scalable, multi\-tenant products.
* Demonstrated success designing enterprise\-grade integrations.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.


Nice\-to\-Haves:

* Experience with MassTransit.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs, or agent\-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* Strong understanding of security and compliance for medical or regulated data (HIPAA, GDPR).
* .NET and React familiarity.


Key Traits:

jobs.title: Software Solutions Engineer – Cloud, Integrations & Architecture
jobs.description:
.


Proffsmagasinet is looking for a hands\-on **Software Solutions Engineer** to join our internal technology team and work closely with our business and established external development partners.



This is a broad role combining **software engineering, architecture and business understanding**. You will not only translate requirements into solutions, but also identify opportunities where technology can improve customer experience, efficiency and business performance.



**What you will do**



* Work closely with business teams to understand needs and identify opportunities
* Design and build backend services, APIs, integrations, automation and internal tools
* Help shape technology decisions and long\-term business goals
* Work across our Azure\-based, containerised e\-commerce environment
* Collaborate with our internal tech team and external developers
* Explore and test new technologies where they can create real business value


**Our environment**



Our landscape includes **.NET/F\#, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Kafka, Cosmos DB, Elasticsearch, Visma Business, Sterling EDI and Vivaldi**.



Our technology supports a complex e\-commerce ecosystem spanning online commerce, ERP, warehouse, logistics, search, payments, customer communication and integrations.



You do not need experience with everything above. We value the ability to understand complex systems, learn quickly and choose pragmatic solutions.



**What we are looking for**



You are an experienced software engineer who still enjoys building things, but who also has a **commercial mindset and strong business understanding**.



You should be comfortable working across technology and business, influencing architecture, solving complex problems and helping turn ideas into valuable solutions.



Experience with AI\-assisted development is valuable. **F\# experience is useful, but not required.**



**Why Proffsmagasinet?**



You will join a small, highly effective team with real influence, direct access to business decision\-makers and the opportunity to shape how technology drives growth, customer experience and operational excellence across Proffsmagasinet.



Full\-time (40 hours/week)  

Our hybrid location policy is currently four days a week at our office by Liljeholmskajen in Stockholm.


.

jobs.title: Teknisk Produktägare Integration & Automation till Balder
jobs.description:
Vi är Balder. Vi vill påstå att vi inte är som alla andra fastighetsbolag. Att vi vågar utmana branschens gamla sanningar.
  
Som Teknisk Produktägare för Integration \& Automation blir du navet som knyter ihop Balders systemlandskap, från vårt nya ekonomisystem och dataplattform till masterdata och externa tjänster. Rollen sitter centralt i vår tekniska organisation, nära både verksamheten och utvecklingsteamen, och växer i takt med att vi expanderar till fler nordiska länder.
  
  

Om rollen
  
**Rollen växlar mellan att tänka stort och jobba i detalj:** en dag handlar det om riktning och roadmap i vår Azure\-miljö, en annan om att en integration faktiskt levererar som den ska. Du är den som sätter riktningen gentemot både verksamheten och de som bygger lösningarna.
  
  

**Snabbversionen:**  

Du kommer äga roadmap och arkitektur för hela integrations\- och automationsområdet.
  
  

Du kommer agera lösningsarkitekt – från kravställning till teknisk design och implementation.
  
  

Du kommer leda och kvalitetssäkra arbetet hos utvecklare, konsulter och leverantörer.
  
  

Du kommer etablera gemensamma standarder och följa upp drift, incidenter och teknisk skuld.
  
  

”Vi har gått från att köpa in hela integrationsleveransen till att själva äga arkitekturen, riktningen och de tekniska vägvalen, med konsulter som en förlängning av teamet. Samtidigt gör vi en stor teknikresa med nytt ERP, masterdata, dataplattform och flera nya verksamhetssystem. Det är en väldigt spännande miljö att få vara med och bygga.”
  
– Henrik, Enterprise Architect
  
  

Vad vi söker
  
För att du både ska trivas och kunna leverera hos oss så tror vi att du har flerårig erfarenhet av integrationsarkitektur, integrationsutveckling eller tekniskt produktägarskap inom integration – oavsett om det tagit dig tre eller tio år dit. Det viktiga är att du har varit med hela vägen: samlat krav, designat, utvecklat och levererat en integrationslösning från start till mål, med djup förståelse för API\-design och olika integrationsmönster.
  
  

**Krav:**  

Bakgrund som integrationsarkitekt, senior integrationsutvecklare, Solution Architect eller Tech Lead.
  
  

Erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services (API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Functions)
  
  

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur och teknisk design för integrationslösningar
  
  

Erfarenhet av kravställning och teknisk ledning av utvecklare eller externa leveransteam
  
  

Du har utvecklat i något kodspråk (t.ex. C\#. NET), är van vid att testa API: er och läsa API\-dokumentation och har erfarenhet av olika typer autentisierignsmetoder.
  
  

**Meriterande:**  

Erfarenhet av Power Platform, Nodinite eller Infrastructure as Code.
  
  

Erfarenhet från fastighetsbranschen eller andra verksamheter med komplexa systemlandskap.
  
  

Vem är du?
  
Du är tekniskt skicklig och hands\-on men det är affären och verksamhetsnyttan som styr dina val, inte tekniken i sig. Långsiktigt ägarskap kommer naturligt för dig, och du är social nog att navigera i prioriteringar mellan olika intressenter. Din nyfikenhet gör att du hellre skapar ordning där den saknas än förvaltar något som redan är på plats.
  
Låter detta som en tjänst för dig?
  
Kul! Vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning om 6 månader. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Göteborg, med arbete på plats fem dagar i veckan.
  
I denna process ber vi dig inte skicka med personligt brev, utan vill i stället att du besvarar våra urvalsfrågor. Vi använder oss av rekryteringstester för att hjälpa oss göra ett så bra och objektivt urval som möjligt.
  
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Elin Kothe, TA\-Konsult, på elin.kothe@balder.se
  
  

Hjärtligt välkommen till oss och en bransch som är full av möjligheter!

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Junior Software Developer who wants to grow in modern software development and help build digital solutions for restaurants and foodtech.
  
This role is for you if you have a solid foundation in programming and want hands\-on experience building, testing, and maintaining software with experienced developers and other team members.
  
You’ll work across multiple product areas and contribute to solutions used in everyday restaurant operations—such as POS, online ordering, kitchen screens, self\-service kiosks, payments, and integrations.
  
About the role
  
As a Junior Software Developer, you’ll be part of our development team—developing, improving, and maintaining our digital products.
  
You’ll participate in the full development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and planning solutions to writing code, testing, troubleshooting, and following up on deliveries.
  
You’ll work closely with senior developers, product owners, QA, and other team members to deliver solutions with high quality, great user experience, and stable operations.
  
What you’ll do
  
Develop and maintain features in our web and backend solutions.
  
Write clean, structured, and testable code.
  
Participate in planning, estimation, and technical discussions.
  
Troubleshoot and analyze bugs in development and production.
  
Write and update unit and integration tests.
  
Contribute to building AI solutions.
  
Work with APIs, databases, and system integrations.
  
Review code with colleagues and give/receive feedback constructively.
  
Continuously improve development practices, code quality, and documentation.
  
  

What we’re looking for
  
Post\-secondary education in software development, computer science, or equivalent knowledge.
  
Basic programming experience (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C\#, Python, or similar).
  
Understanding of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and core software architecture.
  
Basic knowledge of databases, REST APIs, and Git version control.
  
Understanding of testing, debugging, and agile development methods.
  
Ability to communicate in English, both written and spoken.
  
A drive to learn, take ownership, and grow with the team.
  
  

Nice to have
  
Experience with React, Node.js, Java, TypeScript, or other modern frameworks.
  
Experience with cloud services, CI/CD, or containers.
  
Experience with SQL, relational databases, or message\-based integrations.
  
Personal projects, open\-source contributions, or relevant internship/work experience.
  
Experience building web applications, SaaS solutions, payments, POS systems, or e\-commerce platforms.
  
Interest in AI tools and how they can be used for development, testing, and product innovation.
  
  

Who you are
  
You’re curious and solution\-oriented—you like understanding how things work. You take initiative, ask questions when something is unclear, and use feedback to improve.
  
You work in a structured way and care about code quality, testing, and documentation, while also enjoying collaboration and sharing knowledge.
  
You don’t need to know everything from day one. The key is a strong technical foundation, genuine interest in software development, and the desire to grow in the role.
  
About us
  
We build digital systems used every day by restaurants and foodtech companies—POS, online ordering, self\-service kiosks, payments, integrations, and customer\-facing tools.
  
Our products operate in environments where stability, performance, and usability are critical. That’s why we work closely with customers and product teams to create solutions that make restaurant operations easier and more efficient.
  
Here, you’ll develop as a developer, work on real products, and be part of a team building the future of the digital restaurant experience.

jobs.title: .Net Developer
jobs.description:
**Vi letar efter en senior utvecklare som både drivs av teknik och affär. Din starka kompetens inom .Net, kombinerat med dina soft skills är det som kommer få dig att lyckas i rollen hos oss!**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





#### **Det här letar vi efter**


Vi letar efter en senior utvecklare som både drivs av teknik och affär.


Med tanke på hur snabbt dagens teknik förändras så tror vi att du är nyfiken, öppen för att utforska nya arbetssätt och gillar att ständigt utvecklas. Här hade vi kunnat fylla på med många buzzwords, men vi tror att du har jobbat med .Net i dina senaste projekt. Har du en dragning mot DevOps eller Cloud så är det ett intressant plus! Vi tror att du som utvecklare är AI\-assisted i ditt arbete, vilket för oss innebär att du använder dig av AI i ditt dagliga arbete för att jobba smartare. För oss handlar det om att utvärdera hjälpmedel och verktyg för att ge kunden en skarpare leverans, inte bara att springa på nästa trendiga tjänst.


Att drivas av affären som konsult innebär för oss att använda din kommunikativa och relationsskapande kompetens för att på djupet förstå kundens behov. Vi tror att det är viktigt för att kunna skapa värde hos kunden, både direkt när du är på plats, men även för att skapa något som håller i längden och för framtiden.


Som Senior Backend\-utvecklare med .Net\-kompetens får du ofta en ledande roll i teamet, till exempel som Tech Lead eller Senior Utvecklare. Det innebär att du både bidrar tekniskt och stöttar andra i teamet – men också att du är med och skapar lösningar som håller över tid.


Om du är en person som vill kombinera dina soft skills med din tekniska expertis, då är vi rätt plats för dig!


#### **Det här är Crowd Collective**


Vi är fokuserade på utveckling (Backend/Fullstack) samt Data (Engineering, Science, ML och BI), givetvis med sikte på moderna tekniker, utvecklingen inom AI och kunskapsdelning. Våra projekt och uppdrag är varierande, både utifrån längd och bransch. Några av våra kunder bygger just nu e\-handelsplattformar, e\-learning\-lösningar, teknik för självkörande bilar och spelupplevelser.


Det här låter kanske som det du brukar höra från konsultbolag. Det som däremot gör oss annorlunda är vår organisering i Crowds. Det är mindre grupper av kollegor som regelbundet ses för att dela kunskap, bolla idéer och hjälpas åt med utmaningar vi stöter på i vardagen. Här finns det alltid någon att fråga, resonera med eller bara få ett nytt perspektiv från någon i en liknande sits.


Tanken med våra Crowds är enkel – du ska aldrig känna att du står ensam i din leverans. Du har ett gäng kollegor i ryggen som stöttar, utmanar och inspirerar, oavsett vilket uppdrag du sitter i. Och du är en viktig del i det själv också – din erfarenhet och dina insikter gör skillnad för dina kollegor. Antingen genom din coachande approach när en kollega söker stöd, eller mer strukturerat i form av mentorskap internt på Crowd Collective. Vår coachande attityd och ambition tar vi givetvis med oss ut till kunderna, där vi flera gånger byggt upp team med juniora medarbetare och coachat dem till självgående utvecklare.  

  



#### **Det här erbjuder vi dig**


Du kan räkna med starkt pensionspaket, 5000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag, tekniken du behöver, föräldralön, mentorskap och 6 veckors semester. Utöver det har du möjlighet att bli delägare hos oss, något vi gärna berättar mer om!


Nyfiken på att veta mer? Skicka in din ansökan så hör vi av oss så snart vi kan!

jobs.description:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world's most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI\-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.



At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

##### **As a Staff Frontend Engineer at Gong, you will...**


* Be a major part of Gong's Frontend guild with Frontend developers from all the teams in the company.
* Tackle hard technical problems—some at the architecture level, some at the code level, some at the product level—and come up with solutions, balancing practicality and innovation, short and long term.
* Be the owner of the features you develop, while collaborating with product and UX teams from thinking and wireframes processes to production.
* Be part of our known architecture huddles when we make future decisions about our code and best practices.
* Constantly learn new things \- join professional lectures and workshops organized by Gong. In addition, each developer gets extra learning time on behalf of Gong to gain or improve new professional skills.
* Be a part of a successful startup technology team that translates our vision into a solid SaaS product that performs, scales, is easy to use, and makes a big impact.

##### **You should apply if you are...**


* A software engineer between 8\+ years of industry experience developing web applications.
* Someone who enjoys having responsibility and a sense of ownership of the product you are creating.
* Deeply knowledgeable of how JavaScript works and experienced with React **(a must!)**.
* Familiarity with backend languages such as Java, Node.js, C\#, and others is an advantage.
* Experienced with large scale, cloud\-based web applications.
* Proven experience in the architecture of design systems and components.
* Preferably someone with a degree in computer science or similar discipline.
* An all\-around player, fast\-learner and self\-motivated individual.
* An excellent communicator and team player, with strong verbal and written skills in English.
* Most importantly, a person who enjoys working independently and within a team of highly skilled peers.

##### **What makes Engineering at Gong unique?**



Here at Gong, we trust and empower our employees with ownership to solve complex problems, make the right decisions, and build the best products that create radical impact. We call this "Own. Solve. Impact." For our engineers, it means it's not just about writing code. You are involved and able to influence the entire process to create the best product. If you are curious to discover Gong's wonderful and challenging world, what are you waiting for? Don't delay \- fill in your application details. Who knows, maybe there's a Gongster in you!


##### **Perks \& Benefits**


* We offer Gongsters a variety of private health insurance plans, designed to fit you and your family's needs.
* Wellbeing Fund \- flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.
* Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.
* Education \& learning stipend for personal growth and development.
* Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work\-life blend.
* Paid parental leave to support you and your family.
* Company\-wide recharge days each quarter.

##### **About us**



Gong empowers everyone in revenue teams to improve productivity, increase predictability, and drive revenue growth by deeply understanding customers and business trends; driving impactful decisions and actions. The Gong Revenue AI Platform captures and contextualizes customer interactions, surfaces insights and predictions, and powers actions and workflows that are essential for business success. More than 4,500 companies around the world rely on Gong to unlock their revenue potential. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 29 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title** AI Engineer

**Department** Asset Management Platforms

**Location**Dublin

**Reports To**Head of Research, AMP

**Level** 6


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.


As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.

**About your role**  

The AI Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining and delivering AI\-enabled software engineering capabilities across Asset Management Platforms (AMP). The role combines enterprise AI strategy, software engineering leadership, and practical adoption of AI\-assisted development to improve productivity, quality, and speed of delivery while maintaining Fidelity's standards for architecture, security, governance, and software quality.


This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Strategy \& Platform Leadership**

* Define the technical vision, architecture, and operating model for AI\-enabled engineering across AMP.
* Establish enterprise standards, reference architectures, and governance frameworks for AI, Generative AI, AI agents, and AI\-assisted software development.
* Lead decisions relating to model strategy, orchestration, retrieval architecture, and multi\-model AI adoption.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business and engineering value.

**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering practices across development teams.
* Develop reusable patterns, workflows, prompts, and accelerators.
* Coach engineers in the effective use of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and other AI development assistants.
* Establish standards for AI\-generated code, quality assurance, security, and responsible AI usage.

**Software Engineering \& Architecture**

* Design and deliver modern, scalable software solutions supporting Fidelity's investment platforms.
* Champion engineering best practices across architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, and automation.
* Support technical design decisions and guide teams through complex engineering challenges.
* Contribute to engineering strategy, roadmaps, and architecture governance.

**Stakeholder Leadership**

* Partner with Engineering Leads, Architects, Product Owners, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI\-driven improvement.
* Build communities of practice and promote knowledge sharing across engineering teams.
* Communicate AI strategy and engineering outcomes to technical and business audiences.

**About you**


We're looking for an experienced software engineer who has designed and delivered production Generative AI/LLM solutions.

**Essential Experience**

* Experience in software engineering, architecture, or technical leadership roles.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise\-scale software solutions and leading engineering transformation initiatives.
* Strong experience with Agile delivery, CI/CD, DevSecOps, engineering governance, and secure software development.
* Hands\-on experience with AI engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of RAG, retrieval, embeddings/vector search, agents and agentic workflows, MCP/tool integration, prompt/context engineering, model orchestration and AI evaluation.
* Strong software engineering background across modern programming languages, cloud platforms, APIs, containers, automation, and observability.
* Ability to balance innovation with risk management, governance, and regulatory requirements.


Experience within Asset Management, Investment Management, or Financial Services environments is preferred.

**Technical Skills**


Experience with many of the following technologies and practices:

* Java, Python, C\#, TypeScript or similar modern programming languages
* Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)
* Containerisation technologies including Docker and Kubernetes
* Git\-based source control and collaborative development workflows
* REST APIs and event\-driven architectures
* CI/CD tooling
* Test automation frameworks
* Infrastructure as Code
* Observability and monitoring platforms
* Enterprise architecture principles

**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with strong technical depth.
* Passionate about engineering excellence and emerging technologies.
* Strong coaching, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and delivery focused.
* Comfortable operating across both business and technology domains

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

**Summary / Objective**


The Software Development Engineer in Test I (entry level) will have the opportunity to build hands\-on experience working alongside experienced Quality Assurance and Engineering team members to help conceive, design and develop our AWS based registry platform by developing, executing and maintaining software \& frameworks to test the registry platform


This role reports to the Director, Quality Assurance.


**What You’ll Do**


* Develop and maintain automated tests in C\# for new and existing product features, with guidance from experienced SDETs
* Works with senior SDETs to enhance our existing automation framework which is written in C\#
* Writes data driven back\-end tests using relational \& non\-relational database methods from the automation framework
* Works with more senior automation engineers to understand features and design documents
* Derives automated \& manual tests from specifications and development design documents
* Assists with deploying environments using cloud platforms such as AWS via Azure DevOps
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance Engineers and software engineers as part of an Agile development team on automation tests in C\#
* Build knowledge of our registry platform to understand the different modules and how they interact with each other
* Learn to configure and maintain automated tests within our TeamCity continuous integration environment
* Understands requirement documents for the purpose of writing test cases
* Maintains work items (bugs, test plans and estimates) to reflect the work accomplished
* Actively models and promotes Identity Digital’s core values through day\-to\-day interactions, behaviors, and decision\-making
* Other duties as assigned


**Who You Are / What You Bring**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience
* 0–1 years of experience in software development, software testing, test automation, or a related technical area
	+ Recent graduates are encouraged to apply; relevant internships, co\-ops, academic projects, personal projects, or similar experience will be considered
* Foundational experience with object\-oriented programming languages such as C\# or Java, gained through coursework, internships, projects, or professional experience
* Familiarity with SQL queries and stored procedures white box testing (MS\-SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL)
* Familiarity automation testing of xml/Json API backend services
* Exposure to AI tools and concepts in software testing, with a keen interest in leveraging AI to enhance QA efficiency, test design, and automated QA code generation
* Exposure to cloud technologies is a plus
* Strong communication, collaboration, reporting, analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and systems
* Displays a passion for technology and software quality
* Ability to work outside core business hours as needed
* Ability to travel as needed
* Ability to work across time zones as part of a global organization as needed
* Reliable transportation to the workplace


**Physical Requirements**


* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times


**Location:**


* 36 Dame Street, Dublin 2, D02 K7K5 (hybrid)


**Salary Range**


The base salary range for this full\-time position is €55,000 \- €65,000 (flexibility based on experience) plus additional benefits. In addition, the successful candidate will be eligible to receive other compensation from time to time in the form of discretionary and/or nondiscretionary bonuses and long\-term incentive plan. Actual compensation will be influenced by a candidate’s qualifications, internal employee equity considerations, and location. We will not ask for information about a candidate's current or past compensation for purposes of developing an offer of employment.


Note: Benefits programs are subject to eligibility requirements and may vary in certain locations.


**A few things to know about us**


Identity Digital is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or any other category prohibited by local, state or federal law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, placement, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, social and recreational activities, and termination.


**Background Check Statement**


At the time of an offer, you will be required to complete a background check. Any offer is contingent upon a satisfactory background check.


**Sponsorship Statement**


Please note that work sponsorship for this position may not be available now or in the future. While we strive to support our candidates, not all roles will qualify. Eligibility will be reviewed on a case\-by\-case basis.


**Accommodation Statement**


We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Identity Digital will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact our Recruiting Team at careers@identity.digital.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M\-KOPA Mobility, our fast\-growing e\-mobility business.** **This is an initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event\-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.**

**The Impact** – Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e\-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering:** Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership


**Global recognition:** Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges:** Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year\-on\-year, with over 11,000 e\-motorbikes financed and demand climbing


**Real climate impact:** Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e\-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event\-driven microservices with real\-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end\-to\-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting\-edge .NET development with purpose\-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

**Technical Environment**

* **Languages \& frameworks:** C\#/.NET
* **Cloud:** We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
* **Architecture:** Event\-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* **Infrastructure:** Kubernetes, Docker
* **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana
* **Engineering culture:** DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery
* **AI tooling:** We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow

**Our Engineering Approach**

As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

* High quality output
* Observability and monitoring
* Automated testing in all environments, including production
* Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

**What You Need**


We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first\-order concerns in development.


Required Experience:

* Strong grasp of C\# .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* Microservices architecture experience
* Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
* Testing and deployment expertise
* DevOps culture mindset
* Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

**Location \& Benefits**

* Initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role
* Fully remote role within UTC \-1 to UTC \+3 time zones
* Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission** We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model, with M\-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

* **Connected :** 6 million smartphone customers, 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users
* **Prosperous :** 70% of customers use their M\-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000\+ livelihoods created for agents
* **Green :** 11,000\+ e\-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year\-on\-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

**Ready to build C\# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern backend engineering?**

**At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritise well\-being, and embrace flexibility.**

**Apply now to join our mission of transforming lives across Africa through technology.**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026\), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 \& 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e\-bikes financed in Kenya.*

***Important Notice***  

  

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

*If your application is successful M\-KOPA undertakes pre\-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references.*

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer II, Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to join our team. We build and operate the network and services that enable Amazon Fulfillment Centers, Middle and Last Mile facilities, including Air hubs, and PrimeNow to deliver packages to Amazon retail customers. From two million square foot automated robotics fulfillment centers to small last\-mile delivery stations in emerging markets, these networks are the backbone of Amazon Operations. Hundreds of thousands of associates rely upon these networks at thousands of locations, and are critical to the delivery of shipments to Amazon retail customers.  

  

Our mission is to design, deploy, and enable networks that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security and cost, enabling Fulfillment and Logistic operations to deliver on time, every customer order. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to create next\-generation network products. The team is focused on creating in\-house networks from leveraging open source tools and projects. We partner closely with IT support teams to ensure that simplicity in our product designs translate to operational readiness in the field. Information security rigor is at the core of everything we do. You will tackle complex, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. It is expected that you will be technically pioneering, while at the same time being balanced and pragmatic in your approach. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot and make a positive impact on millions of people.  

  

The right candidate will have demonstrated experience leading large projects and have an expert level technical background in current networking technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or multiple priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high\-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will anticipate bottlenecks, influence external vendors and internal team roadmaps, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Development Engineer you will be expected to:  

* Write code for our most demanding, cross\-functional networking projects.
* Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight\-forward solutions.
* Fully and completely comprehend system inter\-connections and limitations.
* Effectively research and benchmark Amazon technology against other systems in the industry.
* Contribute intellectual property through patents.
* Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.

  

A day in the life  

You will partner with Network, Software and Systems development Engineers to deliver automation for building and decommissioning the network infrastructure. Additionally create new tools or improve existing ones for network operators.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with networking fundamentals including hands\-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
* Experience working in an Agile environment

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** Oslo (NO) / Hybrid
  

**Department:** Development
  

**Reports to:** Development Manager  

  



**Why Join Us?**


Welcome to Aptic, where innovative technology meets sustainable software development.


We develop advanced fintech solutions used by banks, finance companies, and e\-commerce businesses across Europe. We are now looking for a **Full\-Stack Machine Learning Engineer** to take ownership of one of our machine learning solutions and help shape the next generation of AI\-powered capabilities within Aptic. You will be part of a small team giving you large impact on solution design and work processes.


Initially, you will revive, enhance, and transition to live production an ML platform, working across machine learning, LLMs, backend development, integrations, and frontend technology. Over time, you will also contribute to broader AI initiatives and product development within Aptic. This gives you the opportunity to build deep expertise in one solution while maintaining flexibility to grow into new technical challenges and products.

**What** you'll do


As a Full\-Stack ML Engineer, you will transition to live production and take end\-to\-end ownership of an ML solution and ensure it continues to evolve, perform, and create value.

* Improve existing machine learning models with measurable gains in accuracy, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy new features across backend, AI/ML, and frontend layers.
* Design and implement APIs and integrations with internal and external systems.
* Collaborate with internal experts to rebuild knowledge, processes, and infrastructure.
* Write automated tests and verification scripts for the solution.
* Create, run, maintain on the build and deploy pipelines
* Produce high\-quality technical documentation and knowledge\-sharing material
* Support AI initiatives across the company when needed.
* Contribute to Aptic products and development teams as business needs to evolve.

 **What** you'll bring

* Experience in designing, developing, and optimizing predictive models using machine learning and deep learning techniques.
* Experience in training, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring neural network models in production environments.
* Solid understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices.
* Understanding of integration patterns and data pipelines.
* Experience with SQL Server or similar relational databases.
* Experience with development in Python, C\# and frontend Javascript based frameworks like React.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Working knowledge of Norwegian is an advantage
* Knowledge about financial papers valuation an advantage

**What’s In It** For You?

* Competitive salary based on experience and background.
* 25 paid vacation days per year.
* Hybrid working model and great office locations.
* Wellness budget and pension program.
* A culture built on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Plenty of opportunities to influence direction and drive meaningful change.
* A stable workplace that values work/life balance.

 **Ready to Apply?**


Sounds like you? Apply in minutes—no cover letter required. We can’t wait to meet you!

**About us**


Aptic AB is a fast growing fintech company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. We deliver advanced solutions across BNPL, ledger services, factoring, lending, leasing, and debt collection. Our CLVR platform is trusted by major players such as Profina, Kredinor, and Lowell.


Our culture is rooted in technical excellence, innovation, and deep customer focus.
