jobs.title: Software developer
jobs.description:
Etsimme **Sovelluskehittäjää** vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

**Sijainti:** Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

#### **Vastuualueet:**


Sovelluskehittäjänä:

* Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
* Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
* Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI\-suunnittelijat.
* Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
* Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

#### **Kenen kanssa työskentelet?**


Työskentelet osana *T*woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.


Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

#### **Odotamme sinulta:**

* Vähintään **3 vuoden kokemus**.
* Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: **C\#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript**.
* Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten **PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle**.
* Pilviosaamista: **Azure tai AWS**.
* Kokemusta **mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista** ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
* Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
* Englannin kielen osaaminen.
* Olet oma\-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
* Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
* Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
* Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
* Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
* Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
* Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

#### **Katsomme eduksi**


Jos sinulla on kokemusta jostain seuraavista osaamisista:

* Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
* Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
* Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
* Integraatioista.
* Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
* Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
* Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.


Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can\-do \-asenteella.

#### **Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?**


Ensimmäisen kuuden kuukauden tavoitteesi kiteytettynä:

* Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.
* Olet päässyt hyvin osaksi työyhteisöä ja osoittautunut loistavaksi lisäksi tiimiimme.
* Olet sisäistänyt asiakkaan toimialan ja perehtynyt sisään hankkeeseen.
* Osaamisesi on osoittautunut relevantiksi asiakasprojekteissamme.


Auttaaksemme sinua menestymään, tarjoamme sinulle perehdytysohjelman, koulutuksia, sertifikaatteja sekä työyhteisön, joka omalla osaamisellaan ja tekemisellään tukee työssä oppimistasi ja urakehitystäsi. Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

#### **Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?**


Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

##### **Etuihimme kuuluu:**

* **Markkinatasoinen työsuhde\-etujen paketti sisältäen:**


	+ Lounas ja virike\-etu
	+ Työterveyshuolto
	+ Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
	+ Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi
* **Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:**


	+ Online\-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
	+ Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
	+ Koulutukset ja community\-tapaamiset
	+ Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)
* **Paljon vapaa\-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:**


	+ Koko firman tapahtumat
	+ Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
	+ Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e\-urheilu, padel.

#### **Tehtävään hakeminen:**


Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn\-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!


Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

**Onko sinulla kysymyksiä,** esimerkiksi hakemukseen tai toimiston esteettömyyteen liittyen, joihin toivoisit meidän vastaavan ennen hakemuksen jättämistä?


Voit ottaa yhteyttä rekrytointitiimiimme careers.fi@twoday.com ja palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian vastausten kera.


Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

#### **Työskentely Twodaylla**


Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.


Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia\- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi\- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.


Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

#### **Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus**


Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

#### **Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?**


Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

jobs.title: PhD Position(s) in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a regenerative built environment to apply for one or more PhD positions in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture. The position(s) is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.  



**Scope of the work**

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the research will develop architectural interfaces that support the establishment and growth of living systems, particularly photosynthetic communities, as a strategy for regenerative architecture. The focus is on enveloping surfaces in the built environment.


The project will focus on designing, testing and demonstrating, at architectural scale, porous mineral interfaces combined with hydrogels. Computational design, fabrication and environmental monitoring will be combined with cultivation experiments and biological assessment, targeting mosses, algae and cyanobacteria in collaboration with partner researchers in biology.


We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:


* **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing:** exploring how architectural geometry, material composition and 3D printing can create bioreceptive interfaces. The work will combine computational design, printable material development, toolpath generation and robot programming to develop porous mineral interfaces informed by biological requirements.
* **Living Material Design and Biological Performance:** developing hydrogels incorporating living organisms for integration into porous mineral interfaces. The work will combine formulation, cultivation, sensors, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, biological growth, photosynthetic activity and material performance.

Both profiles require an interest in integrating biological systems and processes into architectural design and construction. The successful candidate(s) will collaborate within the team to develop and validate the resulting interfaces.


The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through teaching, workshops and co\-supervision of student projects.  



**Focus Area and Research Project**

The research will investigate how material composition, porous morphologies and hygrothermal dynamics can support biological establishment and environmental performance, while addressing durability, maintenance and integration into building envelopes. Environmental measurements will help establish relationships between interface design, climatic exposure, biological development and performance.


The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:


* Computational design of bioreceptive mineral interfaces for enveloping surfaces in the built environment
* Development and characterisation of printable mineral materials
* Robotic 3D printing, toolpath generation and fabrication process development
* Formulation of hydrogels incorporating living organisms and their integration into printed scaffolds
* Cultivation experiments and assessment of biological growth and photosynthetic activity
* Sensor integration, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, ecological and microclimatic performance
Fabrication and evaluation of full\-scale architectural demonstrators, addressing durability, maintenance and sustained biological growth  
* 

**About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment**

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.


Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.


SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten\-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2\. The programme provides a long\-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.  



**Responsibilities**

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory\-based investigations. Responsibilities include:


* Conducting high\-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes
* Conducting fabrication experiments and biological and environmental performance testing, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile
* Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks
* Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities
* Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co\-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research\-related activities
* Disseminating research results through high\-impact peer\-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences
* Sharing research outcomes through curated and high\-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions
* Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities
* Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network
* Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.  



**Candidate Requirements**

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, computational design, civil or architectural engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, biology, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing** or **Living Material Design and Biological Performance** , and the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities. Interdisciplinary experience connecting these areas is particularly valued.


Candidates must demonstrate:


* Documented interest and foundational knowledge in bioreceptive design, living system integration or related research areas
* Competence in Grasshopper and Rhino, advanced for the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile and at working level for the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile, together with relevant programming skills such as Python or C\#
* For the **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile:** practical experience in computational design, toolpath generation and robotic 3D printing, together with an understanding of biological requirements relevant to design; experience developing porous geometries and printable mineral materials are particularly valued
* For the **Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile:** practical experience in material formulation and biological experimentation or cultivation, together with competence in experimental measurement and data analysis; experience with hydrogels, sensor integration, automated monitoring or hygrothermal characterisation are particularly valued
* Hands\-on laboratory experience, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile
* Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer\-reviewed publication
* Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral
* Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily
* Strong communication skills across graphical, written and oral formats
A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer\-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively  
* 

**Contact information**

For further information about the position(s) and SDU CREATE’s activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk . For additional information on the Centre’s work, visit the website at www.create\-sdu.com .


If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support .  



**Application Procedure**

Applicants are advised to carefully read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and how to apply for academic staff before submitting their application. The application must be submitted in English and include the following documents, uploaded in the specified order as PDF files:


* Completed TEK PhD application form for 5\+3 applicants. The form is available on the Faculty website .
* Motivation letter and research statement, with a maximum combined length of five pages. The document should clearly describe the applicant’s proposed research direction and qualifications for the position and indicate their primary research profile.
* Detailed curriculum vitae, including academic and professional experience, research projects, teaching and supervision experience, awards, exhibitions, and computational and fabrication skills.
* List of publications, if applicable, including copies of publications the applicant wishes the committee to assess.
* Verified copies of official bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and academic transcripts, provided in Danish or accompanied by an official English translation. Applicants currently enrolled in a master’s programme must include a statement indicating their expected completion date.
* Completed TEK PhD form for calculating grade point average. The form is available on the Faculty website .
* Official documentation describing the educational structure and grading system of the awarding institution, if the degree was obtained outside Denmark.
* Portfolio of up to 15 pages presenting selected research, teaching, or professional projects.
* Contact details for at least two referees, including their names and email addresses. The referees may be contacted during the selection process.
All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF\-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.


SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).  



**The application deadline is 15 October, 2026,** at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  



**The assessment and selection process**

Read about the Assessment and selection process . An assessment committee will evaluate applications. Shortlisting may be applied. Only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the process.  



**Enrolment and employment terms**

Applicants must have a master’s degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree at the time of enrolment and employment. Employment as a PhD fellow is a 3\-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37\.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. Salary and employment conditions are governed by the applicable collective agreement and the Protocol on PhD Research Fellows.


Employment is conditional upon approval for admission by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order) . Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).


Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender\-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.


Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self\-organizer”.  



The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).


Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.


Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: DevEx Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!**

We’re looking for a **DevEx Engineer** to join our **Empower platform squad “Taycan”**. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.



The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.



As our new **DevEx Engineer**, you’ll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you’ll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.



You’ll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.



Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.



Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.



We foster a developer\-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You’ll have access to modern AI\-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.


**Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will**


* Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
* Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
* Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
* Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults


**The need\-to\-have**

* Strong engineering experience in .NET / C\#.
* Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3\) and infrastructure\-as\-code (CDK/Terraform).
* Familiarity with microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed\-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
* Hands\-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.


**The nice\-to\-have skills**


* Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
* Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
* Hands\-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
* Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.


We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!


**About AutoProff**



AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.



in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan\-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B\-B2B\-B2C dealing solution for used cars.



At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used\-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.



We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.


With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure)
jobs.description:
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software\-as\-a\-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high\-performance computing calculation engine in the back\-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry\-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.  



We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.  



**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end\-users to deliver high\-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
* Contribute across the entire development lifecycle \- from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
* Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
* Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.

You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.  

* 

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Solid knowledge of C\#, .NET Core/Framework, and object\-oriented design principles.
* Experience with APIs.
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk\-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
* Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
* You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
* Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance \& attribution and investment\-related instruments.
* You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
* You are enthusiastic about building state\-of\-the\-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
* Curiosity and adaptability to learn in\-house tools and frameworks \- including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
* You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non\-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
* You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.

If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.  

* 

**WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK HERE**

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3\-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.  



* **Global hybrid work policy** \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* **Growth and** **innovation** \- Every 6 th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* **Self\- Direction** \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Pension and health benefits and bonus
* **Work\-life balance** – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
* **Empowerment** – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes
**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp , we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.


**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations , professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Energy Billing
jobs.description:
#### **About Reel**

  

We are rethinking electricity to accelerate the transition to a carbon\-free energy system.


Electricity is one of the biggest sources of carbon emissions globally, yet most green power sold on the market today fails move the needle toward decarbonizing electricity production.


Reel empowers companies to move beyond climate commitments and achieve real\-world carbon reductions, by bridging the gap between renewable energy producers and consumers.


Join our mission\-driven, cross\-disciplinary team of developers, builders, and climate experts working to accelerate the transition to a net\-zero economy.

#### **How you can contribute**

  

We’re working with some of the most exciting technologies within energy, delivering renewable power to corporates and balancing production from asset owners. We’re optimizing solar parks, wind farms, and grid\-scale batteries, trading across different markets and providing ancillary services to help stabilize the grid.


At the end of each month, we’re condensing all of this activity into a few numbers on an invoice for each of our customers. That’s only possible with a strong, purpose\-built energy billing platform.


As our new Software Engineer for billing, you’ll own and grow our next\-generation energy billing platform. You’ll work closely with Christian, our CTO, the rest of the engineering team, and our electricity operations team.

#### **What your role will look like**


These are some (not all) of the things you will be working on:

* **Own our energy billing tech:** Lead the work on continually improving and expanding our billing platform to serve new products, collaborating closely with engineering colleagues.
* **Expand into new markets:** Every market has its own rules, data, and (more often than not) quirks we need to adapt to. You’ll build the integrations that allow us to serve new markets, building on top of the platform we have today.
* **Energy analytics**: Structure and expand our financial data for accurate and up\-to\-date customer analytics and reporting.
* **Build the tools our team runs on**: Our electricity operations team settles all of our customers every month. Build the tooling that gives them the full picture, catches anything that looks off, and makes their workflow as automated as possible.
* **Raise the bar and help set the direction:** Perform code reviews, share feedback with colleagues, contribute to key technical decisions, and be a core member of the team shaping how our tech evolves.

#### **We think you will thrive in this role if**


You have shipped production software and know how to get things done. You take real ownership of your work and have a bias for shipping. You don't need to know anything about energy today or have years of experience with energy billing \- what matters most is that you're eager to learn and ready to put in the work.


You might also recognise yourself in some of these:

* You have solid experience building and maintaining backend systems in production.
* You have worked with billing, payments, settlement or other financial systems.
* You are comfortable being the person who cares whether a number is right.
* You care deeply about building reliable, scalable systems, while shipping frequently.
* You default to simple, pragmatic solutions.
* You work well independently, make decisions with confidence, and know when to bring others in.
* You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others level up.
* You are curious about how AI tools can help us ship better software as a team.


We work in Elixir and Python. We're hosted on GCP, use Kubernetes, data in Postgres w. TimescaleDB and BigQuery, and observability using Loki, Prometheus, and Grafana. We strive to keep our infrastructure as code with tools like Terraform and ArgoCD. Experience in this specific stack is by no means a requirement.


Please note that we are located in Copenhagen, Denmark and this is an in\-office role with flexibility for occasional hybrid work.

#### **Working at Reel**


At Reel, we care deeply about our people. We offer a workplace that values initiative, ownership and kindness, with ample room for personal and professional growth. We believe great teams are built by welcoming people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences.


You will join a tight\-knit team on an ambitious journey, where the impact of your role will be visible and recognisable on a daily basis. Every colleague \- from founders to student assistants \- are in this together. We cherish focus and autonomy just as much as team work and setting time aside for having fun together \- at our monthly socials, bi\-annual offsites and daily coffee chats in our bright and spacious office in central Copenhagen, 2 minutes from the metro.


Read more about working at Reel at our Careers page.

#### **What we offer you**


At Reel, we offer you an organisation that cares as much for its people as for the climate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where your personal growth and well\-being is imperative.

* **Compensation:** A healthy base salary \+ warrant programme
* **Vacation:** 30 days (5 weeks \+ 1\) of paid holidays to recharge
* **Pension:** Employer\-supported pension scheme, including health insurance
* **Parental leave:** A generous parental leave policy
* **Equipment:** Choose your preferred IT setup (Mac, Windows, etc.) with a budget of 25,000 DKK
* **Office:** A vibrant office\-first culture in central Copenhagen with a flexible remote work policy
* **Lunch:** A delicious lunch at the office every day — and your daily caffeine fix from our espresso machine

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **About Reel**

  

We are rethinking electricity to accelerate the transition to a carbon\-free energy system.


Electricity is one of the biggest sources of carbon emissions globally, yet most green power sold on the market today fails move the needle toward decarbonizing electricity production.


Reel empowers companies to move beyond climate commitments and achieve real\-world carbon reductions, by bridging the gap between renewable energy producers and consumers.


Join our mission\-driven, cross\-disciplinary team of developers, builders, and climate experts working to accelerate the transition to a net\-zero economy.

#### **How you can contribute**

  

As our new Senior Software Engineer, you will be directly helping companies achieve lower electricity costs and drive real climate impact. You will work closely with Christian, our CTO, and the rest of the engineering and product team to build the software powering the renewable energy transition.

#### **What your role will look like**


These are some (not all) of the things you will be working on:

* **Build and maintain key backend systems:** From our electricity billing engine handling accurate and on\-time billing, to leading the technical work for entering new markets.
* **Build the data backbone of our platform:** Design and maintain the pipelines and backend systems that ingest, process, and serve large amounts of real\-time energy data reliably and at scale.
* **Build for scale:** We are growing fast \- in volume under management and geographically \- and you will be part of building the infrastructure to support that growth.
* **Ship user\-facing features with real impact:** Contribute to the analytics and platform tools our customers rely on daily to understand their consumption, production, and emissions.
* **Raise the bar and help set the direction:** Perform code reviews, share feedback with colleagues, contribute to key technical decisions, and be a core member of the team shaping how our tech evolves.

#### **We think you will thrive in this role if**


You have shipped a lot of production software and know how to get things done. You take real ownership of your work and have a bias for shipping. You don't need to know anything about energy today \- but you'll be curious to learn. You might also recognise yourself in some of these:

* You have solid experience building and maintaining backend systems in production.
* You enjoy taking projects from idea to shipped, and like to ship often.
* You care deeply about reliability and want to stay close to production.
* You default to simple, pragmatic solutions.
* You work well independently, make decisions with confidence, and know when to bring others in.
* You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others level up.
* Curious about how AI tools can help us ship better software as a team.


We work in Elixir, using the Phoenix framework and LiveView \+ TypeScript for the front\-end. We use Python for ML and trading. We're hosted on GCP, data in Postgres w. TimeScale and BigQuery. Experience in this stack is by no means a requirement \- several engineers on the team today had no prior experience in Elixir.


Please note that we are located in Copenhagen, Denmark and this is an in\-office role with flexibility for hybrid work.

#### **Working at Reel**


At Reel, we care deeply about our people. We offer a workplace that values initiative, ownership and kindness, with ample room for personal and professional growth. We believe great teams are built by welcoming people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences.


You will join a tight\-knit team on an ambitious journey, where the impact of your role will be visible and recognisable on a daily basis. Every colleague \- from founders to student assistants \- are in this together. We cherish focus and autonomy just as much as team work and setting time aside for having fun together \- at our monthly socials, bi\-annual offsites and daily coffee chats in our bright and spacious office in central Copenhagen, 2 minutes from the metro.


Read more about working at Reel at our Careers page.

#### **What we offer you**


At Reel, we offer you an organisation that cares as much for its people as for the climate. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where your personal growth and well\-being is imperative.

* **Compensation:** A healthy base salary \+ warrant programme
* **Vacation:** 30 days (5 weeks \+ 1\) of paid holidays to recharge
* **Pension:** Employer\-supported pension scheme, including health insurance
* **Parental leave:** A generous parental leave policy
* **Equipment:** Choose your preferred IT setup (Mac, Windows, etc.) with a budget of 25,000 DKK
* **Office:** A vibrant office\-first culture in central Copenhagen with a flexible remote work policy
* **Lunch:** A delicious lunch at the office every day — and your daily caffeine fix from our espresso machine
* **Socials:** Monthly social events and bi\-annual offsites where we have fun, unwind, and nurture our team spirit
* **Visa:** We try to support non\-EU residents by sponsoring visas whenever we can, but our ability to do so depends on the role

#### **Interested?**


We are very excited hearing from you. You can find more information about the interview process here.

*You don't feel like you fulfill all the criteria?*


We know that 'perfect' candidates do not exist. The only thing you need to ensure is that the problem we are solving at Reel is one you cannot wait to get out of bed for on Monday morning.

***We encourage all candidates, regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, etc. to apply.***

jobs.title: .net Developer
jobs.description:
*Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 technologies, we collaborate with the most admired private and public organizations to deliver cutting\-edge digital solutions. Our deep industry expertise spans Data \& AI, software development, digital experiences, and business applications. Operating across the Nordics and Lithuania, our team generated a revenue of 280 million euros in 2023\. We serve over 8,000 customers, supporting their digital transformation journeys.*

**Do you want to develop stable and socially impactful solutions in the public sector?**


We are looking for a .net Developer with at least three years of experience to join Twoday as a permanent employee, working as a consultant with a public sector client. You will become part of an agile development team where quality, reliability and professionalism are key – and where your solutions will make a real difference to citizens and employees.


At Twoday, you will be part of a strong professional community, while working closely with the client and their teams on a daily basis.

**Your responsibilities as a .net developer will include:**

* Developing and enhancing .net\-based backend solutions
* Implementing functionality in both existing and new systems
* Working with APIs, integrations and data access
* Writing structured, testable and maintainable code in C\#/.net
* Collaborating with frontend developers, architects and business stakeholders
* Participating in analysis, estimation and planning of development tasks
* Contributing to technical improvements, quality and best practices
* Continuous learning and knowledge sharing with more experienced colleagues

**Your qualifications**


Your educational background is less important – what matters is a solid technical foundation and a willingness to grow. We expect that you:

* Have at least three years of experience as a .net developer
* Have hands\-on experience with C\# and .net/.net Core
* Have worked with backend development, such as:
* ASP.net
* REST APIs
* Integrations with other systems
* Have a basic understanding of:


	+ Architecture principles
	+ Performance
	+ Security
* Work in a structured manner and take responsibility for the quality of your work
* Thrive in an agile environment and collaborate well within a team
* Are fluent in Danish, both spoken and written, as the working language is Danish


It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you also have experience with:

* Azure or other cloud platforms
* CI/CD and automated testing
* Public sector IT solutions

**Employment**


You will be employed by Twoday and work as a consultant for a public sector client. Twoday is your employer and provides a strong professional community, skills development and clear career paths – while you contribute daily to an important and meaningful project with the client.

**The process**

* Telephone interview with a Talent Acquisition Partner
* Teams interview with hiring manager
* Technical assessment
* Onsite interview with hiring manager

**About Twoday**


Twoday has modern offices in more than 30 locations across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Lithuania. We offer an engaging work environment with high professional standards and a strong sense of community. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally in an international and innovative organisation.

**Diversity \& Inclusion**


Don’t meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Twoday, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace, and we encourage you to apply if the role interests you – even if your experience does not match the job description perfectly.

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Build the enterprise platforms that power intelligent operations.  

  

Join Agilent's Global OT \& AI Engineering organization and help develop the cloud\-native platforms that connect enterprise systems, manufacturing operations, and intelligent digital solutions across Agilent's global operations.  

  

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, enterprise APIs, integration platforms, and cloud\-native applications that enable secure, reliable, and real\-time information exchange across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence.  

  

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Data Engineers, AI \& Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will develop the enterprise services that power digital products, operational analytics, AI applications, and connected manufacturing systems.  

  

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

**About Global OT \& AI Engineering**

  

Global OT \& AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.


Our organization combines software engineering, enterprise data platforms, Artificial Intelligence, industrial automation, cloud technologies, and Smart Factory solutions to build scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision\-making, and enable continuous improvement across global operations.


Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.


Our portfolio includes:

* Global Operations Control Tower
* Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
* AI \& Decision Intelligence Platform
* Smart Factory Applications
* Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
* Enterprise KPI Platform
* Digital Twin Solutions
* Manufacturing Data Exchange Platform
* AI\-powered Digital Coworkers

**About the Role**

  

Modern enterprise software depends on reliable, scalable, and secure platform services that connect business applications, operational technologies, enterprise systems, and cloud services into a unified digital ecosystem.


As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will build the backend capabilities that power Agilent's digital products. From enterprise APIs and integration services to cloud\-native microservices and event\-driven architectures, your work will provide the foundation that enables seamless communication between applications, data platforms, AI services, and manufacturing systems.


You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, improve system reliability, and support Agilent's long\-term digital transformation strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

 **Platform Services Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that support enterprise digital products.
* Build reusable APIs, microservices, and shared platform capabilities that accelerate software development across multiple applications.
* Develop secure and maintainable services that enable reliable communication between enterprise systems and operational platforms.
* Ensure platform services are scalable, resilient, and designed for long\-term maintainability.

**Enterprise Integration**

* Develop integration services connecting ERP, MES, PLM, Quality Systems, AI platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
* Design API\-first solutions that promote reuse and simplify system integration.
* Implement event\-driven and asynchronous communication patterns to improve scalability and responsiveness.
* Enable secure and efficient information exchange across enterprise and manufacturing environments.

**Cloud\-Native Engineering**

* Develop cloud\-native applications and services using modern architectural patterns.
* Support containerized deployments, automated testing, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).
* Optimize platform performance, reliability, scalability, and operational resilience.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities that improve platform health and operational support.

**Security \& Reliability**

* Apply secure software development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and API security standards.
* Support disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and high\-availability strategies.
* Continuously improve platform performance through proactive monitoring and optimization.

**Cross\-functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Application Experience Engineers to deliver end\-to\-end enterprise applications.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers to expose trusted enterprise data through secure services.
* Work with AI \& Data Scientists to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Support Smart Factory Engineers by enabling secure integration between operational technologies and enterprise applications.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and Agile delivery activities.

**Technology Environment**

  

You will have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

**Backend Development**

* .NET
* Python
* Node.js (preferred)

 **API \& Integration**

* REST APIs
* GraphQL (preferred)
* gRPC (preferred)
* OAuth 2\.0 / OpenID Connect

 **Cloud Platforms**

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS

 **Containers \& DevOps**

* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Azure DevOps
* GitHub Actions

 **Messaging \& Event Streaming**

* Apache Kafka
* Azure Event Hub
* RabbitMQ (preferred)

 **Databases**

* SQL Server
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* Redis (preferred)

 **Monitoring \& Observability**

* Azure Monitor
* Application Insights
* Grafana
* Prometheus (preferred)

**Qualifications**
------------------


We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.


You should have:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing backend applications, APIs, or enterprise software platforms.
* Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as C\#, Python, or Java.
* Understanding of API development, system integration, and relational databases.
* Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and distributed application architecture.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Passion for building scalable software platforms that enable enterprise digital transformation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:

* Cloud\-native application development (Azure or AWS)
* Microservices architecture
* Event\-driven architecture
* Container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
* Enterprise Integration Patterns
* CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Identity and Access Management (IAM)
* Manufacturing or industrial software platforms

**Leadership Competencies**

  

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

* Strong software engineering and systems design fundamentals.
* Passion for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable software platforms.
* Customer\-focused problem solving with a commitment to delivering business value.
* Excellent collaboration across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Curiosity to explore emerging technologies and modern engineering practices.
* Ability to balance technical excellence with pragmatic business outcomes.

**Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule.
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:** EU remote

#### **About the Role:**


As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise\-grade solutions for audiology clinic chains worldwide. You will shape integrations, domain boundaries, system design, and platform evolution across our SaaS product portfolio.

**Our tech stack** includes .NET, React ecosystem, Azure Servises (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database).


#### **What You Will Do:**

**Integration \& API Architecture:**

* Define and maintain Manage’s integration strategy (REST, Events, APIs, Data Feeds).
* Design standard integration patterns — real\-time (Event Hubs), on\-demand (REST), hybrid workflows.
* Lead technical workshops with customers and partners to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
* Align integrations with domain boundaries, data contracts, and platform security standards.
* Govern message contracts, event schemas, versioning strategy, and error\-handling models.
* Enforce security best practices (OAuth2, mTLS, Azure AD, Key Vault).
* Oversee monitoring, observability, and integration reliability (tracking, retries, DLQs).

**Domain \& System Architecture:**

* Serve as the technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates, and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross\-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high\-level design, technology selection, and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture, and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation, and ADRs.

**Platform \& Multi\-Tenancy:**

* Design and own the architecture of a secure, performant, and cost\-efficient multi\-tenancy model.
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture vision and support the evolution of the platform strategy.

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement:**

* Participate in pre\-sales work, technical scoping, and early\-stage solution shaping.
* Support troubleshooting and performance improvements for complex integrations or distributed system issues.

#### **What You Will Bring:**


Technical Skills \& Experience:

* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate architectural decisions to both leadership and engineering teams.
* Experience with integration architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, REST APIs, Webhooks).
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event\-driven architectures.**
* Solid understanding of **Domain\-Driven Design** and **Clean Architecture.**
* Proven ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation and diagrams (Miro, Lucid, C4, Event Catalog).
* Comfortable in customer\-facing technical discussions.
* Strong background in Azure Cloud services.
* Ability to enforce architectural standards through ADRs, reviews, and quality gates.
* Familiarity with governance, audit logging, and proactive system health monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with Product and Delivery teams to align architecture with the roadmap and business vision.
* Fluent English.


Preferred:

* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years in architecture roles within enterprise SaaS.
* Proven experience modernizing or commercializing legacy platforms into scalable, multi\-tenant products.
* Demonstrated success designing enterprise\-grade integrations.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.


Nice\-to\-Haves:

* Experience with MassTransit.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs, or agent\-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* Strong understanding of security and compliance for medical or regulated data (HIPAA, GDPR).
* .NET and React familiarity.


Key Traits:

* Strong leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to solve complex technical challenges and provide clear direction.
* A consistent focus on continuous learning — both personal and team\-wide.
* A mindset that promotes cross\-team alignment, technical excellence, and architectural consistency.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Long\-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company.
* High engineering and product standards.
* Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
* Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
* A global, diverse, and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA, and more.
* A culture that values personal growth as much as business outcomes.

Our global team of over 10,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.

To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.
  
  

Be part of the future of iGaming with 10,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.
  
  

ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  

Do you want to implement exciting, eye\-candy games, that perfectly complement the beautiful gaming studios we are building?
  
  

Do you want to control every aspect of the development process?
  
  

Do you want to do all the above, head to toe, with just a few colleagues, and be in full control of your time and the result?
  
  

If yes, look no further.
  
  

We are a large company, but this is a small new department. We are backed by ARRISE’s industry\-leading experts, allowing us to provide the next in iGaming experience, And we need you, a talented Senior or Intermediate Programmer, to further expand the small existing team we have put in place.
  
  

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
  
Discuss, clarify and understand the requested product
  
Write the code needed to implement the required product
  
When needed, be in touch with external teams and team members (artists, designers, directors and managers)
  
Communicate, work with and help your colleagues
  
Provide support for previous projects, when needed
  
WHAT WE ASK OF YOU
  
**Know at least one of the following programming languages:** C\+\+, C\#, Java, Javascript
  
Have a programmer mindset (logical skills; problem\-solving, solution\-finding: find specific solutions for specific problems, instead of using general approaches)
  
Work as part of an extended team (teamwork and team player)
  
6 Years \+ experience needed
  
C\# knowledge is a plus
  
Quality\-oriented mindset
  
English language is needed, as it is used in all external communication
  
Implement the required visual features (write shaders, implement animations, visual effects, etc.)
  
Provide technical solutions to obtaining the desired visual result
  
Work together with the artists to implement and obtain the expected visual quality
  
**Polish until everything looks awesome:** it needs to sparkle like Las Vegas!
  
Understanding masks, layering and how visuals mix together is a plus
  
WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE
  
Work as part of a small and efficient team
  
**Little overhead, low maintenance:** just focus on developing software
  
Work in a friendly, relaxed environment
  
**Highly\-experienced colleagues:** the other team members know how to handle everything; you can learn from them
  
Competitive salary
  
Complimentary lunch in the office
  
Health medical subscription to Regina Maria
  
Close proximity to “Muncii” subway station
  
Benefits

jobs.title: DEVELOPER L4
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** DEVELOPER L4
  
**City:** Istanbul
  
**State/Province:** Istanbul
  
**Posting Start Date:** 9/15/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** .NET .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to become our first dedicated internal QA professional and take ownership of quality across our products and services. This is a hands\-on, technical role with significant ownership. Our systems are primarily backend and API\-driven, so your focus will be on backend, API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing rather than simply testing the UI. You’ll work closely with developers and DevOps to understand how our systems work, identify risks early, investigate complex issues, improve test coverage, and ensure that releases are ready for production.

  

  

As our first dedicated QA hire, you’ll also have the opportunity to shape how QA is done across the company — from test strategy and automation to processes, tooling, and release quality. We’re looking for someone technical, pragmatic, and curious who enjoys going beyond the UI to investigate APIs, databases, logs, infrastructure, and real\-world system behavior.

  

  

**Your Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities:**


* Own and continuously improve our **QA strategy, processes, and testing approach**.
* Plan and execute **manual, exploratory, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end testing**.
* Test **REST APIs and end\-to\-end business flows** using Postman, cURL, or similar tools.
* Review requirements early and identify **risks, edge cases, ambiguities, and missing scenarios**.
* Define and maintain **test plans, regression coverage, and release criteria**.
* Build and maintain **automated regression and end\-to\-end tests** using Playwright or similar frameworks.
* Investigate and troubleshoot issues using **application logs, databases, metrics, and monitoring tools**.
* Work with **GCP and Azure** environments and cloud logging/monitoring tools.
* Use **SQL** to validate data and investigate issues, ideally with PostgreSQL.
* Collaborate closely with **developers and DevOps** on defects, environments, deployments, and technical investigations.
* Reproduce, isolate, document, and follow up on issues through to resolution.
* Provide **QA approval, risk assessment, and release readiness recommendations** for production releases.
* Help establish practical **QA standards, processes, and best practices** across the company.
  

  

**Skills We Cannot Do Without:**


* **3\+ years of QA experience** or equivalent senior\-level experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **backend/API, integration, manual, regression, and exploratory testing**.
* Experience owning **test strategy, test planning, regression coverage, and release readiness**.
* Strong experience testing **REST APIs and end\-to\-end business flows** using Postman, cURL, or similar tools.
* Ability to identify **risks, edge cases, and missing scenarios** during requirements and technical reviews.
* Experience building and maintaining **automated regression and end\-to\-end tests**, using Playwright or similar frameworks.
* Good **SQL skills**, ideally with PostgreSQL.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and experience working with **logs, databases, metrics, and monitoring tools**.
* Experience with **cloud environments, logging, and monitoring**, particularly GCP and Azure.
* Good understanding of **HTTP, REST, authentication, and distributed systems**.
* Programming/scripting experience, ideally with **JavaScript/TypeScript or similar**.
* Comfortable working closely with **developers and DevOps** on technical investigations and releases.
* Ability to make **QA approval and risk\-based release recommendations**.
* Strong communication skills in **Greek and English**.
  

  

**Nice to Have:**


* Experience with **Cloudflare, Elasticsearch**, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with **gRPC, Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, and VMs**.
* Experience with **performance/load testing** and basic security testing.
* Experience testing **mobile applications, cross\-browser compatibility, or web accessibility**.
* Experience with **physical devices, hardware\-integrated systems, or IoT**.
* Familiarity with **Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, or .NET** environments.

* As a Senior .NET \& Cloud Engineer, you will be responsible for:
* Designing, developing, and maintaining microservices\-based applications using .NET (C\#), Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) and much more
* Managing Kubernetes deployments, including Ingress NGINX and containerized applications with Docker
* Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform

* Strong knowledge of Azure services and DevOps tools
* Experience with microservices architecture and messaging systems
* Familiarity with networking concepts, VPNs, and certificate management

* A challenging and technical role within a specialized product team

* Opportunities for personal development and professional certification
