jobs.title: SAP Domain Architect Supply Chain Management (SCM)
jobs.description:
Ypto recherche de nouveaux collègues. Vous souhaitez renforcer nos équipes? Découvrez l'offre d'emploi ci\-dessous et postulez.

  

Please apply via the following link: https://ypto.recruitee.com/o/sap\-domain\-architect\-supply\-chain\-management\-scm


**Comment pouvez\-vous faire la différence ?**
----------------------------------------------

  

**About the shERPa Project**
  

NMBS is undergoing a company\-wide transformation through the shERPa program, implementing SAP S/4HANA as a greenfield solution. This program will standardize processes, improve operational efficiency, and enable digital transformation across all business units — including Supply Chain, Rolling Stock maintenance, Infrastructure and Operations.


**Quel est votre rôle à la SNCB ?**
-----------------------------------

  

**Job Purpose**


We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SAP Domain Architect Supply Chain Management (SCM) to define and lead the target architecture for NMBS’s end\-to\-end supply chain processes. This includes Demand en Supply Planning across all planning horizons (log\-, mid\- and short term), Inventory \& Warehouse Management, Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Logistics Execution, and the Maintenance Supply Chain — all in the unique context of NMBS responsible for safety\-critical materials, rolling stock availability, Finance, HR and Customer Relations.
  

You will design the future\-state SCM architecture on SAP S/4HANA, ensuring strong integration with Maintenance (PM), Finance, Engineering, and NMBS's depot logistics. You will guide complex transformations and support NMBS in building a resilient, transparent, and regulatory\-compliant supply chain.

  

This vacancy is for a payroll profile

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Define the S/4HANA SCM target architecture tailored to NMBS’s depot operations, rolling stock maintenance flows, critical spare parts management, and logistics constraints.
* Lead full lifecycle S/4HANA SCM implementations as Domain Architect.
* Own solution design for Inventory Management (IM), , Warehouse Management (Stock room management/EWM), Transportation Management (TM) and SAP Business Network for Supply Chain.
* Optional Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Manufacturing and integration with PM
  

Architecture integrations with all the relevant systems within SCM and S/4HANA
  

Model processes and enterprise capabilities with ADOIT or ARIS for governance and compliance.
* Lead workshops with senior stakeholders (Supply Chain, Rolling Stock, Infrastructure Engineering, Finance).
* Oversee the results of the delivery teams, validate design decisions, and ensure adherence to future\-state architecture.
* Guide integration supporting safety\-critical stocking policies, long lead\-time parts, multi\-depot inventory, and material traceability.
* Support project execution using ServiceNow, Jira, Xray, Cloud ALM and Solution Manager.
**Un job fait pour vous ?**
---------------------------

  

* The candidate demonstrates proficiency at CEFR level C1 or C2 in Dutch or French, and at least CEFR level B1 in English.
* The candidate has a minimum of **15 years of professional experience** in SAP Supply Chain Management including SAP MM (basic), Inventory Management (IM), Warehouse Management (WM or EWM), mobile warehouse solutions, automated warehousing solutions, Transportation Management, and integration with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM).
* The candidate has led at least **one full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA** implementation project in the role of Domain Architect, supported by evidence in the CV or project references.
* The candidate has professional experience in at least one asset\-intensive, logistics\-intensive, or regulated industry (e.g. rail, utilities, or MRO).
* The candidate demonstrates **professional experience** with SAP Ariba and/or supplier collaboration platforms.
* The candidate demonstrates **advanced professional experience** with the enterprise architecture tools ADOIT and/or ARIS.
* The candidate confirms availability to work onsite in Brussels (near Brussels\-Midi station) at least two days per week.
  

**Diversity Statement**


Everyone is unique. That's why we believe it’s important that you can be yourself — It makes SNCB stronger. We therefore place great value on diversity and inclusion.


**Qu'avons\-nous à vous offrir ?**
----------------------------------

  

Choosing Ypto means choosing to contribute to the digital transformation of the Belgian railways. You will have a job with social impact and ample opportunity to make your own contribution. Alongside a healthy work\-life balance and a competitive salary, we offer:


* Hybrid working, with a balanced weekly mix of office and remote work, combined with flexible hours.
* 35 days of annual leave.
* A mobility package with a company car (also available via our mobility plan) or alternative mobility choices, complemented by a public transport season ticket.
* A target bonus.
* A comprehensive insurance package, with hospitalisation and dental care for the whole family.
* Coverage of outpatient medical costs.
* Group insurance, including a supplementary pension (cafeteria plan).
* Meal vouchers \& eco vouchers.
* Net allowances for hybrid working and an internet allowance.
**Où allez\-vous travailler ?**
-------------------------------

  

You will work near Brussels\-South station.


**What’s next ?**
-----------------

  

* You apply online : https://ypto.recruitee.com/o/sap\-domain\-architect\-supply\-chain\-management\-scm


* We take a close look at your CV and check whether it matches the profile you are looking for. We may call you briefly to ask about your motivation and experience.


* We invite you for a first (online) HR interview where you can demonstrate your motivation, experience and expectations.


* If the first interview is positive, we invite you for a second (technical) interview in Brussels. This interview will be with the team, where we’ll discuss the role and how your skills align with the team’s needs.


* If everything goes well, we will make you a contract offer.


* You start your new job!

  

We reserve the right to adjust or pause this procedure if necessary. Our recruitment team will select the profiles that best match the job requirements to ensure an optimal fit.


**Avez\-vous encore des questions?**
------------------------------------

  

**Jobreq: 54036**

  

Ypto recruitment
  

Mail: ypto\-recruitment@belgiantrain.be

jobs.title: OSI PI Engineer
jobs.description:
De functie combineert technische expertise in PI AF en PI Vision met een sterke focus op data\-contextualisatie, GxP\-compliance en betrouwbare dataflows. Vanuit een zelfstandige rol werk je nauw samen met het manufacturingteam, het PI\-team en de system owner.


**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------


### **PI AF\-configuratie \& data\-contextualisatie**


Je configureert PI AF (Asset Framework) om data uit de manufacturingprocessen op een gestructureerde en betekenisvolle manier te contextualiseren. De configuraties worden afgestemd op de specifieke noden van de productieomgeving en ondersteunen een betrouwbare verwerking en interpretatie van procesdata.


Daarnaast werk je mee aan de monitoring van Run2Run\-processen via PI Vision\-displays. Hierbij ligt de focus op de front\-end en op het overzichtelijk beschikbaar maken van relevante productie\-informatie voor de gebruikers.


### **Validatie \& change management**


Je valideert ontwikkelde PI AF\-configuraties volgens de geldende GxP\-vereisten en de gedocumenteerde procedures voor PI AF change management. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat configuraties op een gecontroleerde en gedocumenteerde manier worden voorbereid voor implementatie.


Na validatie implementeer je de configuraties in de PI\-productieomgeving. Wanneer procedures of werkwijzen wijzigen, draag je bij aan het actualiseren en onderhouden van de bestaande PI AF change managementdocumentatie. Afstemming met het manufacturingteam, het PI\-team en de system owner vormt hierbij een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie.


**Wie ben jij?**
----------------


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma of gelijkwaardige technische ervaring en hebt ongeveer 2 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring opgebouwd binnen een technische of industriële omgeving. Je hebt een sterke kennis van OSI PI, met specifieke expertise in PI AF en PI Vision.


Ervaring binnen een GxP\-productieomgeving is belangrijk, net als een goed begrip van IT/OT\-systemen en de bijhorende datastromen. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig PI AF\-configuraties uit te werken voor concrete requirements en weet daarbij technische noden te vertalen naar een praktische en betrouwbare oplossing.


Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van Lean\-principes en ervaring met agile werkwijzen of tools zoals Jira en Confluence zijn een pluspunt.


**Wat maakt deze rol uniek?**
-----------------------------

* **Techniek binnen een gereguleerde context:** de combinatie van OSI PI, GxP\-validatie en change management zorgt voor een uitdagende technische omgeving waarin kwaliteit en compliance centraal staan.
* **Zelfstandige verantwoordelijkheid:** de functie biedt ruimte om PI AF\-configuraties zelfstandig uit te werken en van validatie tot implementatie op te volgen.
* **Sterke samenwerking tussen disciplines:** je vormt de technische schakel tussen manufacturing, het PI\-team en de system owner.

**Laat je carrière knallen bij Enginity**
-----------------------------------------


Bij Enginity draait alles om technische expertise, persoonlijke groei en projecten die écht impact maken binnen industriële omgevingen. Als consultant krijg je de kans om jouw kennis in te zetten bij toonaangevende klanten, terwijl je blijft bouwen aan je eigen traject.


### **De kracht achter de knal**


Enginity maakt deel uit van de Cronos Groep en combineert de slagkracht van een sterk netwerk met de persoonlijke aanpak van een hecht team.

Geen standaardpad, maar een carrière die mee evolueert met jouw ambities. Samen bekijken we welke projecten, opleidingen en uitdagingen aansluiten bij je expertise en groeidoelen.


### **Brandstof om vooruit te gaan**


Via gerichte begeleiding, kennisdeling en opleidingsmogelijkheden blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen in zowel technische als soft skills. Zo krijg je de ruimte om je expertise verder te verdiepen en breder inzetbaar te worden.


### **Meer dan collega’s: een familie**


Enginity staat voor een toegankelijke cultuur waarin mensen elkaar kennen, ondersteunen en versterken. We spreken niet voor niets over onze Enginity Family.


### **Hier geldt: 1 \+ 1 \= 3**


Door technische kennis, ondernemerschap en samenwerking te bundelen, ontstaan oplossingen die verder gaan dan het individuele project. Samen maken we het verschil bij klanten én binnen het team.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Aftermarket Applications)
jobs.description:
**Your role**
-------------

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.


You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.


As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.


You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.


You build the back\-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as\-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.


Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.


The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C\# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.


**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

You have built back\-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business\-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade\-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.


You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must\-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.


**Must\-have**

* **C\# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10\):** recent, hands\-on experience building production\-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
* **Azure:** practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
* **REST API design and implementation:** designing and consuming well\-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
* **SQL databases:** data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
* **Testing as part of development:** unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
* **Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.**

**Strong plus**

* **Apache Kafka:** consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
* **Graph databases:** Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
* **Secure\-by\-default cloud development:** managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
* **Observability:** structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
* **Domain\-driven design:** bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
* **Microservice architecture:** service boundaries, inter\-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
* **Event\-driven and message\-based architecture:** queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at\-least\-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
* **CI/CD with Azure DevOps:** YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well\-being, and we provide a flexible work\-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.


You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.


**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).


  
Company: Atlas Copco Group
  

Location: Belgium
  

City: Antwerp
  

Date of Posting: September 14, 2026

jobs.title: Senior Netwerk Engineer
jobs.description:
**Tabaknatie is een logistieke dienstverlener in de Antwerpse haven, gespecialiseerd in de opslag en behandeling van goederen voor internationale klanten. Zowel op rechter\- als op linkeroever beschikken wij over gespecialiseerde magazijnen met een totale oppervlakte van meer dan 1\.000\.000m². Als Senior Netwerk Engineer maak je deel uit van ons IT\-departement en ga je aan de slag op ons hoofdkantoor in het centrum van Antwerpen.****WAT GA JE DOEN?**
===================


* Je bent binnen het team het aanspreekpunt voor het netwerk: van de core\-en access\-switchen in de kantoren en magazijnen tot de firewalls, WiFi\-dekking en de connectiviteit tussen onze sites.
* Je beheert, bewaakt en optimaliseert deze omgeving, en je werkt mee aan projecten zoals vernieuwingen, uitbreidingen en migraties.
* Operationeel beheer van de netwerkinfrastructuur: switching, routing, firewalling, WiFi en VPN.
* Opvolgen van incidenten en changes, inclusief root cause\-analyse en structurele oplossingen.
* Bewaken van documentatie, configuratiestandaarden en netwerkbeveiliging.
* Uitvoeren en begeleiden van projecten: van voorbereiding en planning tot implementatie en oplevering.
* Coachen van een junior collega: je neemt hem of haar stap voor stap mee in de netwerkmaterie en maakt van kennisoverdracht een vaste gewoonte.
* In het kader van NIS2, het mee bewaken van de netwerkbeveiliging: segmentatie, firewallbeleid, toegangsbeheer en hardening.

Je takenpakket stopt niet aan de grens van het netwerk. Je volgt actief de markt op voor nieuwe trends om mee te helpen bouwen van de roadmap. Afhankelijk van de noden van de organisatie schuif je mee aan bij bredere ondersteuning van de operationele teams op de werkvloer. Omdat onze operatie ook buiten de klassieke kantooruren doorloopt, ben je bereid om occasioneel onderhoud, upgrades en interventies vroeg ‘s ochtends, ‘s avonds of in het weekend uit te voeren. Ingrepen worden vooraf gepland en in overleg met het team afgesproken.
**WIE ZOEKEN WE?**
==================


Je hebt ruime ervaring als netwerk engineer en je weet waarover je praat. Je bouwt je advies op ervaring, onderzoek en overleg met je collega’s, niet op aannames. Daarnaast geef je graag je kennis door en hebt het geduld om een junior collega te laten groeien in plaats van het werk zelf over te nemen.
**Je beschikt ook over:**
=========================


* Ervaring met Cisco\-netwerkapparatuur is een must, net als aantoonbare ervaring in operationeel netwerkbeheer. Ervaring met Palo Alto\-firewalls is een plus.
* Kennis van of ervaring met informatieveiligheidsnormen zoals ISO 27001 of regelgeving zoals NIS2 is een plus.
* Een gestructureerde werking: je documenteert, plant je werk en houdt overzicht, ook wanneer er meerdere zaken tegelijk lopen.
* Een pragmatische en rustige houding. Bij een storing verlies je je kalmte niet en ga je methodisch te werk.
* Een professionele en heldere communicatiestijl, ook richting hoger management: je vertaalt techniek naar begrijpelijke taal, impact en opties. Dit in het Nederlands, maar ook Engels is een must.
* Een flexibele ingesteldheid en pakt daardoor aan wat nodig is, ook als het buiten je strikte specialisatie valt.
* Kennis van of ervaring in een magazijn\-, transport– of logistieke omgeving is een plus.
* Een rijbewijs B, om je te kunnen verplaatsen naar de verschillende sites en hoofdkantoren verspreid in de Haven van Antwerpen.

**Waarom voor Tabaknatie werken?**
==================================


Bij Tabaknatie zal je deel uitmaken van een hechte familie van getalenteerde professionals die elkaar ondersteunen en aanmoedigen om gezamenlijk grenzen te verleggen. We geloven in het creëren van een omgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd voelt en waar individuele groei en ontwikkeling worden gestimuleerd. Als wereldleider zijn we voortdurend in beweging, en dat houdt ons werk boeiend en uitdagend. Geen dag is hetzelfde bij Tabaknatie, en dat maakt ons uniek in onze branche. We omarmen verandering en innovatie, waardoor onze medewerkers de kans krijgen om hun vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en nieuwe mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Kiezen voor een carrière bij Tabaknatie betekent kiezen voor een werkplek waar je je gewaardeerd voelt, waar je kunt groeien en waar je deel uitmaakt van een familie die zich inzet voor succes. Sluit je aan bij ons team en ervaar zelf waarom onze medewerkers zo trots zijn om bij Tabaknatie te werken.

.text\-block p { margin\-top: 0px; }
Voor ons ontwikkelingsteam achter Horizon, onze customer success portal die fungeert als dé centrale toegangspoort tot de diensten van Cegeka en klanten ondersteuning, inzichten en transparantie biedt, én als onze Employee Experience Portal, waarmee Cegeka\-medewerkers digitaal hun timesheets, afwezigheden en onkosten beheren, zijn we op zoek naar een getalenteerde en gedreven Teamlead. In deze rol bevind je je op het kruispunt van people leadership, procesoptimalisatie en product\- en technische expertise. Samen met je team bouw je mee aan digitale oplossingen die dagelijks een positieve impact hebben op zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers.
Je leidt en coacht ons Horizon\-developmentteam, een team van ongeveer 10 getalenteerde collega's verspreid over een internationale omgeving (België, Roemenië, Moldavië en Griekenland).
Je combineert hands\-on leiderschap met een grondige kennis van Agile\-principes en helpt het team kwalitatief hoogstaand werk af te leveren, terwijl je zowel de individuele als de collectieve groei stimuleert.
Je creëert een cultuur van eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering, over verschillende locaties en tijdszones heen.
Je faciliteert Scrum\-ceremonies zoals sprintplanningen, daily stand\-ups, reviews en retrospectives en zorgt ervoor dat Agile\-principes op een doeltreffende en pragmatische manier worden toegepast, zonder ze louter "by the book" te volgen.
Je bent eigenaar van de Jira\-werkwijze binnen het team en beheert de backlogstructuur, sprintboards, rapportering en proceshygiëne.
Je fungeert als brug tussen het developmentteam, product owners en stakeholders, waarbij je prioriteiten vertaalt naar duidelijke, concrete en uitvoerbare opdrachten.
Je identificeert en neemt zowel technische als organisatorische obstakels weg die het team kunnen vertragen.
Je ondersteunt de sprint\- en releaseplanning en bewaakt hierbij de juiste balans tussen scope, kwaliteit en oplevertermijnen.
Afhankelijk van je achtergrond draag je actief bij aan technische of productgerelateerde discussies, bijvoorbeeld door architectuurbeslissingen mee te beoordelen of productvereisten verder te verfijnen.
Je volgt de prestaties en deliverables van het team op aan de hand van relevante metrics en gebruikt deze inzichten om continue verbetering te stimuleren, niet als een loutere compliance\-oefening.
Wat breng jij mee?
Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen, begeleiden en coachen van een internationaal, verspreid team.
Je werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende landen, tijdzones en culturen.
Je hebt ruime ervaring in Agile omgevingen en hebt teams succesvol geleid, gecoacht of gefaciliteerd als Scrum Master, teamlead of in een vergelijkbare rol.
Je hebt een achtergrond in softwareontwikkeling of product ownership, waardoor je een geloofwaardige sparringpartner bent voor het team en vlot kunt deelnemen aan prioriteringsdiscussies.
Je hebt een gedegen kennis van Jira en voelt je comfortabel bij het configureren van boards, het beheren van backlogs en het vergroten van de transparantie binnen teams.
Je beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en weet technische details moeiteloos te vertalen naar businessprioriteiten en omgekeerd.
Je beheerst het Engels vloeiend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, aangezien dit de voertaal is binnen het team. Kennis van het Nederlands is een pluspunt.
Je bent bereid om af en toe te reizen om teamleden of stakeholders in andere landen te ontmoeten.
Je hebt een pragmatische mindset gericht op continue verbetering en ziet Agile als een middel om samenwerking en waardecreatie te stimuleren, niet als een doel op zich.
Ervaring met het Horizon\-platform of een gelijkaardig product/domein is een troef.
Relevante certificeringen zoals PSM, CSM, PSPO, SAFe of gelijkwaardig zijn een pluspunt, net als ervaring met Confluence of andere documentatietools.
Je werkt minstens twee dagen per week vanuit ons kantoor in Hasselt (Corda Campus), aangevuld met tijd in een ander Cegeka\-kantoor (bij voorkeur Leuven) en thuiswerk.
Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?
We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren.
Je start bij een Top Employer.
Een marktconform dagtarief en tal van voordelen.
Cegeka bewijst jaar na jaar in het Whitelane Research dat we een betrouwbare en toonaangevende partner zijn op vlak van IT\-dienstverlening, met een eerste plaats in 2026 voor Security Services (vierde jaar op rij), een gedeelde tweede plaats voor Cloud \& Infrastructure Services en Network \& Connectivity.
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans.
Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team\-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij.
Begeleiding op maat: doorheen jouw carrière word je begeleid door onze people managers. Zo heb je een aanspreekpunt, een persoonlijke coach én een sparringpartner.
Continu bijleren: door innovation centers, leesgroepen, knowledge sharing meetings, hackatons, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen zetten we kennisdeling en bijleren centraal.

Hybride werken: je werkt vanuit een Cegeka kantoor in jouw buurt (Hasselt, Leuven, Antwerpen, Gent, Diegem), maar ook bij onze klanten, gecombineerd met thuiswerk.
We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2\-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt.

**Company Description**  

Devoteam is a leading consulting firm focused on digital transformation. We help ourclients leverage technology to achieve their business goals. Our longstandingpartnerships with leaders like AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and ServiceNowamplify our capabilities, allowing us to deliver top\-tier expertise and award\-winning  

services.  

For 30 years, we have always been on the next tech wave. Devoteam has guided organizations through the Internet and cloud. The next revolution? AI. With 11,000 tech natives working in 25\+ countries, we bring you highly skilled ITexperts across Europe. At Devoteam, tech is in our DNA, and it’s the people we empower with tech. Now,with responsible AI, we’re ready to unlock a future where technology drivespositive change.

 **Job Description** **About the Team**


Devoteam Creative Tech is Belgium's leading digital consultancy, specializing in cloud\-native development, AI innovation, and modern software engineering. Our multidisciplinary teams work on high\-impact projects for top\-tier clients across industries — from intelligent automation to large\-scale platform modernizations. We foster a culture of curiosity, continuous learning, and creative problem\-solving.

**About the Role**


As a Senior Java Developer at Devoteam Creative Tech, you will take on a prominent role in designing, building, and maintaining high\-performance enterprise applications and modern back\-end services, with foundational capabilities in any front\-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, Vue.js). This is an AI Augmented position: you are expected to actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily workflow to accelerate development, drive code quality, and build intelligent application features.

**Mission**

* Take on a prominent role in the software architecture and design of enterprise applications, maintaining clean, scalable, and maintainable Java codebases.
* Design and implement robust back\-end microservices, REST APIs, and databases with optimized performance, security, and scalability.
* Build and integrate responsive front\-end components to support full\-stack project delivery and client requirements.
* Leverage AI\-assisted software engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Google Gemini, Claude) to streamline coding, unit testing, debugging, and documentation processes.
* Design and implement AI\-powered features, including LLM API integrations, RAG pipelines, intelligent automation, and conversational interfaces.
* Participate in code reviews, automated testing, and quality assurance processes to drive engineering excellence.

 **Qualifications** **Profile**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and architectural skills with a deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
* Strong understanding of software design patterns, Clean Architecture, and microservices design principles.
* Solid grasp of the software development lifecycle, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and DevSecOps practices.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Genuine curiosity about AI and a proactive approach to adopting modern tools, keeping pace with emerging Java frameworks, cloud tech, and AI practices.
* Fluency in Dutch or French, and English.

**Technical Requirements :**

**Java Core \& Back\-End**

* Java Core \& Frameworks — Deep expertise in Java (Java 17/21\+), Spring Framework, Spring Boot, and Hibernate / JPA.
* API Development \& Microservices — Design and implementation of scalable microservice architectures and robust web services (RESTful APIs, gRPC, or GraphQL).
* Databases \& Data Modeling — Strong proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) and SQL, as well as familiarity with NoSQL stores.

**Front\-End \& Web**

* Web Fundamentals — Solid practical knowledge of a front\-end framework, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SASS, and responsive UI integration.
* State \& Integration — Experience integrating front\-ends with back\-end REST APIs and managing client\-side application state.

**Quality, CI/CD \& Security**

* Testing Frameworks — Strong unit testing and TDD mindset using JUnit, Mockito, and fron\-tend testing utilities (Jasmine/Karma or Jest).
* DevOps \& Version Control — Proficiency with Git, build tools (Maven, Gradle), and modern CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps).
* Security — Understanding of web application security principles, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and JWT.

**AI Skills**

**This is an AI Augmented role. The following AI competencies are mandatory:**

* Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Google Gemini, Claude, or similar) embedded in your daily workflow.
* Practical understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI) into Java applications (e.g., using Spring AI or LangChain4j).
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques and constructing LLM\-enabled workflows (summarization, data extraction, enterprise search).
* Understanding of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and vector databases (eg: pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant).
* Awareness of responsible AI principles: data privacy, security, and ethical AI deployment.

**Assets (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging systems (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Familiarity with building AI agents or multi\-agent systems.
* Relevant professional certifications (e.g., Spring Certified Professional, AWS/Azure/GCP Developer, or AI certifications).

 **Additional Information** **What We Offer**

* A challenging and varied role within Devoteam Creative Tech, Belgium's leading tech consultancy.
* Work on cutting\-edge projects combining modern software development with AI innovation.
* A competitive salary package including company car, net allowances, meal vouchers, and group insurance.
* Continuous learning opportunities: certifications, training budgets, conferences, and internal knowledge\-sharing.
* A hybrid work model with modern, inspiring office spaces designed for collaboration.
* A culture that values innovation, autonomy, and personal growth.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.  



  

**Job Description**

  

Job Title: **Integration Engineer**

Location: **Madrid, Spain \| Hybrid 6 days a month**

**SS\&C Algorithmics**

The SS\&C Algorithmics (part of SS\&C Technologies Inc.) financial risk, regulatory and performance platform serves banking, insurance, asset management and hedge fund institutions. We partner with clients around the world to respond proactively and transparently to regulatory requirements and solve the most complex challenges in financial risk management and performance measurement.


**The Opportunity**

As an Integration Engineer, you will work across a broad technical stack including Linux, databases, scripting, interfaces, middleware, cloud and automation. Rather than focusing on a single technology, you will learn how complex enterprise systems are designed, integrated, deployed, tested and operated in real\-world environments.


This role is a great opportunity for a technically minded engineer who wants to combine hands\-on technology with real client exposure and ownership of complex implementation projects, and who enjoys understanding how systems work end\-to\-end, solving difficult technical problems and working with people as much as with technology.


You will work closely with some of the largest financial institutions in Europe, collaborating directly with client technology teams, project managers, financial engineers and SS\&C product specialists. From an early stage, you will be encouraged to take ownership of technical problems, contribute to solution design and become a trusted technical advisor to clients.


**What You Will Get To Do:**

* Define and specify the technical architecture and design of the SS\&C Algorithmics solution to be implemented.
* Define and scope the technical configuration, interfacing and enhancement work in conjunction with project managers, senior engineers and financial engineers.
* Provide technical consultancy to clients based on solid understanding of the Algo product suite and implementation requirements.
* Set up and configure Algorithmics and third\-party products (database, middleware, reporting solutions) at client sites.
* Design and implement interfaces between clients’ source systems and SS\&C Algorithmics products. This will largely involve the Algorithmics’ data mapping tool and definition of data required from the clients’ systems.
* Design, develop and implement customised modules using a range of development tools (typically shell, Perl or Python).
* Conduct troubleshooting, testing (functional and volume) for original installation and system upgrades, and support clients’ integration testing and acceptance testing activities.
* Where appropriate, deliver training through formal courses and workshop sessions for clients and internal teams.
* Produce technical documentation for clients describing the system and its customisations.

**What You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's Degree in a technical degree (e.g., Computer science, telecom engineering, or a related technical field.
* English \& Spanish: Fluent
* High degree of initiative, resourcefulness, resilience, and self\-sufficiency in implementing and configuring complex software products and using technology to solve business problems.
* Hands\-on command of Unix / Linux, including shell scripting and file system navigation.
* Basic programming experience in at least one language (e.g., Java, Python, C\#, C\+\+, Kotlin, Rust
* AI \& Productivity Tools: Experience using AI agents \& tools.
* Capacity to estimate work, manage own deliverables and keep within project plans.
* Ability to work with competing demands in small multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Sound documentation and communication skills in a client\-facing environment.

**Desired:**

* Experience with middleware and business intelligence (reporting) software.
* Understanding of database essentials (including SQL, installation, sizing, performance). Specific DBA skills are not essential, but familiarity with at least one RDBMS is required.
* Client\-facing culture
* Familiarity with DevOps \& Cloud
* Understanding of the financial marketplace (market data, fixed income products, derivatives) in terms of the underlying data.

Familiarity with risk management (market risk/credit risk in a commercial or treasury environment), financial analytics and market data  

  



**Why You Will Love It Here!**

* **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model
* **Your Future:** Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS\&C University
* **Work/Life Balance:** Competitive holiday scheme
* **Your Wellbeing:** Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
* **Diversity \& Inclusion:** Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity

*We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.*

Thank you for your interest in SS\&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website @ www.ssctech.com/careers .

Europe Region

MAD0000JO Requisition \#  

**Junior BMS Engineer**


**Shape the Future of Intelligent Building Control Systems with Arup.**


Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.


Our Building Controls team plays a vital role in Arup’s commitment to smart and sustainable building solutions. We design and integrate advanced control systems that enhance building performance, optimize energy usage, and contribute to cutting\-edge digital and net\-zero solutions.


Join a team that’s making a tangible difference. Our work in intelligent buildings, energy efficiency, and digital integration is directly contributing to a more sustainable and resilient future for communities in Spain and beyond.


**The Opportunity**


This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects, including commercial, industrial, healthcare, data centres, and educational sectors.


As a Building Controls Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, integrating, and optimizing control systems to enhance building performance and contribute to our innovation building automation initiatives.


You will also have the opportunity to drive innovation in building automation, IoT integration, and energy\-efficient control strategies, shaping the future of intelligent building systems at Arup.


**As a Junior Building Controls Engineer at Arup, you will:**


* Design BMS/building controls systems to optimize building performance and streamline building management, including applications in commercial, industrial, and Data Centre environments.
* Work closely with disciplines like Mechanical, Electrical, ICT, Smart Buildings, and Digital to ensure fully integrated control solutions.
* Ensure seamless integration of BMS, EPMS, and HVAC control systems into overall building design, with consideration for Data Centres where required..
* Conduct design studies and produce conceptual design reports.
* Prepare contract documentation, specifications, and drawings ensuring compliance.
* Conduct surveys and site inspections.
* Witness control system commissioning, ensuring proper execution and alignment with design, including Data Centre BMS and EPMS where applicable.

**Does this role inspire you?**


We are looking for someone who is passionate about smart building automation and energy\-efficient control systems. We also value:


* A bachelor's degree in Controls, Mechatronics, Building Services, Mechanical, or Electrical Services Engineering.
* 3\-4 years' experience designing building control systems (BMS, BAS, or HVAC Controls).
* Actively working towards or interested in achieving Chartered Engineer status
* Experience in Data Centre projects.
* Experience with PLC (programmable Logic Controllers) and DDC (Direct Digital Control) systems, particularly in complex building environments, including Data Centre.
* Familiarity with the latest standards and regulations relevant to building control systems, with knowledge of Data Centre\-specific standards (ASHRAE, Uptime Institute, ISO 50001\).
* Proficiency in software tools commonly used in the building controls sector.

**Why Arup?**


At Arup, we offer a rewarding career with a global company committed to a better future. Our unique trust ownership structure allows us to prioritize meaningful work and invest in our people. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


**Benefits that work for you:**


* **Professional Growth \& Development:** Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup.
* **Global Opportunities**: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short\-term or long\-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.
* **Financial Well\-being \& Ownership**: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit\-sharing programme.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** We offer a hybrid working model and flexible working arrangements to support work\-life balance.
* **Well\-being and Culture:** Access to a range of well\-being programs, including sports subsidies, social activities, and initiatives promoting a healthy work\-life balance. We foster a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.

Arup is recognized as one of the best companies to work for in Spain in 2026 by Actualidad Económica and Forbes magazine, thanks to our flexibility policies. We also adhere to the Code of Principles of Generational Diversity, committing to equal opportunities regardless of age.


At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You’ll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning—to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.


We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. We’re here to support you.

**Join our expanding engineering team! We're actively recruiting a Senior Backend Engineer to help scale M\-KOPA Mobility, our fast\-growing e\-mobility business.** **This is an initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with the potential to extend or transition into a permanent role. Build the event\-driven microservices that power clean, affordable transport for riders and entrepreneurs across Africa.**

**The Impact** – Africa's transport sector is massive, underserved, and at an inflection point, and the transition to electric is accelerating, led by East Africa. Your code will directly power the technology behind Kenya's leading e\-mobility financing platform. We've already financed over 11,000 electric motorbikes, helping riders save more than $3 a day and cutting air pollution by 90%. It's your chance to build tech for a business that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent


**The Opportunity**


**Mission\-driven engineering:** Every service you build helps put clean transport within reach of riders who'd otherwise be locked out of ownership


**Global recognition:** Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest\-growing companies for 5 consecutive years running (2022–2026\)


**Scale challenges:** Build backend systems for a business growing at 3x year\-on\-year, with over 11,000 e\-motorbikes financed and demand climbing


**Real climate impact:** Electric is simply better for drivers, cities, and the planet — our e\-motorbikes cut air pollution by 90% versus petrol equivalents

**What You'll Do**


At M\-KOPA, you'll build sophisticated event\-driven microservices with real\-world impact. Our engineering teams own their solutions end\-to\-end – from architecture decisions to production monitoring. Join us in combining cutting\-edge .NET development with purpose\-driven engineering that makes digital and financial inclusion possible across Africa.

**Technical Environment**

* **Languages \& frameworks:** C\#/.NET
* **Cloud:** We work in Azure, and welcome experience across AWS or GCP
* **Architecture:** Event\-driven systems and microservice development – we use Service Bus, and welcome experience with similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* **Infrastructure:** Kubernetes, Docker
* **Observability:** Prometheus, Grafana
* **Engineering culture:** DevOps, infrastructure as code, automated testing across all environments including production, continuous delivery
* **AI tooling:** We use AI coding tools including Claude Code as part of our engineering workflow

**Our Engineering Approach**

As an engineer, you will work as a collaborator. More senior members will coach and contribute, placing an emphasis on:

* High quality output
* Observability and monitoring
* Automated testing in all environments, including production
* Infrastructure as code and DevOps practices

**What You Need**


We expect you to be comfortable working as part of a team which owns the entire software stack, including supporting infrastructure, throughout the entire software lifecycle, from inception through production to decommissioning under a DevOps culture. You'll value the constraints that continuous delivery places upon engineering processes and embrace testing and observability as first\-order concerns in development.


Required Experience:

* Strong grasp of C\# .NET development
* Experience with event\-driven systems – Service Bus or similar messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* Microservices architecture experience
* Experience with Azure, or other major cloud providers such as AWS or GCP
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker)
* Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
* Testing and deployment expertise
* DevOps culture mindset
* Experience working with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code or similar

**Location \& Benefits**

* Initial 12\-month Fixed Term Contract, with potential to extend or transition into a permanent role
* Fully remote role within UTC \-1 to UTC \+3 time zones
* Work with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa
* Professional development programs and coaching partnerships
* Family\-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements
* Well\-being support and career growth opportunities

**Our Mission** We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer\-centric financing model, with M\-KOPA Mobility extending that same model to clean transport. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth, and low\-income communities.

**Our Impact**

* **Connected :** 6 million smartphone customers, 2\.5 million first\-time smartphone users
* **Prosperous :** 70% of customers use their M\-KOPA product for income generation, with 35,000\+ livelihoods created for agents
* **Green :** 11,000\+ e\-motorbikes financed, growing 3x year\-on\-year, cutting air pollution by 90% and helping riders save more than $3 a day

**Ready to build C\# .NET solutions that put clean, affordable transport within reach of Every Day Earners, while advancing your career in modern backend engineering?**

**At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritise well\-being, and embrace flexibility.**

**Apply now to join our mission of transforming lives across Africa through technology.**

**Why M\-KOPA?**
----------------


At M\-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on\-the\-job training. We support individual journeys with family\-friendly policies, prioritize well\-being, and embrace flexibility.


Join us in shaping the future of M\-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at **m\-kopa.com**.

*M\-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

*M\-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M\-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships.*

*M\-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre\-employment or post\-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process.*

*Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
System Architect
jobs.description:
**Location:** EU remote

#### **About the Role:**


As a member of Auditdata's Architecture Group, you will join a highly skilled engineering organization building enterprise\-grade solutions for audiology clinic chains worldwide. You will shape integrations, domain boundaries, system design, and platform evolution across our SaaS product portfolio.

**Our tech stack** includes .NET, React ecosystem, Azure Servises (AKS, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure SQL Database).


#### **What You Will Do:**

**Integration \& API Architecture:**

* Define and maintain Manage’s integration strategy (REST, Events, APIs, Data Feeds).
* Design standard integration patterns — real\-time (Event Hubs), on\-demand (REST), hybrid workflows.
* Lead technical workshops with customers and partners to gather requirements and define integration approaches.
* Align integrations with domain boundaries, data contracts, and platform security standards.
* Govern message contracts, event schemas, versioning strategy, and error\-handling models.
* Enforce security best practices (OAuth2, mTLS, Azure AD, Key Vault).
* Oversee monitoring, observability, and integration reliability (tracking, retries, DLQs).

**Domain \& System Architecture:**

* Serve as the technical consultant for assigned domains, ensuring architectural integrity and consistent domain boundaries.
* Shape domain models and identify bounded contexts, aggregates, and integration points.
* Define APIs and event contracts across microservices and cross\-domain workflows.
* Evaluate epics and initiatives for architectural feasibility and appropriate service ownership.
* Support teams with high\-level design, technology selection, and patterns.
* Participate in architecture reviews and platform governance.
* Coach teams on DDD, Clean Architecture, and best engineering practices.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, specifications, interface documentation, and ADRs.

**Platform \& Multi\-Tenancy:**

* Design and own the architecture of a secure, performant, and cost\-efficient multi\-tenancy model.
* Contribute to the long\-term architecture vision and support the evolution of the platform strategy.

**Customer \& Pre\-Sales Engagement:**

* Participate in pre\-sales work, technical scoping, and early\-stage solution shaping.
* Support troubleshooting and performance improvements for complex integrations or distributed system issues.

#### **What You Will Bring:**


Technical Skills \& Experience:

* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate architectural decisions to both leadership and engineering teams.
* Experience with integration architectures (Azure Service Bus, Event Hubs, Azure Functions, REST APIs, Webhooks).
* Practical knowledge of **microservices** and **event\-driven architectures.**
* Solid understanding of **Domain\-Driven Design** and **Clean Architecture.**
* Proven ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation and diagrams (Miro, Lucid, C4, Event Catalog).
* Comfortable in customer\-facing technical discussions.
* Strong background in Azure Cloud services.
* Ability to enforce architectural standards through ADRs, reviews, and quality gates.
* Familiarity with governance, audit logging, and proactive system health monitoring.
* Ability to collaborate with Product and Delivery teams to align architecture with the roadmap and business vision.
* Fluent English.


Preferred:

* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years in architecture roles within enterprise SaaS.
* Proven experience modernizing or commercializing legacy platforms into scalable, multi\-tenant products.
* Demonstrated success designing enterprise\-grade integrations.
* Degree in Computer Science or a similar field.


Nice\-to\-Haves:

* Experience with MassTransit.
* Hands\-on experience with AI/ML, LLMs, or agent\-based architectures (semantic search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation).
* Azure Cloud certifications.
* Strong understanding of security and compliance for medical or regulated data (HIPAA, GDPR).
* .NET and React familiarity.


Key Traits:

* Strong leadership, ownership, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to solve complex technical challenges and provide clear direction.
* A consistent focus on continuous learning — both personal and team\-wide.
* A mindset that promotes cross\-team alignment, technical excellence, and architectural consistency.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Long\-term engagement in a stable, growing SaaS company.
* High engineering and product standards.
* Flexible environment with a flat organizational structure.
* Professional development opportunities, including certification support.
* A global, diverse, and highly skilled team across Denmark, Ukraine, UK, Poland, Canada, Australia, USA, and more.
* A culture that values personal growth as much as business outcomes.


You don’t match the description 100%? Please don’t hold back! We would love to hear from you.


We’re looking for someone who finds the role challenging and exciting and wants to grow in this role.


We look forward to your application! *(****please submit your CV in English****)*

 *Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
### **General Information**

Ref \#
235270
Location
Qatar\-Doha
Job family
Corporate \& Commercial
* Closing Date: 2026\-09\-28

  

### **Description**

**About the Role**


Establish IT domain architecture, technology and delivery standards to cater to the automation needs of assigned business units. Activities include solution reviews, recommending IT architecture and design standards, mentoring the IT delivery team on IT design and development, evaluating technologies and tools and execution of adoption plans in a time\-bound manner, evaluation of 3rd party vendor applications, devices and provide technical expertise, lead a team of technical resources based on assigned work program. Lead the governance of systems architectures across assigned business units, ensuring consistency with specified requirements agreed with both external and internal customers/suppliers.

**Your duties would include:**

* Responsible for comprehending Qatar Airways’ business needs, scrutinizing existing systems, and pinpointing potential tech solutions. This includes crafting and overseeing solutions that meet these needs and developing scalable architectures for new services and business models. Pivotal in planning and executing these solutions, driving the organization’s tech progression.
* Responsible for evaluating and selecting suitable tools and frameworks and overseeing the implementation and integration of solutions.
* Ensure technological scalability and compliance with security standards through assessing and mitigating the risks associated with the project.
* Responsible for designing innovative and practical end\-to\-end technical solution of a system, in line with the business strategy and objectives of the Line of Business (LOB).
* Collaborate with Solution Architects from other LOBs to identify synergies in solutions and to adopt and standardize common tools and technologies across organization.
* Contribute to the development of architecture governance structures, methodologies and compliance activities of the organization ensuring that the solution, architecture or methodologies are in compliance to the QR policies and standards.
* Responsible for reviewing business requirements to deliver artefacts, including Solution Architecture.
* Contribute and review Functional and Non\-functional requirements, Technical Architecture, Interface specifications and high\-level design documents.
* Responsible for breaking down the complex application requirements using functional decomposition and Domain Driven Design, identify Microservices and define APIs for the domains to create better software solutions that are maintainable and scalable.
* Oversee development of solutions, review artefacts of projects across LOB/scrum teams in order to ensure consistency with design and architecture guidelines.
* Provide strategic guidance to development teams and ensure that business goals and objectives are aligned.
* Drive communication plan to educate stakeholders on the purpose and benefits of solution architecture.
* Plan and execute proof of concepts to demonstrate feasibility of idea, complex solutions and cutting\-edge technologies.
* Drive innovation, to ensure that solutions drive value to the business and customers.
* Liaise with external 3rd party suppliers and internal departments / IT teams to collaborate and design and implement robust solutions and interfaces between applications.
* Ensure system designs are manageable, maintainable, scalable, resilient, sustainable, cost effective whilst addressing business requirements.
* Responsible for ensuring that all application Non\-Functional Requirements are met, ensure thorough testing of NFRs and ensure corrective / preventive actions.
* Assist in review of production readiness, prior to release of the application to Production.
* Make sure that the items under user acceptance certificate are tested thoroughly by the quality assurance team.
* Responsible to correctly apply across programs/projects and products the relevant technical strategies, policies, standards and practices in collaboration with Technical Architecture Group.
* Anticipate project issues and risks before they occur, and work with the team to identify and implement solutions or mitigations with relevant stakeholders.
* Lead root cause analysis of reported critical incidents in operational production systems and recommend/ensure implementation of effective preventive actions to avoid repetition.
* Work closely with QRIT Security and Technology Services team to ensure compliance to IT standards and policies.
* Contribute to preparation of IT Strategy for business and associated IT budgeting exercise.
* Takes full responsibility for ensuring that solution designs balance functional, non\-functional, security, service quality and systems management requirements.
* Enforce policy and strategy for the selection of solution design components, and co\-ordinates design activities, promoting the discipline to ensure consistency. Ensures that appropriate standards (corporate, industry, national and international) are adhered to by the development teams.

**Be part of an extraordinary story**


Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.


Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.


Together, everything is possible.


### **Qualification**

We are looking for a passionate and experienced professional to join our IT \- team. The ideal candidate should possess the following:

* Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent with Minimum 10 years of job\-related experience
* Degree or Honours in Engineering/Computer Science/Mathematics/Sciences/Commerce.
* Software Engineering experience.
* Proven experience in implementing high volume eCommerce solutions utilizing enterprise grade eCommerce platforms
* Must have experience in integrating, CMS, PIM, storefronts, Customer Data Platform and Personalization solutions including prior experience in A/B/N testing platforms and gamification solutions.
* Must be hands\-on in integrating SaaS platforms with enterprise systems using proven middleware technology
* Demonstrated experience in database technologies, distributed, event\-driven and micro services architecture
* Excellent understanding of DevOps, Dev/SecOps methodologies and Software Quality Assurance processes.
* Must possess expertise in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Integration patterns and software design and development.
* Must have hands\-on experience in utilizing AI tools and skills in systems development and implementation
* Expertise in Large and Critical Product design, full\-stack development.
* Expertise in area(s) of architecture cloud technologies, domain such as data, infrastructure, application, business, and/or Software development.
* Must have good analytical skills and ability to troubleshoot and solve problems.
* Must be hands\-on with IT solutions, technical framework design and latest tools \& technologies.
* Ability to foster teamwork among team members.
* Ability to effectively communicate with peers and Senior stakeholders.


Preferred

* Retail \& Hospitality combined with eCommerce industry experience will be advantageous.
* Experience in a relevant architecture domain such as data, infrastructure, application, business, and/or Software development and maintenance, with key roles played in design and production maintenance, support, and performance management.
* Managerial skills: Ability to coach and develop team skills. Ability to delegate work, set clear direction, manage workflow and conflict resolution.
* Ability to learn and adapt to emerging technologies.

**About Qatar Airways Group:**


Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community.

**How to Apply**
If you are interested in submitting your application and feel you are a good fit for this role, please complete our application form and upload your CV for our review and consideration.

Dit is een sterk samenwerkende rol waarin technologie, inhoudelijke expertise en gebruikersbehoeften samenkomen. Daarom zoeken we iemand die nieuwsgierig is, sterk op de gebruiker gericht, en graag zowel het zakelijke domein als de mensen die dagelijks met de software werken wil begrijpen.
  
  

**Je verantwoordelijkheden:**

new_jobs.title: Sales Engineer - Netherlands
new_jobs.description:
Chemelex is a global leader in electric thermal and sensing solutions, protecting the world’s critical processes, places and people. With over 50 years of innovation and a commitment to excellence, we develop solutions that ensure safety, reliability, and efficiency in diverse environments – from industrial plants and data centers to people’s homes. We deliver future\-ready technologies, advanced engineering capabilities and local expertise backed by global standards. Our offering includes a leading portfolio from our trusted brands: Raychem, Tracer, Nuheat and Pyrotenax.
  
  

**What you will experience in this position:**  

This is a technical and commercial sales role serving a wide range of industries, including oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, power, water, food and beverage and other process industries. You will sell electrical heat\-tracing and thermal\-management products, services and project solutions to industrial end users, contractors and OEM customers.
  
The territory will primarily cover West \& Central Netherlands, with clear ownership of both existing account development and active hunting/new business within the assigned territory.
  
Through frequent direct customer visits, you will develop relationships with existing and new customers, understand their applications and promote innovative solutions to the relevant stakeholders within each opportunity.
  
By actively contributing to the development and execution of the Benelux sales strategy, you will take ownership of your assigned accounts and territory and deliver sustainable and profitable growth for Chemelex.
  
  

**Key responsibilities:**  

* Develop existing customers and identify new business opportunities.
* Build strong relationships with industrial end users, contractors and OEM customers.
* Visit customers throughout the assigned territory and understand their applications, projects and commercial needs.
* Use a consultative sales approach to translate customer requirements into suitable Chemelex products, services and solutions.
* Manage opportunities from initial contact through quotation, negotiation and closing.
* Deliver agreed sales, margin and growth targets for the assigned customer portfolio and territory.
* Grow recurring business and local industrial projects by developing new customers and the existing installed base.
* Promote the complete Chemelex product range, including new solutions, upgrades and specialist applications.
* Deliver customer presentations, product training and lunch\-and\-learn sessions where these support business development.
* Maintain an accurate overview of customer activities, opportunities and sales forecasts in the CRM system.
* Develop and execute account plans for priority customers, including clear growth opportunities and actions.
* Monitor market developments, planned customer investments and competitor activity.
* Work closely with technical and commercial colleagues to provide customers with the right solution.


**Candidate Profile:**  

* Bachelor’s level in engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or another relevant technical field, or equivalent through experience.
* Approximately 3–5 years of technical B2B sales experience.
* Experience in industrial electrical products, process technology, instrumentation, HVAC or related technical solutions is preferred.
* Experience working with industrial end users, contractors or OEM customers is an advantage.
* Commercially driven and comfortable developing new business.
* Able to understand technical applications and explain customer value clearly.
* Independent, structured and comfortable managing customers across a sales territory.
* Fluent in Dutch and able to communicate professionally in English.
* The ability to speak and write French is an advantage.
* Comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel; experience with Salesforce or another CRM system is preferred.
* Willing to travel regularly throughout the Benelux, primarily within the Netherlands, and holds a valid driving license.


**Preferred experience:**  

* Basic knowledge of electrical heat tracing or low\-voltage electrical power distribution.
* Knowledge of, or experience within, one or more relevant industrial sectors, such as refining, petrochemicals, chemical processing, power generation or utilities.


**Working arrangements:**  

* This is a home\-based field\-sales position with regular travel throughout the assigned territory.
* The role requires frequent customer visits and occasional presence at Chemelex offices, production locations, project sites and internal meetings.
* Approximately 50% travel may be required, primarily within the Netherlands and occasionally elsewhere in the Benelux.


**What we offer:**  

* Competitive base salary plus a Sales Incentive Plan (SIP)
* 8% holiday allowance
* 13th month
* Company car
* 27 days of annual leave plus 6 ADV (working\-time reduction) days per year for full\-time employees
* Pension plan with an employee contribution of 3\.5%
* Access to collective health insurance
* Employer\-paid WIA and WIA accident insurance
* Worldwide business travel assistance
* Sports contribution of up to €25 net per month
* Tablet, phone, printer


**At Chemelex:**  

We protect places of progress through electric excellence.
  
Pioneering plants, sprawling data centers, busy transport hubs, and your own home. These are the places that bring progress to the world, and the places that we protect with time\-tested technologies, advanced engineering, and a suite of services. Because here, excellence is everything.
  
Our Dimensions of Excellence reflect the core values of Chemelex. Together, they inspire our decisions and guide our actions – defining excellence in our work for colleagues, customers and communities.
  
* Experts with empathy
* Explorer mindset
* Example for others
* Exceptional impact


​We are committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by national, federal, state or local law.

new_jobs.title: Jr. Automation Engineer
Commissioning Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een engineer die erbij wil zijn als een nieuwe installatie voor het eerst echt gaat draaien. Iemand die een systeem kan brengen van "het werkte in de pilot" naar "het draait elke dag in productie". Onze technologie is nieuw en uniek, dus de meeste antwoorden bestaan nog niet. Jij helpt ze te vinden.

**Over Myne**
-------------


Myne Circular Metals ontwikkelt technologieën die een van de meest urgente uitdagingen in de grondstoffensector aanpakken: de uitputting van hoogwaardige metalen en de milieukosten van de productie ervan. Onze kerntechnologieën, de Xorter en MDX, zetten chaotische metaalafvalstromen om in grondstoffen die qua kwaliteit gelijkwaardig zijn aan primaire metalen, tegen lagere kosten en zonder downcycling. Dit doen we met \~75 mensen in Harderwijk, een jaaromzet van €400M en nauwe samenwerkingen met universiteiten en specialisten. We schalen snel op, met ambitieuze technische ontwikkelingen die nog volop in gang zijn.

**Rolomschrijving**
-------------------


Bij Myne staan engineers dicht bij het werk, en deze rol is geen uitzondering. Als Commissioning Engineer breng je nieuwe technologie en de installatie eromheen van pilot naar volledige productie en werk je aan de optimalisatie.

* **Commissioning:** je bouwt op, start op en valideert elk component tot het de prestatiedoelen haalt. Dat geldt ook voor nieuwe, zelf ontwikkelde technologie.
* **Optimalisatie:** je zet wat er misgaat om in blijvende verbeteringen, via instellingen, aanpassingen en werk dat je zelf met je handen doet.


Je werkt nauw samen met de engineers die de technologie hebben ontwikkeld. Zij weten hoe het ontworpen is, jij weet hoe het zich in de praktijk gedraagt met echt materiaal in de handen van echte operators. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van het Operations\-team in Harderwijk en de fabrieksvloer waar je je dag grotendeels doorbrengt.

### **Verantwoordelijkheden**

* **Eigenaarschap:** Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor nieuwe systemen en de installatie eromheen, van eerste opstart tot volledige productie
* **Commissioning:** Nieuwe componenten opbouwen, opstarten en valideren tot ze hun prestatiedoelen halen
* **Troubleshooten:** De oorzaak achterhalen wanneer een systeem zich anders gedraagt dan verwacht en werken aan een oplossing, of die nu in de mechanica, het proces of de manier van bedienen zit
* **Optimaliseren:** Bevindingen omzetten in blijvende verbeteringen via instellingen, aanpassingen en werk dat je zelf met je handen doet
* **Samen verbeteren:** Met andere teams werken aan ontwerpverbeteringen, en echte productiedata en storingsoorzaken terugkoppelen zodat we blijven verbeteren
* **Overdragen:** De procedures schrijven en de operators opleiden, zodat de fabriek ook zonder jou goed draait

**Wat we zoeken**
-----------------

* **Ervaring:** 0–3 jaar. Je hebt een technische basis in werktuigbouwkunde, industriële techniek of procestechniek en hebt bij voorkeur al met echte apparatuur gewerkt. Of dat uit een opleiding, stage, afstudeerproject of werkplaats komt, maakt niet uit; wat telt is dat je het in de praktijk kunt toepassen.
* **Hands\-on:** Je pakt liever zelf een sleutel om het uit te zoeken dan dat je wacht tot iemand het uitlegt. Je voelt je thuis rond pompen, leidingen, transportbanden en besturingskasten.
* **Diagnostisch inzicht:** Als iets niet werkt, werk je terug naar de oorzaak in plaats van te gokken. Je houdt bij wat je hebt veranderd en wat dat deed.
* **Technisch inzicht:** Je begrijpt hoe materiaal zich door een systeem beweegt en wat er verandert als je iets aanpast. Je kunt P\&ID's en PFD's lezen, of je wilt dat leren.
* **Zelfstandigheid:** Je neemt de leiding over jouw systemen, stelt je eigen prioriteiten en weet wanneer een probleem te groot is en opgeschaald moet worden.
* **Samenwerken:** Je werkt goed samen met operators en technici, en net zo makkelijk met de engineers die het systeem hebben ontworpen.
* **On\-site:** Harderwijk, dagelijks in een industriële omgeving waar dingen nog worden uitgezocht, en dat is precies wat het interessant maakt.
* **Opleiding:** HBO Werktuigbouwkunde, Industriële Techniek of Procestechniek, of gelijkwaardige ervaring.

**Wat we bieden**
-----------------

* **Salaris:** €3\.000–€4\.500 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring en kennis (0–3 jaar)
* **Bonus:** Jaarlijkse prestatiebonus op basis van jouw bijdrage
* **Flexibele uren:** 32–40 uur per week
* **Arbeidsvoorwaarden:** Volledige reiskostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling
* **Impact:** Baanbrekende recyclingtechnologie met een directe bijdrage aan de circulaire economie, samen met toonaangevende onderzoeksinstellingen
* **Team:** Een multidisciplinair team waar diverse achtergronden en de beste ideeën echt gewaardeerd worden
* **Groei:** Ontwikkelmogelijkheden die passen bij jouw ambities

**Solliciteren**
----------------


Enthousiast na het lezen van deze vacature? We verwelkomen jouw sollicitatie, **ook als je niet aan alle genoemde criteria voldoet.** Solliciteer vandaag nog en draag met ons bij aan een duurzame toekomst.

* Techniek
