*Deze vacature sluit op 30 september 2026*


Bestaande installaties en complete nieuwbouwprojecten uitbreiden. Dat doe je als Junior secundair engineer vanuit locatie Amsterdam. Samen met de beste vakspecialisten vorm je een team om samen die klus te klaren. Dat betekent een afwisselende functie met genoeg vrijheid voor nieuwe inzichten. Dit betreft een functie van minimaal 32 uur. Jij maakt het net professioneler bij Alliander.


**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


**De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als junior secundair engineer**


Het ontwerpen van de besturing, signalering en de beveiliging van de midden\- en hoogspanningsinstallaties van Liander en TenneT. Zo werk jij aan een duurzame toekomst. In jouw projecten stel jij de specificaties op en werk je die met jouw team uit tot in detail. Jij stelt samen ontwerpen en bijbehorende begrotingen op naar aanleiding van klantvragen. Samen met de projectmanager en sitemanager worden jouw projecten goed opgeleverd. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als junior secundair engineer werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met het:


* meedraaien met engineeringsteams voor het ontwerpen van besturing bewaking en beveiliging van nieuwe of bestaande hoogspanning stations;
* begeleiden en beoordelen van offertes en uitbestedingstrajecten tot na de gunning;
* het overdragen van je ontwerpen naar de realisatie, tijdens de realisatie toelichten van je ontwerp;
* sparren met collega’s over je ontwerp;
* jezelf ontwikkelen, kennis op doen, groeien in je vak;
* samenwerken in het engineeringswerk en de afstemmen met andere disciplines.

**Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander**


Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten.


En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Qirion. Hier houd jij je bezig met de energie\-infrastructuur en slimme energieoplossingen. Zo ontwerp, bouw en onderhoud je het hoogspanningsnet van vandaag en de toekomst.


De afdeling Engineering bestaat uit kundige en behulpzame collega’s. In dit multidisciplinaire team is er ruimte voor lol en werken we aan veilige, betrouwbare en technisch haalbare ontwerpen. Je komt terecht in een snel groeiende organisatie met volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.


**Jij maakt het net energieker**

Werken met de nieuwste technieken en innovaties.Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw Focus op de toekomst? Geweldig! Zeker als je dit aanvult met:


* een afgeronde hbo\-/of wo\- opleiding elektrotechniek, energietechniek, industriële automatisering of vergelijkbaar;
* Je passie ligt bij bewaken, besturen en beveiligen, je wilt je verder ontwikkelen en uitgroeien tot een Senior Secundaire engineer.
* Werkervaring in de hoogspanning, energietechniek of industriële automatisering is een pré;
* Kennis van systems engineering, besturen, beveiligen en meten van (hoogspannings\-) installaties is een pré;
* Kennis van midden\- en hoogspanningsinstallaties is een pré;
* Ervaring met teken/ontwerp systemen zoals ELCAD is een pré;
* Klantgerichtheid: je begrijpt dat alles wat we doen uiteindelijk impact heeft op onze klanten, en je handelt daar ook naar.

**Voor jou net beter geregeld**


Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40\-urige werkweek:


* een salaris tussen €3729,68 en € 5\.948,46 bruto per maand (schaal 7 of 8\);
* elke maand bovenop je salaris, een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past;

* het Duurzame Inzetbaarheidsbudget (DIB). Hiervoor krijg je € 500 euro per jaar en die kan je inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld arboproof thuiswerkmeubilair, loopbaanontwikkeling, vakliteratuur, sportabonnement of coaching;
* een NS\-Business Card, zodat je duurzaam kan reizen. Kom je met eigen vervoer? Dan krijg je een kilometervergoeding.

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.


**Voor jou net wat meer informatie**

new_jobs.title: Vacature: CI/CD Platform Engineer - View vacancy
new_jobs.description:
As a CI/CD Platform Engineer in The Hague, you work on the foundations that support software delivery at NN. You build and integrate the tools and services that teams rely on to develop, test, and deploy applications securely and efficiently. By strengthening these shared platforms, you contribute to NN’s ambition to support change and help ensure reliable digital services for customers and society.


**What you are going to do**


In this role, you shape and evolve NN’s CI/CD platforms that are used by engineers throughout the organisation. The focus is on creating stable, scalable solutions that integrate seamlessly into the broader IT landscape. You balance standardisation with flexibility, making sure tooling supports a wide range of teams while meeting security and compliance requirements.


Key responsibilities:


* Developing Python\-based automation to remove manual operational work and reduce toil for engineers
* Building and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK to support secure and scalable platforms
* Supporting internal CDaaS users by answering operational questions and improving how tools are used
* Contributing to platform improvements that automate security, compliance and developer enablement

**What we offer you**


NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you:


* Salary between €4,527 and €6,036, based on 36 hours and depending on your knowledge and experience
* 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary
* 27 vacation days for a 5\-day working week and three Diversity Days
* A modern pension administered by BeFrank
* Plenty of training and learning opportunities
* NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately.
* Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometers travelled
* Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use

At NN, we work in a hybrid way. In consultation with your team, you’ll determine where and when you work. Your official workplace is The Hague.


**Who you are**


You enjoy collaborating closely with colleagues, learning together through practices such as pair or mob programming, and continuously improving how tools and services are used. Making complex topics, such as security and compliance easier for engineers, comes naturally to you.


You also have:


* The ability to develop Python code that automates operational work and reduces manual effort
* Hands\-on involvement with infrastructure as code, for example, by working with AWS CDK or similar tools
* Practical knowledge of Kubernetes within a professional engineering environment
* A track record of supporting internal users by answering operational questions and improving platform usability
* A strong focus on improving developer experience through automation of security, compliance and delivery workflows

**Who you will work with**


You will join the CI/CD Platform Team, part of NN’s Engineering Experience \& Platforms domain. The team comprises a diverse group of platform engineers with various backgrounds and areas of expertise, working closely together to support engineers across the organisation. The atmosphere is open and collaborative, with a strong focus on knowledge sharing, pair programming and continuous improvement. Team members regularly gather at the office on Wednesdays, where working side by side and participating in team activities strengthen collaboration.


**Any questions?**


Are you excited about this vacancy? Do you think you would be a good fit for NN and the team? Then we invite you to apply. We are eager to learn more about who you are, what motivates you and what you can contribute.


For questions about the recruitment process, feel free to contact Bianca Schaareman, Talent Acquisition Specialist, via bianca.schaareman@nn\-group.com.

**Bij** **NN** **geloven we dat onze verschillen ons sterker maken.**


We verwelkomen talent in alle vormen en waarderen de unieke ervaringen, achtergronden, perspectieven en kwaliteiten die iedereen meebrengt. Daarom bouwen we aan een inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom, gewaardeerd en vrij voelt om zichzelf te zijn.


Twijfel je of je aan alle functie\-eisen voldoet? Laat dat je niet tegenhouden om te solliciteren. We zijn niet alleen geïnteresseerd in je ervaring, maar ook in je motivatie, je potentieel en de impact die je wilt maken.


**Be yourself. You belong at NN.**

Je wordt doorgestuurd naar NN's recruitment systeem, Workday, waar je kunt solliciteren en jouw sollicitatie kunt beheren.

Recruiter


Send email to Bianca Schaareman

new_jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren testautomatiseerder die graag het verschil maakt? Bij de Belastingdienst in Apeldoorn werk je aan veilige, betrouwbare IT\-oplossingen die impact hebben op miljoenen mensen. In deze rol (32\-36 uur per week) krijg je volop ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten, collega’s te coachen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.


* Bachelor\-hbo
* 32\-36 uur
* ICT
* € 4\.132,\- / € 6\.275,\- bruto p.m.
* Apeldoorn
  
* 


* Reageer t/m 7 oktober 2026
**Dit doe je bij de Belastingdienst**
-------------------------------------

Als senior testautomatiseerder ben jij dé specialist die features vertaalt naar userstories en testscenario’s ontwikkelt op basis van jobflows. Je voert functionele, regressie\- en ketentesten uit en automatiseert testprocessen. Daarnaast stel je testplannen en rapportages op en werk je met moderne technologieën zoals Java, Angular en Tekton. Je ondersteunt developers bij het configureren van pipelines en bepaalt de teststrategie.


Je hebt een kritische blik op kwaliteit, begeleidt een junior tester en coacht collega’s. Jij zorgt dat fouten vroeg worden opgespoord en neemt stakeholders mee in testresultaten. Zo verbeter je continu de ontwikkelcyclus en de betrouwbaarheid van onze applicaties.


Je komt terecht in een ervaren team van 5 bouwers en 3 testers (waarvan 2 senior). Deze positie vervangt een externe kracht, waardoor jij als vaste collega écht het verschil kunt maken en langdurig kunt bijdragen aan onze softwarekwaliteit


**Een bijzondere baan, omdat...**
---------------------------------

* je bijdraagt aan de technologische vernieuwing van de Belastingdienst.
* je de kans krijgt om met de nieuwste technologieën te werken.
* je zowel functionele als technische expertise inzet om software van hoge kwaliteit te leveren.
* je collega’s coacht en begeleidt in hun ontwikkeling.
* je invloed hebt op de teststrategie en kwaliteit van applicaties.
* je werkt in een hecht team met veel kennis en fijne samenwerking.

* **De afdeling \- Directie Informatievoorziening**
-------------------------------------------------

Toon inhoud van De afdeling \- Directie Informatievoorziening


De directie Informatievoorziening is hét ICT\-bedrijf van de Belastingdienst. Met ruim 3\.000 collega’s zorgen we dat Nederland kan rekenen op betrouwbare informatievoorzieningen en ICT\-systemen. Heel Nederland? Ja, onze ‘klanten’ zijn niet alleen Belastingdienstmedewerkers, maar ook 8\.600 grote ondernemers, 2,2 miljoen mkb\-ondernemers en 8,5 miljoen burgers. En wist je dat wij werken volgens een agile\-mindset? Open, transparant en gericht op leren en kennis delen. Door de toepassing van een DevOps\-werkwijze en ons aanbod van geautomatiseerde technieken kunnen de systemen van de Belastingdienst dagelijks miljoenen data en euro’s verwerken.


Bij ons werk je in een moderne tech\-organisatie met ménsen als kloppend hart. Of je nu als engineer of in een andere rol bijdraagt aan effectieve ICT; jouw inzet doet ertoe. Net als jouw ontwikkeling, waarin wij graag investeren. En jouw ideeën, waar we graag naar luisteren. Ook is er volop ruimte om samen te innoveren met externe partijen. Niet alleen om te moderniseren, maar vooral om nieuwe producten en diensten te ontwikkelen die passen bij de belevingswereld van burgers, bedrijven en collega’s.
*“In dit team werken we met de nieuwste technologieën en dat maakt ons werk spannend. We verbeteren continu onze processen en ondersteunen elkaar goed. Ik waardeer vooral de samenwerking en de mogelijkheid om impact te maken.”* Mark, testautomatiseerder en scrummaster


**Wanneer past deze baan bij je?**
----------------------------------

* Je hebt een hbo\-werk\- en \-denkniveau en minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als testautomatiseerder of vergelijkbaar.
* Je hebt ervaring met functionele testen, regressietesten, ketentesten en testautomatisering.
* Je hebt ervaring met het Robot\-framework en met het testen van Java\-applicaties.


**Jouw competenties**
---------------------

* klantgerichtheid
* resultaatgerichtheid
* plannen en organiseren
* samenwerken
* analyseren


**Meer over de vacature?**
--------------------------

### **Neem contact op met Richard Wolbrink, teamleider**

* Contact via Whatsapp: 06 25 27 32 55
* 06 25 27 32 55
**Solliciteren bij de Belastingdienst**
---------------------------------------

Het sollicitatietraject bij de Belastingdienst loopt via onderstaande stappen. Hiermee willen we zo veel mogelijk te weten komen over jou, maar laten we je ook kennismaken met ons.


1
### **Sollicitatie \+ selectie**

Solliciteren is mogelijk tot aan de deadline die in de vacaturetekst genoemd wordt. We beoordelen je cv en motivatiebrief op de genoemde functie\-eisen.


2
### **Voorselectietest**

Voor sommige functies is een online voorselectietest onderdeel van de procedure. In dat geval ontvang je per e\-mail meer informatie over de procedure en de uiterlijke inlevertermijn. Het maken van de test duurt ongeveer 120 minuten. De test kan in de meeste gevallen thuis worden gemaakt.


3
### **Sollicitatiegesprek**

We nodigen je per telefoon of e\-mail uit voor een sollicitatiegesprek, waarin een selectiecommissie je beoordeelt op de competenties van de functie aan de hand van een competentiegericht gesprek.


4
### **Assessment**

Een assessment kan deel uitmaken van de procedure. In dat geval word je telefonisch of per e\-mail hiervoor uitgenodigd.


5
### **Arbeidsvoorwaarden**

We nodigen je uit voor een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. Na een positieve afronding, treffen we samen verdere voorbereidingen voor jouw eerste werkdag! Wil je alvast meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Op P\-direkt vind je informatie over onderwerpen zoals financiën, vrije dagen, loopbaanontwikkeling, rechten en regels en nog veel meer.

  

* 
* **Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden**
---------------------------

Toon inhoud van Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden


### **Salarisniveau**

Schaal 11


### **Salarisomschrijving**

Individuele schaalInschaling vindt plaats in de bij de functie behorende salarisschaal. Elke salarisschaal kent 11 salarisnummers met bijbehorende maandbedragen; deze staan vermeld in de salaristabel op de website CAO Rijk. De inschaling vindt plaats op basis van relevante kennis en het aantal relevante werkervaringsjaren passend bij de uit te voeren werkzaamheden in de nieuwe functie.Als voorbeeld: met 3 jaar relevante werkervaring word je ingeschaald in nummer 3 van de betreffende salarisschaal.


### **Maandsalaris**

Min €4\.132,\- \- €6\.275,\- (bruto)


### **Dienstverband**

Bepaalde tijd, voorafgaand aan onbepaalde tijd


### **Minimum aantal uren per week**

32


### **Maximum aantal uren per week**

36


### **Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden**

Naast salaris ontvang je ook een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Jouw IKB bestaat uit geld (IKB\-budget) en tijd (IKB\-uren). Het IKB geeft je de mogelijkheid om naar eigen keuze een deel van je IKB\-budget te laten uitbetalen op de door jou gekozen tijdstippen. Én je hebt de mogelijkheid om je IKB\-budget deels om te zetten in verlof of andersom. Ook kun je het IKB\-budget besteden aan een fiscaal\-vriendelijk doel, zoals bijvoorbeeld een fiets, bedrijfsfitness of vakliteratuur.


De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer studiefaciliteiten, ouderschapsverlof en een vergoeding woon\-werkverkeer.


Wij verwachten van onze werknemers dat ze integer zijn en we vragen aan nieuwe medewerkers een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Als deze niet kan worden overlegd voor de indiensttreding, volgt geen arbeidsovereenkomst.

------------------------------------------------------

Toon inhoud van Bijzonderheden \- Belangrijk voor je sollicitatie!


We ontvangen je brief en cv graag in een Word\- of PDF\-bestand. Neem in de bestandsnaam jouw voor\- en achternaam op. Als je een beroep doet op een voorrangspositie, stuur dan ook een kopie van die kennisgeving mee.


Onze selectieprocedure voor deze functie ziet er als volgt uit:


	+ Allereerst wordt beoordeeld of een voorrangskandidaat binnen de Rijksoverheid in aanmerking komt voor deze functie.
	+ Daarna wordt beoordeeld of jouw cv en motivatiebrief voldoen aan de gestelde functie\-eisen.

De voorkeur gaat uit naar kandidaten die het meest aansluiten bij het opgestelde profiel. Dit heeft betrekking op zowel de genoemde kennis en werkervaring als op het opleidingsniveau. Vermeld deze daarom duidelijk in je cv.


De Belastingdienst zet zich in voor de banenafspraak: zoveel mogelijk banen realiseren voor mensen met een arbeidsbeperking. Val jij in deze doelgroep? Wij zullen je ondersteunen zodat je optimaal kunt functioneren, en daarmee jouw bijdrage aan Nederland kunt leveren. Of het nu gaat om aanpassingen op je werkplek, bepaalde voorzieningen in het vervoer of bijvoorbeeld vergoedingen van het UWV: samen met jou, je leidinggevende én een jobcoach gaan wij kijken naar jouw kwaliteiten en mogelijkheden om een passend werkpakket uit te voeren. Een (online) voorselectietest en/of een assessment kan deel uit maken van de sollicitatieprocedure, evenals het maken van een casus, het opvragen van referenties en (online) screening, bijvoorbeeld via databanken, (zoekmachines) en sociale netwerken.

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product **Playtime Arcade**, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in\-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

**Keeping Platform Stability Front and Center for 770M\+ Users**


On the frontier of adjoe's most critical publisher relationships, the Product Operations team moves fast, cuts through complexity, and keeps our entire platform running. Operating across the full adjoe stack—backend services, SDKs, catalog, and integrations—we unblock strategic launches, build custom integrations, and resolve critical issues in production.


We act as the safety net for our product teams and the first line of defense for enterprise publishers like Venmo and PayPal. Beyond immediate troubleshooting, we build and scale high\-impact diagnostic tooling to automate root\-cause resolution across client\-side and microservice architectures. Combining cross\-stack technical depth with rapid execution, Product Operations ensures seamless performance wherever enterprise growth meets global scale.

**Your Mission \& Who We Are Looking For:**

* **5\+ years in Go, built for scale.** You have 3\+ years building production Go services and know how to profile and optimize applications under real traffic, not just identify bottlenecks, but eliminate them. You've worked on large Go applications with considerable daily request volume.
* **Distributed systems are your default context.** You design and operate microservice architectures using **Kafka** and **SQS/SNS** for reliable asynchronous communication, and are responsible for collecting and aggregating billions of daily API events into **Kafka** streams queryable from the data lake in seconds.
* **Data performance matters at every layer.** You work with **Druid**, **MySQL**, **Redis**, and **DynamoDB**, optimizing queries and data access patterns to deliver few\-millisecond response times. You know the tradeoffs between different storage solutions and when each one is the right tool.
* **Bridge product and Data Science.** You collaborate directly with Data Scientists to integrate ML algorithms that optimize ad delivery: translating complex mathematical solutions into production\-ready backend services.
* **Partner\-facing data ownership.** You support partners through well\-documented open APIs, providing raw or aggregated data transparently based on their business needs.
* **Infrastructure fluency is part of the job.** You have hands\-on experience with **Terraform**, **Docker**, and serverless infrastructure, owning services end\-to\-end from development to production.

**We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.**

**What’s in It for You?**


At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

* **Go Big.** Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.
* **Move Fast.** Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.
* **Be Direct.** Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.
* **Thrive Together.** Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.
* **Have Fun.** Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.


We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

new_jobs.title: Senior Scientist – Optimization Algorithms & Software Development (m/f/x)
new_jobs.description:
ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology


Enabler for smaller, more powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips


Working for tomorrow today.


Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are produced using ZEISS technologies. As the centerpiece of every electronically controlled system, they have become an integral part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in the field of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high\-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, increasingly powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips, and thus plays a pivotal role in the age of micro\- and nanoelectronics.


As a developer for the system optimization of EUV lithography systems, you will help advance some of the world’s most sophisticated optical systems for semiconductor manufacturing. You will develop physical and mathematical models, optimization algorithms, and robust software solutions used in both system development and production. Working closely with experts from optical design, metrology, process development, production, system engineering, and software development, you will turn complex technical challenges into scalable and sustainable solutions. Depending on the task, you will coordinate technical activities or small expert teams and take responsibility for the quality, schedule, and results of your work.


**Your Role**
=============

* Design, refine, and implement physical and mathematical models as well as numerical algorithms for the adjustment and optimization of complex optical systems.
* Analyze system and production behavior, identify optimization potential, and validate solutions through simulations and experiments under realistic conditions.
* Translate mathematical and physical concepts into robust, maintainable, and testable software used in development and production, primarily in MATLAB and complementary software environments.
* Shape and drive the evolution of our software architecture, including modularization, interfaces, data flows, reusable components, and automated testing—while ensuring the continued operation of existing functionality.
* Establish and promote modern software development practices across projects through code and design reviews, regression testing, version control, knowledge sharing, pairing, and technical mentoring.
* Coordinate activities across optical design, metrology, production, system engineering, and customer interfaces; where appropriate, lead small expert teams and support the introduction of new processes and future technologies.

**Your Profile**
================

* A degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, natural sciences, or a related field; a PhD is an advantage.
* Strong expertise in mathematical optimization, numerical methods, physical modeling, or related algorithmic disciplines, with experience applying them to complex technical systems.
* Extensive experience in software and algorithm development, ideally for scientific, technical, or production\-related applications.
* Strong proficiency in MATLAB; experience with Python, C\#, C\+\+, or comparable languages is an advantage.
* Sound knowledge of software architecture and design, including modularization, interfaces, maintainability, testability, reusable components, and the incremental modernization of existing software systems.
* A proven ability to connect physical domain knowledge, mathematical algorithms, and professional software engineering, combined with fluent English at C1 level and a pragmatic, structured, and collaborative working style.

Your ZEISS Recruiting Team:


Sandra Köhler

new_jobs.title: Support Engineer (Snowflake)
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Legal \& General (L\&G) is a leading UK financial services group and major global investor.

**We’ve been safeguarding people’s financial futures since 1836, and strive to build a better society, while improving the lives of our customers and creating value for shareholders.**


We are one of the world’s largest asset managers and provide powerful asset origination capabilities. Together, these underpin our retirement and protection solutions: we are an international player in pension risk transfer, in UK and US life insurance, and in UK workplace pensions and retirement income.

**Who we are**


Our Retail business supports customers throughout their lives, to help them save, plan, protect and enjoy retirement.


We’re a leading provider of retirement and protection solutions. We aim to support our c.12\.8 million policyholders and workplace members throughout their lifelong financial journeys.


We focus on helping the customers of today and tomorrow achieve better long\-term outcomes. We either talk with them directly or work with intermediaries and employers to meet their needs. We use the latest technology to connect with them quickly, efficiently and wherever possible in highly personalised ways.

 **Job Description**  

We’re looking for a Support Engineer to help keep our data services running smoothly. You’ll join a collaborative support team responsible for our Snowflake data warehouse, investigating pipeline issues, responding to internal queries and helping colleagues access the accurate data they need.


This is an opportunity to work with Snowflake, DBT, SQL and Azure technology in a varied environment where your troubleshooting and communication skills will be equally valued. We welcome candidates from different backgrounds who can demonstrate the relevant skills, even if they do not meet every desirable requirement.


What you'll be doing:

* Monitoring scheduled ETL jobs and data ingestion pipelines
* Confirming that data has loaded successfully into Snowflake
* Investigating pipeline failures and coordinating timely resolutions
* Responding to incidents and service requests from internal colleagues
* Troubleshooting missing, incomplete or inconsistent data
* Supporting technical and non\-technical users with Snowflake queries
* Communicating progress and solutions in clear, accessible language
* Prioritising issues effectively within a fast\-paced support environment


Who we're looking for:

* Practical experience of working with Snowflake
* Good working knowledge of DBT
* Strong SQL skills
* Previous experience within a support or service desk environment
* Effective troubleshooting and analytical problem\-solving skills
* An approachable communication style and the ability to explain technical subjects clearly
* The ability to remain organised and make sound decisions under pressure
* Experience of Azure Data Factory or the wider Azure ecosystem would be beneficial


Whatever your role, we reward performance and behaviour with a package that looks after all the things that are important to you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

* The opportunity to participate in our annual, performance \-related bonus plan and valuable share schemes
* Generous pension contribution
* Life assurance
* Healthcare Plan (permanent employees only)
* At least 25 days holiday, plus public holidays, 26 days after 2 years’ service. There’s also the option to buy and sell holiday
* Competitive family leave
* Participate in our electric car scheme, which offers employees the option to hire a brand\-new electric car through tax efficient salary sacrifice (permanent employees only)
* There are many discounts we offer – both for our own products and at a range of high street stores and online
* We’re creating net‑zero carbon workplaces by 2030 by investing in our sustainable, modern offices across the UK, all designed to bring people together and elevate the in‑person experience


\#LI\-NH1

 **Additional Information**  

At L\&G, we believe it's possible to generate positive returns today while helping to build a better future for all.


If you join us, you’ll be part of a welcoming, inclusive culture, with opportunities to collaborate with people of diverse backgrounds, views, and experiences. Guided by leaders with integrity who care about your future and wellbeing. Empowered through initiatives which support people to develop their careers and excel.


We care passionately about outcomes rather than attendance and are therefore open to discussing all kinds of flexible working options including part\-time and job shares. Although some roles have limited flexibility due to customer demand, we accommodate requests when we can.


It doesn’t matter if you don’t meet every single criterion in this advert. Instead, think about what you excel at and what else you can bring in terms of strengths, potential and connection to our purpose.

new_jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Hybrid)
new_jobs.description:
**Principal Engineer**
======================


**Location**: Waterloo, London, England, UK \| **Hybrid** (1 day per week in office)



**Who We Are**
--------------



At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.



Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early\-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.



Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands\-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.



If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.


**Who You Are**
---------------



You’ve shown long\-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 10\+ years. You are a trusted expert and leader, often called upon to guide ambiguous initiatives and architect scalable solutions. You bring a blend of deep consulting acumen, technical expertise, and product thinking that drives measurable and impactful outcomes. In your previous experience, you have:


* Built and shipped production\-grade platforms: the reusable foundations, tools, infrastructure, and workflows that help other teams shift faster and more reliably
* Taken AI and agentic systems from prototype to production, with a strong understanding of infrastructure, authentication, and observability
* Delivered on high\-stakes consulting engagements across multiple language paradigms, stacks, ecosystems, and client industries
* Built high\-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served
* Led the development and delivery of production\-grade software using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C\#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL
* Actively experimented with AI development tools and translated that experimentation into faster, higher\-quality delivery for your teams
* A track record of understanding, assessing, and embracing new tooling and trends within the software industry
* Built or integrated AI/ML features into products and systems, including recommendation engines, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, RAG pipelines, and agents
* Successfully led modernisation and replatforming efforts to align legacy systems with short and long\-term business needs
* Led and delivered solutions to architecture\-level problems including scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and observability
* Facilitated alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders to move initiatives forward through ambiguity and complexity
* Provided mentorship and team support at scale, while sharing knowledge and improving team practices
* Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
* Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

**What You’ll Do At 8th Light**
-------------------------------



As a go\-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:


* Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives
* Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long\-term technical vision to what ships
* Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long\-term vision to what ships
* Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high\-quality work within deadlines
* Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes
* Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
* Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions
* Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
* Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
* Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
* Designing and managing high\-level technical roadmaps for large engagements
* Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain
* Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices
* Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization
* Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre\-sales scope shaping
* Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep\-dives to improve team and project outcomes
* Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
* Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
* Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform\- or product\-oriented development
* Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices
* Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale

**Strongly Preferred Skills**
-----------------------------



We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:


* Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
* Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
* Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
* DevSecOps \& DevOps
* MLOps
* Infrastructure as Code


Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real\-world career experiences.


**How You’ll be Supported**
---------------------------



At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well\-being, and success shape our future.


* Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
* A robust L\&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert\-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
* Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning \& development
* Coworking support for our global team
* 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

  


**A Note on Compensation**
--------------------------



At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.



We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Principal Engineer position within London is: £92,818\-£116,122 GBP



Reach out to recruiting@8thlight.com for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.


**8th Light Hubs and Geographies**
----------------------------------



8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.


* **London Co\-working:** Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co\-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.


We hope to see you apply!



\#LI\-Hybrid

**A Note on Your Privacy**
--------------------------



At 8th Light, one of our core values is ***Honesty that builds trust*** — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of *who we are*, *what we're looking for*, and *how we handle your information* throughout the process.

new_jobs.title: Protection and Control Design Engineer
new_jobs.description:
**Base Location**: Melksham, Oxford, Reading, Slough or Portsmouth  

**Salary:** £64,085 \- £76,581 \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.  

**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available



We are looking for an enthusiastic and diligent engineer to join the SSEN Protection \& Control (P\&C) Team working across the Southern  

Distribution Network.



As a Protection \& Control Engineer, you’ll work with a passionate team on projects from 6\.6kV to 132kV, taking designs from concept through construction and energisation. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders to deliver compliant, cost\-effective solutions on time. You’ll also engage in innovation, standardisation, technology assessments, and work with suppliers on new products and services.



Join us now to help tackle Net Zero challenges and embrace opportunities from new technologies and services.


**You will:**


* Develop scoping documentation and Main Connections \& Protection (MC\&P) Diagrams.
* Review Protection \& Control (P\&C) designs from third parties for 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV networks for SSEN.
* Specify P\&C equipment such as relays, CTs, and VTs.
* Produce detailed designs, including AC/DC schematics, and carry out protection grading studies with relay file/settings creation.
* Review Commissioning Plans, attend panel meetings, and witness FAT and on\-site commissioning as required.


**You have:**


* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in a relevant field is required.
* Proven experience working on Distribution Networks from 11kV to 132kV, ideally a UK Distribution Network.
* Background as a Protection \& Control Design Engineer, including work at 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV.
* Experience in protection relays, relay panels, CT \& VT sizing, protection grading studies, and producing accurate AC/DC schematics.
* Strong knowledge of UK electrical standards, CDM regulations, and a commitment to safety with experience in risk mitigation.


Regular travel is required and as a result we can only accept applications from candidates that hold a current driving license.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Distribution, part of the wider SSE group, powers 3\.9 million UK homes and businesses. Our team of more than 4,200 skilled engineers, customer service advisors and technical specialists keep customers connected to a safe, reliable supply of electricity while investing in and developing the flexible networks needed for our low carbon future.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact laura.morrison@sse.com / 01738 341814 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Context**


Engineering • Leeds • Full\-Time • Hybrid  

  

Are you a people\-first engineering leader who thrives on turning complex technical challenges into elegant, user\-centric software?  

  

As our Senior Engineering Manager, you will sit at the intersection of high\-level business strategy and hands\-on execution. You will lead the engineering organisation responsible for the full BigChange product suite—from our legacy monolith to our rapidly evolving microservices architecture and mobile product ecosystem.  

  

Reporting to executive leadership, you will lead high\-performing development teams, translate strategic vision into actionable technical roadmaps, and embed an AI\-first engineering culture that elevates delivery velocity, code quality, and team capabilities.  

  

About BigChange:  

  

BigChange is at an inflection point. As a pioneer of AI\-powered field service software serving over 250,000 users worldwide, we are transforming how trades and field service businesses operate. Headquartered in Leeds and part of the global Simpro Group network, our platform connects jobs, people, and performance across plumbing, HVAC, fire \& security, facilities management, electrical contracting, and more.  

  

Trusted by over 2,200 high\-growth businesses, we've processed billions in invoiced work and scheduled tens of millions of jobs. We've featured multiple times on the Sunday Times Tech Track 100, and we're just getting started. We’ve recently launched BigChange Lightning—an AI intelligence layer that deploys autonomous agents across field service operations—and we are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the teams building what comes next.**What You’ll Do**

**People Leadership \& Talent Development**
-------------------------------------------

* Grow \& Mentor: Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and merit cycles, providing honest, constructive feedback and creating tangible career pathways for individual contributors and leaders alike.
* Build a High\-Trust Culture: Drive hiring, onboarding, and retention efforts in Leeds to foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where engineers feel motivated to stay and do their best work.
* Be a Pillar of Support: Act as a trusted sounding board and support system for your team through both professional and personal challenges.

**Technical Requirements**

* Legacy Modernization \& Strategy: Expertise in bridging legacy monoliths (.NET 4\.6\.2, WebForms, jQuery) with modern architecture (C\# .NET 8, Micro\-frontends, Microservices on AWS EKS).
* Full\-Stack Platform Management: Ability to lead diverse development streams across Web (React, WebForms), Mobile (iOS/Swift, Android/Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform), and Backend systems.
* Cloud \& DevOps Leadership: Proven experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS EC2, EKS) and robust CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Data Architecture: Proficiency in overseeing multi\-model data environments, including relational (MS SQL, PG SQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases, alongside data integration pipelines (Snowflake, FiveTran).
* Observability \& Security Integration: A proactive approach to system health (New Relic), security compliance (Snyk, Auth0\), and incident management (PagerDuty, FlagSmith).

**Technical \& Mobile Platform Strategy**

* Set Technical Vision: Establish and communicate a technical vision that aligns with business goals, making pragmatic architectural decisions across web, cloud, and mobile platforms.
* Platform Evolution: Oversee our continued migration from an AWS EC2 monolith toward AWS EKS microservices, ensuring system reliability, security, and long\-term scalability.
* Mobile Ecosystem Leadership: Drive high technical standards across our native and cross\-platform mobile apps, mastering the nuances of mobile performance, deployment, and app store ecosystems.
* Champion Engineering Excellence: Establish high standards for code quality, continuous testing, and proactive management of technical debt with an AI\-first lens.

**Delivery, Operations \& AI\-First SDLC**

* Transform to an AI\-First Team: Lead the transition from traditional agile delivery to an AI\-first software development lifecycle—leveraging developer tooling and CI/CD intelligence to fundamentally change how engineers work and what they achieve.
* Measure Progress: Utilize industry\-standard framework metrics (such as DX Core 4\) to track team performance, remove delivery bottlenecks, and validate the efficiency gains of our AI transformation.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management, Commercial teams, and executive leadership to balance feature delivery (especially mobile\-first initiatives) with platform maintenance and technical debt.
* Incident \& Vendor Leadership: Take the lead during high\-priority technical incidents, coordinating calm, swift resolutions, while managing key vendor relationships and external software partnerships where required.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Proven Engineering Leadership: 8\+ years of total software engineering experience with a track record of successfully managing, scaling, and transforming engineering teams within a fast\-paced SaaS environment.
* Mobile \& Systems Architecture Depth: Hands\-on expertise in modern mobile application development (iOS, Android, React Native, or Flutter) alongside proven experience navigating hybrid environments combining legacy systems and cloud microservices.
* AI Conviction: Genuine conviction about AI in engineering—you've moved teams beyond AI as a curiosity to AI as a core capability multiplier in developer workflows and product features.
* Pragmatic Debt Navigator: A track record of navigating legacy systems and technical debt pragmatically without stalling product velocity or feature delivery.
* Executive Communicator: Strong presence and communication skills—you easily translate complex technical challenges for executive stakeholders and bridge the gap between technical and business goals.
* Empathetic Leader: A genuinely people\-first manager who takes team morale, psychological safety, and individual growth seriously.
* Location: Located in or able to regularly commute to our headquarters in Leeds for on\-site leadership presence.

**Our Core Values**

 **We Are One Team**

**We Are Customer Centric**  

**We Are Growth Minded**  

**We Are Accountable**  

**We Celebrate Success**


Simpro, AroFlo, BigChange \& ClockShark are equal opportunity employers with a best\-of\-class onboarding program and supportive team environments. This means that we want everyone to feel welcome and offer equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation, or any other non\-performance factor.


If you'd like to join a fun and progressive organisation, where there are opportunities to develop your career, please apply now with your CV/Resumer.

*Please note: no agencies will be accepted in the recruitment of this role. Any CVs provided to Simpro Software by agencies will be treated as a gift.*

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - AI Engineering - New Capabilities
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**At IFS, we're building the next generation of AI\-native enterprise software, transforming how some of the world's largest organisations manage assets, operations and critical services.**

**This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of modern AI engineering, building intelligent products that combine Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI and cloud\-native technologies to solve complex, real\-world business challenges at enterprise scale.**

**We're looking for engineers who are passionate about building production AI systems and excited by the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software.**

**Please note that this role requires demonstrable, hands\-on experience designing, building and shipping production AI applications.**

*Candidates whose AI experience is limited to using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to assist software development, without demonstrable experience building AI\-powered products or systems, will not meet the requirements for this role.*

  

IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 7000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge.


At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.


We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.


We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.


If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to embed directly with customers on IFS PSO, our enterprise scheduling and optimization platform (.NET 10/C\# backend, Angular frontend) used to solve complex resource planning and scheduling problems at scale. This is a hands\-on technical role that combines software engineering, applied optimization and direct customer engagement.


You will sit at the intersection of our optimization engine and our customers: modeling real\-world planning problems, and shipping working solutions fast, embedded with customer teams under tight deadlines.


This role suits an engineer who wants to solve hard optimization problems in the field, work directly with customers, and feed what they learn back into the core product.


We're AI\-first: you'll be expected to make full use of AI\-assisted and agentic workflows day to day, and we're looking for someone genuinely enthusiastic about using them to model problems and ship solutions faster.


Key Responsibilities

* Partner directly with customers to translate real\-world scheduling and planning problems into optimization models.
* Configure, extend, and debug the core scheduling engine and related components against live customer datasets.
* Build and iterate on new solutions with customer teams, often under tight deadlines.
* Feed field learnings back to core product and engineering teams to improve the platform.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* Strong software engineering background, ideally C\#/.NET; comfortable reading and modifying a large codebase.
* Hands\-on experience with optimization techniques, constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, or algorithm development.
* Comfortable working directly with customers: gathering requirements, explaining trade\-offs, and presenting results.
* Bias toward shipping, with a willingness to develop and iterate quickly under ambiguity.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous, real\-world constraints.


Preferred / Bonus Experience

* Experience with Angular/TypeScript or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Background in workforce or resource scheduling domains.
* Experience with large\-scale data modelling.
* Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms or vertical\-specific optimization products.


Technology Stack (Representative)

* Backend: .NET 10, C\#
* Frontend: Angular, TypeScript
* Optimization: Constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, heuristics, algorithm development.
* Deployment: On\-site and embedded customer environments, cloud\-hosted platform
* Practices: Git, automated testing, DevOps


What Success Looks Like

* Customer scheduling and planning problems modeled accurately and solved within performance targets.
* Working solutions shipped to customers, on tight timelines.
* Optimizer performance and quality issues diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
* Field learnings translated into concrete product and engineering improvements.
* Strong, trusted relationships built with customer teams.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*
