new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
new_jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

**Location:** UK / Hybrid  
**Department:** Development  
**Reports to:** Head of Development  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About Compliance Chain

Compliance Chain is a growing digital technology company providing SaaS and expert consultancy solutions across the built environment.

Our platform brings together compliance, supply chain assurance, performance management and social value solutions, helping organisations manage complex operational requirements through one connected digital ecosystem.

We are still in the early stages of our journey, but we have established products, clients and a growing market presence. As we continue to scale, technology is at the heart of our ambition to become the market\-leading SaaS platform within the built environment.

We are looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to join our development team and play a key role in building, improving and scaling our product suite.

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for delivering high\-quality software across both the front\-end and back\-end of our platform.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who takes pride in **excellent delivery**, writes maintainable and scalable code, and wants to have a genuine impact on the products they work on.

You will work closely with our Head of Development, product and operational teams to understand requirements, solve technical problems and turn ideas into reliable, user\-focused solutions.

As a senior member of the team, you will also be expected to contribute to technical decisions, support other developers and help us continually improve how we develop and deliver software.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the development and delivery of features across our SaaS product suite.
* Work across both **front\-end and back\-end development**.
* Design, develop and maintain scalable, secure and maintainable software.
* Translate business and product requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Work closely with product and operational teams to understand requirements and deliver against them.
* Take ownership of development tasks from initial planning through to deployment.
* Investigate and resolve bugs, technical issues and performance problems.
* Contribute to architectural and technical decisions.
* Review code and provide constructive feedback to other developers.
* Help establish and maintain strong development standards and best practices.
* Support the continuous improvement of our development processes, tooling and ways of working.
* Consider security, performance, scalability and usability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Work with our Azure infrastructure and contribute to the continued scalability and resilience of the platform.
* Help identify technical debt and opportunities to improve the existing product.
* Support the Head of Development in shaping the technical roadmap and future development capability.
* Stay up to date with relevant technologies and development practices.

Our Technology Stack

Our core technology stack includes:

**Front End**

* Angular
* TypeScript
* HTML / CSS

**Back End**

* C\#
* .NET
* REST APIs

**Database**

* MySQL

**Cloud \& Infrastructure**

* Microsoft Azure
* Azure\-based application and infrastructure services

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to work within an existing stack. We want someone who understands **why** technology decisions are made and can help us improve the way we build our platform.

What We're Looking ForEssential

* Strong commercial experience as a **Full Stack Developer**.
* Strong experience with **C\# and .NET**.
* Strong experience with **Angular / TypeScript**.
* Solid experience working with **MySQL or relational databases**.
* Experience developing and consuming **RESTful APIs**.
* Experience working with **Microsoft Azure**.
* Strong understanding of software development principles and best practices.
* Experience working with version control, preferably Git.
* Strong understanding of application security, performance and scalability.
* Experience working within an Agile or similar development environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* A genuine commitment to delivering high\-quality software.

Desirable

* Experience working with SaaS products.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with automated testing and test\-driven development.
* Experience designing system architecture.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs and services.
* Experience working with cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Experience working within a regulated or compliance\-focused environment.
* Experience mentoring or supporting junior/mid\-level developers.

The Person

Technical ability is important, but we're looking for someone who fits how we want to operate as a business.

You will be someone who:

* **Takes ownership** – you don't wait to be told about problems; you identify them and help solve them.
* **Cares about quality** – you take pride in producing reliable, maintainable and well\-tested software.
* **Is delivery focused** – you understand that great development is ultimately about delivering value to customers and the business.
* **Thinks commercially** – you understand the difference between building something technically interesting and building something that solves a genuine customer or business problem.
* **Communicates well** – you can explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical colleagues.
* **Challenges constructively** – you're comfortable questioning requirements or approaches when you believe there is a better solution.
* **Works collaboratively** – you support your colleagues and contribute to a positive development culture.
* **Is proactive** – you look for ways to improve the product, processes and team rather than simply completing assigned tickets.
* **Is adaptable** – you are comfortable working in a growing business where priorities can evolve.
* **Is committed to excellent delivery** – you care about getting things right, not simply getting things done.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success will mean:

* Consistently delivering high\-quality features and improvements.
* Taking ownership of development work from requirement through to release.
* Contributing positively to the technical direction of the platform.
* Improving the quality, scalability and maintainability of our codebase.
* Helping the wider development team raise its technical standards.
* Identifying and addressing technical issues before they become larger problems.
* Helping Compliance Chain deliver a stable, secure and scalable SaaS platform.
* Ultimately, contributing to a product that our customers genuinely value and rely upon.

Why Join Compliance Chain?

This is an opportunity to join a business at an exciting stage of its growth.

You won't be joining a large organisation where your role is limited to maintaining one small part of an established system. You'll have the opportunity to **make a tangible impact on our products, technology and the way we operate**.

You'll work alongside an experienced and growing team, have visibility across the wider business and play an important role in helping us build technology capable of supporting our next stage of growth.

If you're a developer who wants responsibility, enjoys solving problems and takes genuine pride in delivering excellent software, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: £45,000\.00\-£70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension
* Discounted or free food
* Private medical insurance
* Sick pay

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Liverpool L3

new_jobs.title: Engineering (Multiple Roles and Locations) Industrial Placement, 2027
new_jobs.description:
**Choose Wisely, Apply Confidently**

To maximise your opportunities at securing an Industrial Placement with us this year, we strongly advise that you **apply to no more than 3 adverts** . (For clarity, multiple roles within a single advert are considered one application.)


We encourage you to concentrate your efforts on the roles that best align with your skills, interests and university experience, as this will strengthen your application and give you the best chance of success.


**Roles Available in Location** : Ware, Montrose, Worthing, Stevenage, Barnard Castle


**Education required** : See individual roles for degree requirements


**Please read the degree requirements for each role carefully before applying.**

**Other requirements** : You will have completed a minimum of 2 years of your undergraduate degree but will not have graduated at the start of your placement. You must be enrolled at a UK (United Kingdom) or ROI (Republic of Ireland) University for the duration of your placement.


**Pre\-application activity:** Before applying, you'll need to obtain an application code by completing a short activity in Connectr, our candidate engagement platform.


This activity is designed to encourage considered applications. Once completed, you'll receive your unique application code required to proceed with your application.


**If you have already graduated with a** **bachelor’s degree and are currently studying a postgraduate Masters, you are not eligible for this programme.**

**Language requirement** : Written and spoken fluency in English


**Expected Start date** : July 2027


**Duration** : 1 year (approximately)


**Salary** : A salary of £26,400 plus a bonus.


**Workplace Arrangements:** See individual roles.


**Application Closing** : Roles are expected to close on **06/10/2026** , however, candidates will be reviewed regularly, and the advert may close at any point. **Please ensure you review and complete the application stages below.**

**Are you looking to gain valuable real world work experience and help positively impact the lives of others?**

A GSK internship offers you the opportunity to kickstart your career – to take on a real role with genuine impact. You’ll take on challenging tasks within live projects or assignments. You’ll also get to learn from others in your team and other parts of GSK whilst developing your skills and gaining valuable experience for wherever the future takes you.


**What do we offer you?**

* A competitive salary, with an annual bonus based on company performance.
* Employee recognition programs, which reward exceptional achievements.
* Access to our cutting\-edge wellbeing platform: personalise your experience, help reduce stress, increase focus, build connections and resilience. You will also have access to a confidential helpline 24/7, mindfulness, health screenings and financial wellbeing support.
* Access to Private Healthcare Insurance, including 24\-hour access to an online GP.
* Optional Support: Includes identity protection, long\-term care insurance, home, auto, and pet insurance
* Opportunities to work with Employee Resource Groups, providing opportunities to network, gain mentorship, and develop personally and professionally.
* Access to IPUnite which is a community of Early Careers programme participants offering development, networking and social connections to help you make the best of your programme. You will also be invited to join LinkedIn groups and pre\-joining webinars, to enable you to connect and network with new students.
* 2 volunteering days per year

Typical skills you can expect to learn on this placement will include:


* Teamworking through working with multidisciplinary teams
* Communication (written \& verbal)
* Time management
* Problem\-solving
* Networking
* Data analysis and management
* Technical skills (detailed within each role description)

**The Roles (8 available)**

**This advert contains multiple roles. Please read each role carefully before proceeding as you will be asked to provide a preference in the application process.**

**Role 1 – Engineering – Ware**

Degree requirements: any Engineering discipline, including (but not limited to) Mechanical, Chemical, Automation, Electrical, Mechatronic, Robotics or related.


Workplace arrangements – Full time onsite required


Overview of the Department


This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands\-on experience within a world\-class pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers, supporting projects that improve equipment reliability, manufacturing performance, sustainability and digital innovation.


Key Placement Activities


* Support engineering projects from concept through to implementation and qualification.
* Assist with the installation, commissioning and improvement of manufacturing equipment and utilities.
* Contribute to equipment reliability and maintenance activities, helping to improve safety, performance and operational efficiency.
* Work with automation, control systems and digital technologies to support manufacturing improvements.
* Use data analysis and visualisation tools to identify trends and support data\-driven decision making.
* Participate in continuous improvement projects, applying structured problem\-solving techniques.

**Role 2 \- Chemical Engineering – Montrose**

Degree requirements: Related science/engineering degree


Workplace arrangements: Full time onsite


Overview of the Department


The Manufacturing Science and Technology Engineering Associate supports engineers in monitoring process performance, analysing manufacturing data, and driving continuous process improvements within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The role contributes to process mapping activities, evaluation and implementation of new or modified equipment and technologies, and supports deviation investigations to ensure operational excellence and compliance.


Working closely with cross\-functional teams, the position helps optimise manufacturing processes, improve throughput, and enhance process control to deliver reliable and efficient production outcomes. The role also provides opportunities for professional engineering development while strengthening collaboration, communication, problem\-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.


Key Placement Learnings


* Support MSAT engineers with process monitoring, performance analysis, and data\-driven decision making to optimise manufacturing performance.
* Assist with process mapping, workflow evaluation, and identification of process improvement opportunities.
* Participate in the assessment, implementation, and validation of new or modified equipment and technologies.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on process efficiency, quality, throughput optimisation, and process control.
* Support deviation investigations, root cause analysis, and risk assessment activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.
* Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, quality, and technical teams while maintaining accurate documentation and supporting compliance requirements.

**Role 3 \- Process Engineering Automation \& Modelling – Stevenage**

Degree requirements: Any computational degree, e.g., Computer Science, Data Science or a STEM degree with computational interests and experience with programming


Workplace arrangements: Flexible working via performance with choice (office and home working available)


Overview of the Department


Process Engineering \& Analytics (PE\&A) is a multidisciplinary, digital\-first centre of excellence that transforms data, knowledge, and technology into a sustained competitive advantage for delivery across medicines and vaccines. By combining engineering, modelling, automation, analytics, and advanced digital capabilities, the department supports the broader business ambition to accelerate drug development with reduced risk and greater efficiency. Engineers and scientists work collaboratively to solve real\-world challenges across multiple modalities, including vaccines, biopharmaceuticals, and small molecules, and at all stages of development from laboratory and pilot\-scale environments through to commercial manufacturing. PE\&A enables medicine development teams to adopt and embed innovative digital solutions that support pipeline delivery, scalable impact, and long\-term value creation.


Key Placement Learnings


* Develop expertise in building and deploying control and orchestration systems that enable efficient, scalable, and automated process development workflows.
* Create and apply process models and simulation tools to support process understanding, virtual experimentation, and data\-driven decision\-making across pharmaceutical development.
* Contribute to the democratisation of modelling capabilities by developing accessible digital solutions that enable scientists and engineers to leverage advanced modelling approaches in their day\-to\-day work.
* Explore and implement AI\-driven and agentic workflows to automate complex tasks, accelerate insight generation, and support in\-silico experimentation and process optimisation.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists, and digital specialists to deliver innovative modelling, automation, and digital transformation solutions to real\-world development challenges.
* Strengthen technical communication, problem\-solving, and project delivery skills through the development and presentation of technical outputs, while adhering to departmental safety, quality, and compliance standards.

**Role 4 \- Medicine Development and Industrialisation – Sustainability \- Ware or Montrose**

Degree requirements: Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Data Science or other Science\-related discipline


Workplace arrangements: Flexible working via performance with choice (office and home working available)


Overview of the Department


GSK has ambitious environmental sustainability goals to have a net zero impact on climate and a net positive impact on nature by 2030 across our entire end to end value chain. The Medicine Development and Industrialisation team is responsible for defining and delivering technical aspects of the sustainability strategy, namely Ecodesign (how we design and develop our products \&


processes to make them more sustainable) within legacy, next generation and new products within the GSK Global Supply Chain (GSC) product portfolio.


Within this role, you will assist in delivering the technical aspects of the GSK sustainability strategy. You will do this by supporting a team of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) specialists to develop and identify environmental impact reduction plans, working to deliver GSK’s commitment to a nature positive world, by reducing our environmental impacts across, carbon, water, materials, and


biodiversity. Furthermore, you will engage in delivering reduction strategies and project initiatives on identified hotspots, from raw materials, our processes (product \& packaging), to patient use, which are significant to our ambition.


Key Placement Activities


* Support the development of a standard approach to LCA, managing data, documents,
* and outputs.
* Assist with streamlining and automation of product LCA.
* Develop your scientific/technical knowledge of GSK’s pharmaceutical products and
* processes.
* Learn how to drive positive change in sustainability, building relationships across
* multiple interfaces in a matrix environment.
* Build your teamworking and communication skills by working collaboratively both with
* co\-workers and other functions.
* Enhance your written skills through technical report writing

**Role 5 – Mechanical Engineering – Montrose**

Degree requirements: Mechanical Engineering


Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required


Overview of the Department


GSK Montrose manufactures a range of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for respiratory, dermatological and HIV conditions. The Production Engineering team provides support to five key manufacturing areas producing multiple APIs. The team consists of Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Inspection, HVAC Engineering, Reliability Engineering and Engineering Maintenance. On a daily basis, the team reacts to resolve any plant breakdown situations. Longer term actions focus on improving efficiency, operability and maintenance of plant. The department also supports the utilities and infrastructure strategy and provides solutions to engineering problems throughout the business.


Key Placement Learnings


* Ownership of maintenance life cycle plans (establish, update, review)
* Perform failure investigations
* Develop technical specification of maintenance contracts
* Technical input and approvals under the Plant Modification Procedure
* Make recommendations on technically complex issues through evaluating engineering problems that have a potential business impact.
* Take account of legal, regulatory and financial implications of engineering standards and changes.
* Ensure that asset care activities are performed in a compliant manner.
* Understand appropriate commitments/requirements of the Quality Management System.
* Follow the principles of Good Manufacturing Practice.

**Role 6 – Mechanical Engineering – Worthing**

Degree requirements: Any Engineering discipline


Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required


Overview of the Department


There are several Mechanical Engineering opportunities available at the Worthing site.


Within the Manufacturing area, you will be working with highly competent engineers within a highly regulated environment, on equipment which produced numerous APIs.


Within the packaging department, you will experience high speed packaging lines and the importance of a strong reliability programme to maintain successful Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).


In our production and technical teams, you will support day to operations by conducting root cause analysis to meet our high specifications in quality and Environmental Health and Sustainability (EHS).


The utilities and facilities team supports Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) critical systems (water, HVAC, steam, compressed etc.), industrial utilities (waste treatment, chillers, cooling towers) and is the interface with our 3rd party service providers for both our main manufacturing site and our R\&D facility.


Key Placement Learnings


* Supporting delivery of the Mechanical, Inspection and Reliability programmes
* Investigating new engineering technologies to improve plant and maintenance techniques
* Development and implementation of maintenance best practice
* Specifying new equipment and components
* Performing root cause analysis investigations and contributing to safety and quality risk assessments
* Carrying out continuous improvement activities to ensure good manufacturing practice
* Gaining a thorough understanding of the equipment, plant and processes used at the site including mechanical design of systems and the ability to problem solve
* Leading and managing groups of peers or contractors
* Developing skills in project management and planning projects such as plant modifications, building turnarounds and production line safety improvements

**Role 7 \- Facilities Engineering – Barnard Castle**

Degree requirements: Currently studying an Undergraduate Degree in Engineering: Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering.


Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required


Overview of the Department


RSC Assembly Engineering manage and improve the Assembly platforms to enable maximum production opportunity. Managing maintenance, breakdowns, obsolescence programs, capital projects and equipment performance to maximise business benefit and strategic objectives.


Key Placement Activities


* Change management (Change controls)
* Identification and development of business cases for continuous improvement Root cause analysis
* Supporting design for equipment upgrades
* Leading meetings
* Document updates
* Stakeholder management
* Change management

**Role 8 – R\&D Engineering Services – Stevenage**

Degree requirements: Any Engineering Degree


Overview of the Department


R\&D Engineering Services delivers facilities management, engineering and capital project services that support Research \& Development. If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to embed directly with customers on IFS PSO, our enterprise scheduling and optimization platform (.NET 10/C\# backend, Angular frontend) used to solve complex resource planning and scheduling problems at scale. This is a hands\-on technical role that combines software engineering, applied optimization and direct customer engagement.


You will sit at the intersection of our optimization engine and our customers: modeling real\-world planning problems, and shipping working solutions fast, embedded with customer teams under tight deadlines.


This role suits an engineer who wants to solve hard optimization problems in the field, work directly with customers, and feed what they learn back into the core product.


We're AI\-first: you'll be expected to make full use of AI\-assisted and agentic workflows day to day, and we're looking for someone genuinely enthusiastic about using them to model problems and ship solutions faster.


Key Responsibilities

* Partner directly with customers to translate real\-world scheduling and planning problems into optimization models.
* Configure, extend, and debug the core scheduling engine and related components against live customer datasets.
* Build and iterate on new solutions with customer teams, often under tight deadlines.
* Feed field learnings back to core product and engineering teams to improve the platform.

 **Qualifications*** Strong software engineering background, ideally C\#/.NET; comfortable reading and modifying a large codebase.
* Hands\-on experience with optimization techniques, constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, or algorithm development.
* Comfortable working directly with customers: gathering requirements, explaining trade\-offs, and presenting results.
* Bias toward shipping, with a willingness to develop and iterate quickly under ambiguity.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous, real\-world constraints.


Preferred / Bonus Experience

* Experience with Angular/TypeScript or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Background in workforce or resource scheduling domains.
* Experience with large\-scale data modelling.
* Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms or vertical\-specific optimization products.


Technology Stack (Representative)

* Backend: .NET 10, C\#
* Frontend: Angular, TypeScript
* Optimization: Constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, heuristics, algorithm development.
* Deployment: On\-site and embedded customer environments, cloud\-hosted platform
* Practices: Git, automated testing, DevOps


What Success Looks Like

* Customer scheduling and planning problems modeled accurately and solved within performance targets.
* Working solutions shipped to customers, on tight timelines.
* Optimizer performance and quality issues diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
* Field learnings translated into concrete product and engineering improvements.
* Strong, trusted relationships built with customer teams.

Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

new_jobs.description:
The role

Barworks is looking for an experienced and highly capable Group Maintenance Manager to keep our venues safe, compliant and running smoothly. This is a senior, hands\-on position for a practical all\-rounder who can diagnose problems quickly, complete a wide range of repairs and take ownership of maintenance across five busy hospitality sites.

You will work directly with our Operations Director and CEO, while managing your own priorities with a high degree of independence. Support and decisions will always be available when needed, but day to day you will be trusted to assess issues, act quickly and see work through properly.

Key responsibilities

* Take ownership of planned, preventive and reactive maintenance across all five venues.
* Diagnose and complete repairs involving electrical systems, plumbing, fixtures, fittings, fabric and general building maintenance, working only within your competence and qualifications.
* Respond promptly to urgent breakdowns and participate in the agreed out of hours emergency call out arrangement.
* Prioritise work based on safety, compliance, operational impact and guest experience, keeping venue teams informed throughout.
* Create and maintain practical maintenance schedules, asset information, service records and clear records of completed work.
* Identify recurring faults and recommend durable, cost\-effective solutions rather than repeated short\-term fixes.
* Source parts and materials, obtain and compare quotations, and manage maintenance costs responsibly.
* Appoint and coordinate approved specialist contractors where work requires additional certification, equipment or capacity; monitor quality, cost and completion.
* Support statutory inspections, servicing and compliance activity, escalating risks or overdue actions immediately.
* Carry out routine checks and support venue opening, refurbishment and improvement projects where required.
* Build strong working relationships with General Managers, kitchen teams and senior leaders across the group.
* Maintain tools, equipment and any company vehicle safely, securely and in good working order.

What we are looking for

* Substantial hands\-on maintenance experience in hospitality, leisure, retail or another fast\-moving multi\-site environment.
* Strong practical experience across both electrical and plumbing work, supported by relevant recognised trade qualification or qualifications, or demonstrably equivalent competence.
* A sound understanding of safe systems of work and the limits of your own competence, with the judgement to bring in a specialist contractor when required.
* The ability to diagnose faults calmly, make sensible decisions and complete work to a consistently high standard.
* Excellent organisation and the confidence to manage competing priorities across several live venues.
* A self\-sufficient and accountable approach, with clear communication and good record keeping.
* Flexibility to travel between East and Central London and respond to genuine operational emergencies outside normal working hours.
* A full UK driving licence.

Additional experience we would value

* Gas Safe registration or relevant gas qualifications.
* PAT testing competence or certification.
* Commercial refrigeration or air\-conditioning experience.
* Commercial kitchen equipment and appliance fault\-finding or repair experience.
* Experience with extraction, cellar, drainage, HVAC, fire safety or access\-control systems.
* An existing van and professional tool set. A suitable company vehicle \& tool set can be provided if required.

We are keen to cast a wide net. You do not need to hold every specialist qualification listed above to apply. For the right person, we are open to discussing support towards relevant additional qualifications and training. Specialist skills and the breadth of work you can safely undertake will be reflected in the salary offered.

What we offer

* Salary of £60,000 to £75,000, depending on experience, qualifications and specialist capability.
* 28 days' holiday per year, including bank holidays.
* Workplace pension.
* Staff discount and meals while working.
* Confidential 24\-7 Employee Assistance Programme support.
* Company mobile phone.
* A suitable company vehicle where required.
* Support towards relevant additional training or qualifications for the right candidate.

Working arrangements

This is a mobile role across five operational venues. The successful candidate will organise their working week around planned maintenance and business priorities and will also take part in an agreed emergency call out arrangement. The practical details of availability, response expectations, time off and any additional call out arrangements will be confirmed with the successful candidate.

How to apply

Please send your CV together with a short summary of your core trades, qualifications, experience working across operational sites, and any experience with refrigeration, commercial appliances, gas or PAT testing.

Pay: £60,000\.00\-£75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Teknisk Produktägare Integration & Automation till Balder
new_jobs.description:
Vi är Balder. Vi vill påstå att vi inte är som alla andra fastighetsbolag. Att vi vågar utmana branschens gamla sanningar.
  
Som Teknisk Produktägare för Integration \& Automation blir du navet som knyter ihop Balders systemlandskap, från vårt nya ekonomisystem och dataplattform till masterdata och externa tjänster. Rollen sitter centralt i vår tekniska organisation, nära både verksamheten och utvecklingsteamen, och växer i takt med att vi expanderar till fler nordiska länder.
  
  

Om rollen
  
**Rollen växlar mellan att tänka stort och jobba i detalj:** en dag handlar det om riktning och roadmap i vår Azure\-miljö, en annan om att en integration faktiskt levererar som den ska. Du är den som sätter riktningen gentemot både verksamheten och de som bygger lösningarna.
  
  

**Snabbversionen:**  

Du kommer äga roadmap och arkitektur för hela integrations\- och automationsområdet.
  
  

Du kommer agera lösningsarkitekt – från kravställning till teknisk design och implementation.
  
  

Du kommer leda och kvalitetssäkra arbetet hos utvecklare, konsulter och leverantörer.
  
  

Du kommer etablera gemensamma standarder och följa upp drift, incidenter och teknisk skuld.
  
  

”Vi har gått från att köpa in hela integrationsleveransen till att själva äga arkitekturen, riktningen och de tekniska vägvalen, med konsulter som en förlängning av teamet. Samtidigt gör vi en stor teknikresa med nytt ERP, masterdata, dataplattform och flera nya verksamhetssystem. Det är en väldigt spännande miljö att få vara med och bygga.”
  
– Henrik, Enterprise Architect
  
  

Vad vi söker
  
För att du både ska trivas och kunna leverera hos oss så tror vi att du har flerårig erfarenhet av integrationsarkitektur, integrationsutveckling eller tekniskt produktägarskap inom integration – oavsett om det tagit dig tre eller tio år dit. Det viktiga är att du har varit med hela vägen: samlat krav, designat, utvecklat och levererat en integrationslösning från start till mål, med djup förståelse för API\-design och olika integrationsmönster.
  
  

**Krav:**  

Bakgrund som integrationsarkitekt, senior integrationsutvecklare, Solution Architect eller Tech Lead.
  
  

Erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services (API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Functions)
  
  

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur och teknisk design för integrationslösningar
  
  

Erfarenhet av kravställning och teknisk ledning av utvecklare eller externa leveransteam
  
  

Du har utvecklat i något kodspråk (t.ex. C\#. NET), är van vid att testa API: er och läsa API\-dokumentation och har erfarenhet av olika typer autentisierignsmetoder.
  
  

**Meriterande:**  

Erfarenhet av Power Platform, Nodinite eller Infrastructure as Code.
  
  

Erfarenhet från fastighetsbranschen eller andra verksamheter med komplexa systemlandskap.
  
  

Vem är du?
  
Du är tekniskt skicklig och hands\-on men det är affären och verksamhetsnyttan som styr dina val, inte tekniken i sig. Långsiktigt ägarskap kommer naturligt för dig, och du är social nog att navigera i prioriteringar mellan olika intressenter. Din nyfikenhet gör att du hellre skapar ordning där den saknas än förvaltar något som redan är på plats.
  
Låter detta som en tjänst för dig?
  
Kul! Vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning om 6 månader. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Göteborg, med arbete på plats fem dagar i veckan.
  
I denna process ber vi dig inte skicka med personligt brev, utan vill i stället att du besvarar våra urvalsfrågor. Vi använder oss av rekryteringstester för att hjälpa oss göra ett så bra och objektivt urval som möjligt.
  
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Elin Kothe, TA\-Konsult, på elin.kothe@balder.se
  
  

Hjärtligt välkommen till oss och en bransch som är full av möjligheter!

new_jobs.title: .Net Developer
new_jobs.description:
**Vi letar efter en senior utvecklare som både drivs av teknik och affär. Din starka kompetens inom .Net, kombinerat med dina soft skills är det som kommer få dig att lyckas i rollen hos oss!**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





#### **Det här letar vi efter**


Vi letar efter en senior utvecklare som både drivs av teknik och affär.


Med tanke på hur snabbt dagens teknik förändras så tror vi att du är nyfiken, öppen för att utforska nya arbetssätt och gillar att ständigt utvecklas. Här hade vi kunnat fylla på med många buzzwords, men vi tror att du har jobbat med .Net i dina senaste projekt. Har du en dragning mot DevOps eller Cloud så är det ett intressant plus! Vi tror att du som utvecklare är AI\-assisted i ditt arbete, vilket för oss innebär att du använder dig av AI i ditt dagliga arbete för att jobba smartare. För oss handlar det om att utvärdera hjälpmedel och verktyg för att ge kunden en skarpare leverans, inte bara att springa på nästa trendiga tjänst.


Att drivas av affären som konsult innebär för oss att använda din kommunikativa och relationsskapande kompetens för att på djupet förstå kundens behov. Vi tror att det är viktigt för att kunna skapa värde hos kunden, både direkt när du är på plats, men även för att skapa något som håller i längden och för framtiden.


Som Senior Backend\-utvecklare med .Net\-kompetens får du ofta en ledande roll i teamet, till exempel som Tech Lead eller Senior Utvecklare. Det innebär att du både bidrar tekniskt och stöttar andra i teamet – men också att du är med och skapar lösningar som håller över tid.


Om du är en person som vill kombinera dina soft skills med din tekniska expertis, då är vi rätt plats för dig!


#### **Det här är Crowd Collective**


Vi är fokuserade på utveckling (Backend/Fullstack) samt Data (Engineering, Science, ML och BI), givetvis med sikte på moderna tekniker, utvecklingen inom AI och kunskapsdelning. Våra projekt och uppdrag är varierande, både utifrån längd och bransch. Några av våra kunder bygger just nu e\-handelsplattformar, e\-learning\-lösningar, teknik för självkörande bilar och spelupplevelser.


Det här låter kanske som det du brukar höra från konsultbolag. Det som däremot gör oss annorlunda är vår organisering i Crowds. Det är mindre grupper av kollegor som regelbundet ses för att dela kunskap, bolla idéer och hjälpas åt med utmaningar vi stöter på i vardagen. Här finns det alltid någon att fråga, resonera med eller bara få ett nytt perspektiv från någon i en liknande sits.


Tanken med våra Crowds är enkel – du ska aldrig känna att du står ensam i din leverans. Du har ett gäng kollegor i ryggen som stöttar, utmanar och inspirerar, oavsett vilket uppdrag du sitter i. Och du är en viktig del i det själv också – din erfarenhet och dina insikter gör skillnad för dina kollegor. Antingen genom din coachande approach när en kollega söker stöd, eller mer strukturerat i form av mentorskap internt på Crowd Collective. Vår coachande attityd och ambition tar vi givetvis med oss ut till kunderna, där vi flera gånger byggt upp team med juniora medarbetare och coachat dem till självgående utvecklare.  

  



#### **Det här erbjuder vi dig**


Du kan räkna med starkt pensionspaket, 5000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag, tekniken du behöver, föräldralön, mentorskap och 6 veckors semester. Utöver det har du möjlighet att bli delägare hos oss, något vi gärna berättar mer om!


Nyfiken på att veta mer? Skicka in din ansökan så hör vi av oss så snart vi kan!

new_jobs.description:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world's most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI\-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.



At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

##### **As a Staff Frontend Engineer at Gong, you will...**


* Be a major part of Gong's Frontend guild with Frontend developers from all the teams in the company.
* Tackle hard technical problems—some at the architecture level, some at the code level, some at the product level—and come up with solutions, balancing practicality and innovation, short and long term.
* Be the owner of the features you develop, while collaborating with product and UX teams from thinking and wireframes processes to production.
* Be part of our known architecture huddles when we make future decisions about our code and best practices.
* Constantly learn new things \- join professional lectures and workshops organized by Gong. In addition, each developer gets extra learning time on behalf of Gong to gain or improve new professional skills.
* Be a part of a successful startup technology team that translates our vision into a solid SaaS product that performs, scales, is easy to use, and makes a big impact.

##### **You should apply if you are...**


* A software engineer between 8\+ years of industry experience developing web applications.
* Someone who enjoys having responsibility and a sense of ownership of the product you are creating.
* Deeply knowledgeable of how JavaScript works and experienced with React **(a must!)**.
* Familiarity with backend languages such as Java, Node.js, C\#, and others is an advantage.
* Experienced with large scale, cloud\-based web applications.
* Proven experience in the architecture of design systems and components.
* Preferably someone with a degree in computer science or similar discipline.
* An all\-around player, fast\-learner and self\-motivated individual.
* An excellent communicator and team player, with strong verbal and written skills in English.
* Most importantly, a person who enjoys working independently and within a team of highly skilled peers.

##### **What makes Engineering at Gong unique?**



Here at Gong, we trust and empower our employees with ownership to solve complex problems, make the right decisions, and build the best products that create radical impact. We call this "Own. Solve. Impact." For our engineers, it means it's not just about writing code. You are involved and able to influence the entire process to create the best product. If you are curious to discover Gong's wonderful and challenging world, what are you waiting for? Don't delay \- fill in your application details. Who knows, maybe there's a Gongster in you!


##### **Perks \& Benefits**


* We offer Gongsters a variety of private health insurance plans, designed to fit you and your family's needs.
* Wellbeing Fund \- flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle.
* Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching.
* Education \& learning stipend for personal growth and development.
* Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work\-life blend.
* Paid parental leave to support you and your family.
* Company\-wide recharge days each quarter.

##### **About us**



Gong empowers everyone in revenue teams to improve productivity, increase predictability, and drive revenue growth by deeply understanding customers and business trends; driving impactful decisions and actions. The Gong Revenue AI Platform captures and contextualizes customer interactions, surfaces insights and predictions, and powers actions and workflows that are essential for business success. More than 4,500 companies around the world rely on Gong to unlock their revenue potential. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

**Department:** Development

**Why Join Us?**


Welcome to Aptic, where innovative technology meets sustainable software development.


We develop advanced fintech solutions used by banks, finance companies, and e\-commerce businesses across Europe. We are now looking for a **Full\-Stack Machine Learning Engineer** to take ownership of one of our machine learning solutions and help shape the next generation of AI\-powered capabilities within Aptic. You will be part of a small team giving you large impact on solution design and work processes.


Initially, you will revive, enhance, and transition to live production an ML platform, working across machine learning, LLMs, backend development, integrations, and frontend technology. Over time, you will also contribute to broader AI initiatives and product development within Aptic. This gives you the opportunity to build deep expertise in one solution while maintaining flexibility to grow into new technical challenges and products.

**What** you'll do


As a Full\-Stack ML Engineer, you will transition to live production and take end\-to\-end ownership of an ML solution and ensure it continues to evolve, perform, and create value.

* Improve existing machine learning models with measurable gains in accuracy, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy new features across backend, AI/ML, and frontend layers.
* Design and implement APIs and integrations with internal and external systems.

* Create, run, maintain on the build and deploy pipelines

* Experience in designing, developing, and optimizing predictive models using machine learning and deep learning techniques.
* Experience in training, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring neural network models in production environments.
* Solid understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices.
* Understanding of integration patterns and data pipelines.
* Experience with SQL Server or similar relational databases.
* Experience with development in Python, C\# and frontend Javascript based frameworks like React.
* Fluent in English, written and spoken.
* Working knowledge of Norwegian is an advantage

**What’s In It** For You?

* Competitive salary based on experience and background.
* 25 paid vacation days per year.
* Hybrid working model and great office locations.

Aptic AB is a fast growing fintech company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. We deliver advanced solutions across BNPL, ledger services, factoring, lending, leasing, and debt collection. Our CLVR platform is trusted by major players such as Profina, Kredinor, and Lowell.


Our culture is rooted in technical excellence, innovation, and deep customer focus.

new_jobs.title: Software developer
new_jobs.description:
Etsimme **Sovelluskehittäjää** vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

**Sijainti:** Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

#### **Vastuualueet:**


Sovelluskehittäjänä:

* Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
* Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
* Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI\-suunnittelijat.
* Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
* Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

#### **Kenen kanssa työskentelet?**


Työskentelet osana *T*woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.


Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

#### **Odotamme sinulta:**

* Vähintään **3 vuoden kokemus**.
* Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: **C\#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript**.
* Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten **PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle**.
* Pilviosaamista: **Azure tai AWS**.
* Kokemusta **mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista** ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
* Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
* Englannin kielen osaaminen.
* Olet oma\-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
* Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
* Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
* Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
* Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
* Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
* Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

#### **Katsomme eduksi**


Jos sinulla on kokemusta jostain seuraavista osaamisista:

* Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
* Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
* Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
* Integraatioista.
* Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
* Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
* Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.


Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can\-do \-asenteella.

#### **Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?**


Ensimmäisen kuuden kuukauden tavoitteesi kiteytettynä:

* Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.

Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

#### **Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?**


Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

##### **Etuihimme kuuluu:**

	+ Lounas ja virike\-etu
	+ Työterveyshuolto
	+ Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
	+ Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi
* **Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:**


	+ Online\-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
	+ Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
	+ Koulutukset ja community\-tapaamiset
	+ Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)
* **Paljon vapaa\-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:**


	+ Koko firman tapahtumat
	+ Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
	+ Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e\-urheilu, padel.

#### **Tehtävään hakeminen:**


Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn\-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!


Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

**Onko sinulla kysymyksiä,** esimerkiksi hakemukseen tai toimiston esteettömyyteen liittyen, joihin toivoisit meidän vastaavan ennen hakemuksen jättämistä?


Voit ottaa yhteyttä rekrytointitiimiimme careers.fi@twoday.com ja palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian vastausten kera.


Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

#### **Työskentely Twodaylla**


Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.


Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia\- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi\- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.


Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

#### **Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus**


Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

#### **Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?**


Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

new_jobs.title: PhD Position(s) in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture
new_jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a regenerative built environment to apply for one or more PhD positions in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture. The position(s) is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.  



**Scope of the work**

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the research will develop architectural interfaces that support the establishment and growth of living systems, particularly photosynthetic communities, as a strategy for regenerative architecture. The focus is on enveloping surfaces in the built environment.


The project will focus on designing, testing and demonstrating, at architectural scale, porous mineral interfaces combined with hydrogels. Computational design, fabrication and environmental monitoring will be combined with cultivation experiments and biological assessment, targeting mosses, algae and cyanobacteria in collaboration with partner researchers in biology.


We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:


* **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing:** exploring how architectural geometry, material composition and 3D printing can create bioreceptive interfaces. The work will combine computational design, printable material development, toolpath generation and robot programming to develop porous mineral interfaces informed by biological requirements.
* **Living Material Design and Biological Performance:** developing hydrogels incorporating living organisms for integration into porous mineral interfaces. The work will combine formulation, cultivation, sensors, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, biological growth, photosynthetic activity and material performance.

Both profiles require an interest in integrating biological systems and processes into architectural design and construction. The successful candidate(s) will collaborate within the team to develop and validate the resulting interfaces.


The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through teaching, workshops and co\-supervision of student projects.  



**Focus Area and Research Project**

The research will investigate how material composition, porous morphologies and hygrothermal dynamics can support biological establishment and environmental performance, while addressing durability, maintenance and integration into building envelopes. Environmental measurements will help establish relationships between interface design, climatic exposure, biological development and performance.


The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:


* Computational design of bioreceptive mineral interfaces for enveloping surfaces in the built environment
* Development and characterisation of printable mineral materials
* Robotic 3D printing, toolpath generation and fabrication process development
* Formulation of hydrogels incorporating living organisms and their integration into printed scaffolds
* Cultivation experiments and assessment of biological growth and photosynthetic activity
* Sensor integration, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, ecological and microclimatic performance
Fabrication and evaluation of full\-scale architectural demonstrators, addressing durability, maintenance and sustained biological growth  
* 

**About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment**

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.


Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.


SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten\-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2\. The programme provides a long\-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.  



**Responsibilities**

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory\-based investigations. Responsibilities include:


* Conducting high\-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes
* Conducting fabrication experiments and biological and environmental performance testing, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile
* Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks
* Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities
* Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co\-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research\-related activities
* Disseminating research results through high\-impact peer\-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences
* Sharing research outcomes through curated and high\-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions
* Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities
* Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network
* Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.  



**Candidate Requirements**

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, computational design, civil or architectural engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, biology, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing** or **Living Material Design and Biological Performance** , and the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities. Interdisciplinary experience connecting these areas is particularly valued.


Candidates must demonstrate:


* Documented interest and foundational knowledge in bioreceptive design, living system integration or related research areas
* Competence in Grasshopper and Rhino, advanced for the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile and at working level for the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile, together with relevant programming skills such as Python or C\#
* For the **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile:** practical experience in computational design, toolpath generation and robotic 3D printing, together with an understanding of biological requirements relevant to design; experience developing porous geometries and printable mineral materials are particularly valued
* For the **Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile:** practical experience in material formulation and biological experimentation or cultivation, together with competence in experimental measurement and data analysis; experience with hydrogels, sensor integration, automated monitoring or hygrothermal characterisation are particularly valued
* Hands\-on laboratory experience, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile
* Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer\-reviewed publication
* Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral
* Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily
* Strong communication skills across graphical, written and oral formats
A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer\-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively  
* 

**Contact information**

For further information about the position(s) and SDU CREATE’s activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk . For additional information on the Centre’s work, visit the website at www.create\-sdu.com .


If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support .  



**Application Procedure**

Applicants are advised to carefully read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and how to apply for academic staff before submitting their application. The application must be submitted in English and include the following documents, uploaded in the specified order as PDF files:


* Completed TEK PhD application form for 5\+3 applicants. The form is available on the Faculty website .
* Motivation letter and research statement, with a maximum combined length of five pages. The document should clearly describe the applicant’s proposed research direction and qualifications for the position and indicate their primary research profile.
* Detailed curriculum vitae, including academic and professional experience, research projects, teaching and supervision experience, awards, exhibitions, and computational and fabrication skills.
* List of publications, if applicable, including copies of publications the applicant wishes the committee to assess.
* Verified copies of official bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and academic transcripts, provided in Danish or accompanied by an official English translation. Applicants currently enrolled in a master’s programme must include a statement indicating their expected completion date.
* Completed TEK PhD form for calculating grade point average. The form is available on the Faculty website .
* Official documentation describing the educational structure and grading system of the awarding institution, if the degree was obtained outside Denmark.
* Portfolio of up to 15 pages presenting selected research, teaching, or professional projects.
* Contact details for at least two referees, including their names and email addresses. The referees may be contacted during the selection process.
All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF\-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.


SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).  



**The application deadline is 15 October, 2026,** at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  



**The assessment and selection process**

Read about the Assessment and selection process . An assessment committee will evaluate applications. Shortlisting may be applied. Only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the process.  



**Enrolment and employment terms**

Applicants must have a master’s degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree at the time of enrolment and employment. Employment as a PhD fellow is a 3\-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37\.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. Salary and employment conditions are governed by the applicable collective agreement and the Protocol on PhD Research Fellows.


Employment is conditional upon approval for admission by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order) . Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).


Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender\-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.


Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self\-organizer”.  



The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).


Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.


Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.
